title: Bateaux Parisiens Seine River Gourmet Dinner & Sightseeing Cruise
description: Enhance your Paris sightseeing experience on a glamorous Bateaux Parisiens Seine River cruise, including dinner and live music. Enjoy unobstructed views through floor-to-ceiling windows and pass world-famous Paris monuments as they begin to illuminate come sunset. Live French music and dishes inspired by classic French cuisine create an unforgettable atmosphere. Options for a multi-course à la carte meal assure a custom experience for every budget and taste.

reviews.usertext: They have many boats and are a very popular attraction. We book the premiere package which gave us a table in the front of the boat and a cheese course (2 small pieces of cheese). Our servers were great but spread too thing. There were 2 of them covering 30+ guests at 20 tables. They did their best but I did expect a bit more for the premium price of $240 per person. If I did it again I wouldn’t book the premiere option.

We had the dinner cruise at 8.30pm with the "Privilege" package. Overall, it was a very enjoyable experience, the positives being the cruise itself, the very talented singer and the huge windows through which we could see Paris in all its glory. The disappointing part was the food. If you think you can expect "gourmet" food for 170 EUR per person, you are mistaken. The quality was very average and the obvious obstacles of serving a good meal on a ship that has no proper kitchen proved too difficult to overcome (everything tasted like reheated meals, slightly overcooked). The service was also anything but exemplary. For example, when cheese was served, the waiter simply put it on the table and said "cheese course" without even mentioning the types of cheese.
With the privilege package you get a glass of champagne and half a bottle of white and red wine for two people. In our case, we had to ask to have the first glass poured, even though the starters had already been served. The waiter then opened a bottle of white wine, poured it and put it at our table, and then a bottle of red wine on the table. We did not know whether to pour it ourselves or wait for the waiter. After all, when you get half a bottle for two people, you rather expect the waiter to take care of it. Since the wine was also average (especially the red wine), it did not matter much in the end because we did not feel like drinking more of it. In summary, the higher price for the "Privilege" package only makes sense because you sit by the window. The fact that you get more food should not matter, unless you really do not care what you eat.

Spent a lot of time researching various dinner cruises before settling on this one we booked the VIP option and WOW!! The boat is all glass and we were given a table for 2 right at the front of the boat. So the views are great but what makes this cruise an amazing choice is the food! It was absolutely magnifique! Nice size portions and we just wanted to lick the plate! Incredibly attentive waiting staff sharing their own knowledge and even make a very nice mocktail for us.
We booked quite a few things but this one was the highlight! Yes it is pricey but looking back, absolutely worth every euro spent!

I was not in favor of spending a lot of euros on a dinner cruise, but my wife wanted to do it so, of course, we did. The boat is very modern and smooth in the water and, if you do it, I would recommend a window table. Yes, it costs more but you’re already spending a small fortune so what’s a little bit more? The food was good and everyone around us seemed to also enjoy their meals. But, let’s be honest, you’re not there for the food. There are plenty of Michelin starred restaurants in Paris you could go to for the same money, and this is certainly not on that level. You’re there for the experience of floating on the Seine and looking at all the people on the banks looking back at you, and to see the monuments lit up at night. For the “nighttime” experience, plan to take either the early or late dinner cruise, depending upon the time of year. Worth the money? Not for the food but maybe, if you’re there to create a memory of Paris.

We made direct reservation with Bateaux Parisens Seine River Dinner Cruise and paid € 338 for the cruise in advance. This was a mistake on our part as we needed to cancel and attempted to do so more than a week in advance of the scheduled date of 11 October. Initially requesting cancellation by email, no response was received from Bateaux Parisiens. In the absence of a response I contacted Bateaux Parisens by phone. During the call we were informed that under the conditions of the contract a refund was not authorized. Basically this comes down to being an expensive lesson on our part as we did not make the reservation through Trip Advisor as we assumed a full refund would be available if the trip was cancelled at least 24 hour in advance of the start date.

Unfortunately we were very disappointed with this cruise. We chose the nighttime one because there were prior reviews stating the AC was broken and it was very hot during the day, and the same was true even at night. It felt like we were in a stuffy hot box. Our waiter was incredibly rude to us, removing my little brother’s half full plate before he was finished eating, without even asking if he was done. When we protested and stated he wasn’t done yet, the waiter just laughed and continued as if it were a joke. We knew he understood us because he’d been speaking English to us the entire time. The food was terrible and incredibly overcooked—almost inedible. Literally the worst meal we had in Paris despite the high price tag. The waiter continually ignored our table despite us having purchased the premier ticket, and never refilled our wine. All other tables in our row had their wine chillers right next to them. Because our table was by the door, ours was further away. As he never refilled our wine glasses (despite us having purchased 2 bottles of wine with the ticket), I got up to refill our wine myself. When I went to do it, our waiter shouted/screamed at me from halfway across the room that I was pouring the “wrong wine”, instead of just coming over and helping. Save yourself the approximately $200 per person, and just take a normal seine river cruise that is <1h, where you can sit outdoor and enjoy the breeze. Then go eat a lovely dinner at a real restaurant with normal waiters that don’t bully your little brother.

Very disappointed! The only good things were the glass of champagne (I upgraded) the wine and getting off the boat!
The service was poor, and the food was terrible. The extra cheese course I paid for, was 2 chunks of awful cheese, no crackers bread, chutney or anything. Only had one mouthful of the starters. Got off the boat and had a crepe.
The toilets (that weren't out of order) were disgusting.
We were sat right at the back of the boat so could hardly hear the lady singing and only saw her for about 5 minutes.
Spend your money on the Moulin Rouge - that was all excellent.

Firstly, bad signage at the docks. It was impossible to say which "gate" your boat was leaving from, until we queued up (mistakenly) at the ticket booth and got told it was at the other end of the dock.
The whole queueing up and boarding took about 40 minutes.
The boat itself was fine, comfortable chairs and tables with linen. No social distancing and a little bit stuffy without much air flow.
Now for the experience. The food was below average. Very much French "fast food" for large numbers of people. It looked and tasted like it came out of a food production line.
The service was the usual fake "I just want a tip at the end of this" interaction.
Very generous with the wines. Unfortunately the wines were very poor quality and the supposed welcome champagne gave me a headache in about 10 minutes.
Don't go on this boat expecting a nice quiet dinner while cruising the Seine. This boat crams so many people in such a small space, and plays loud music on top of it, that all we could hear for the entire 3 hours were loud market-level noisy conversations punctuated by the futile attempts of a bad DJ or Spotify playlist- I'm not sure which. It was so loud, we could barely hear each other. It was so awful, I didn't care that we paid 500euros+ for an awful dinner, within 30 minutes of this circus I wanted to get off the boat.
It truly was one of our most miserable dinners in Paris, and also one of the most expensive, as we opted for the Premiere (most expensive) option on the menu.

Do not waste your time and money on this ridiculous experience.

A really nice way to discover Paris from the water; we had a lovely waiter who works very hard to get everything in time at your table. Don't expect too much of the food, it is OK (you can choose out of 4 dishes) but it's not the best food you ate. However, together with the live music is this a great way of sightseeing Paris. If you take the 20.30 boat you will return just in time to see the Eiffeltower sparkle.
Tip for the company: state where people should go to instead of stating Pier no. 5 or no. 7 and keep an eye on your airconditioning; it was too cold on the boat (lucky me, I got a blanket from our waiter).

Excellent way to experience Paris by night. Dinner and wine provided are as good as many visitors may expect at any local bistro with the added pleasure of a tour of the city by river.
One can benefit from taking the time to prepare for a bit of a walk to the closest taxi stand or clear through the crowds to find a space for an Über to easily pick one up.

*** Ubers do not take more than 3 adults at a time regardless of what the description says. If you are a party of 4 you will need a VAN**

Guests are dropped off in front of the Eiffel Tower just as it lights up and sparkles in only the way the Tower can. Recommend this evening of beauty and friendly customer service for this new and old to the city.

This is the first time I've ever felt compelled to write a review on here, was wondering what the best place to do it and feel here is where most people will see it:

I bought a lunch cruise for my partners birthday on 4/11, we took the window seat as it didn't cost that much more and we both love cheese so great.

We were given 2 bottles of wine at the start (white) and offered red during.

The waiter was absolutely fantastic and really wish I could have thanked him more at the time. He joked with us, pointed out scenery, when we learned there was a birthday he brought out a little candle on my partners cake. Absolutely adorable (there was a birthday package which we avoided due to not liking the attention those things can bring) but none the less it was very sweet.

The meal was great, the sights beautiful and the waiter really kicked it up a notch.

Definitely give it a go if you're on the fence

This dinner cruise was wonderful! We did it for our last night in town, which was the perfect way to end the trip to Paris. We selected the "premium" option which was pricey, but the food was actually really great, and it came with pleeeeenty of wine, so you get a lot of bang for your buck, plus we had great seats. It seems to me that the option just under premium would have been a great option as well, their seats were just as good from what I could tell.

People really do dress up for this boat tour. I wore my more comfortable shoe option, so I felt a little bit underdressed, so if I were to do it again, I'd go all out and wear heels and a dress and just take a taxi to the boat dock instead of walk. Why not make it a really grand night out?

I wouldn't really say this was great for sight-seeing - you're more focused on eating and having the experience than looking to see which monument you just passed, so I'd recommend doing a daytime sight-seeing cruise to get that experience, or else you'll be trying to see all the sights instead of enjoying the dinner. But floating along the Seine with glittering lights all around you is pretty magical.

Oh, one last thing: we had live music on the boat, and I gotta say, the singer was absolutely fantastic. It was really wonderful. I recommend this for sure!

We booked the Croisiere Diner and choose the Premier Menu; it is a ver beautiful way to experience Paris and although is pricey it is a different perspective of Paris from the River. My boyfriend and I though although it is very beautiful it is a one time experience.
For us quality breads are an important opening of a good dinner… not here: bread is just white and not soft nor French toasted, no options either… Food portions are normal (French) and flavors and condiments were ok. Wines were just very mixed as they serve Rose (for toast) and Red (entree) and White (appetizer) and we requested just to keep one for the whole meal…
The sight from the windows is wonderful and since it goes one way and returns the opposite way you get a look of both faces of Paris.
Yes, we do recommend doing it and going to the tables by the windows as loosing the site would defeat the whole purpose of the journey. The night lights and the water are just such a wonderful Combination of Paris’ view.
If you can and you can fit it in your budget: yes! Do it!

Looked forward to our evening dinner cruise on the Seine booked in advance of our weekend trip. The weather was warm, the singer had a beautiful voice, and all was fine until, unfortunately, 5 meals out of our 10 main courses had to be returned, 4 of them the chicken was served raw. The menu quoted chicken supreme, however, supreme it definitely wasn’t. Unfortunately we can’t believe a chef preparing Gourmet food hadn’t checked the chicken was cooked through before serving. Although the fish I had was fine.

This trip was supposed to be the highlight of our weekend for a birthday celebration, having a ‘posh’ meal whilst cruising the Seine and seeing the sights. It wasn’t meant to be remembered for being ‘that trip where we were served raw chicken’ and wondering if friends were going to remain ok to be able to enjoy the rest of our stay. It’s hard to believe that it is a gourmet chef checking these meals, it wasn’t just one meal, or just our table, there were other tables with the same issue.

Bateaux Parisien have since informed us that they serve ‘Rose Chicken’. This chicken was not even rose coloured, it was raw flesh coloured chicken and definitely didn’t look like it had touched even the side of a pan. Unfortunately no compensation has been offered and no question if those affected have recovered.

Although the trip was a great idea, the experience of friends being served raw food and not being able to eat was not so good. I would not book the dinner cruise again for a Gourmet meal at a Gourmet price when you can’t guarantee it would be edible. Stick to the shorter sightseeing excursion.

My niece and I capped off a whirlwind weekend luxuriating on this elegant sea vessel, enjoying a relaxed evening of delectable gourmet (the title is accurate) food, fine wine and delightful entertainment. We loved that the singer was intermittent so we could also converse. But the songs were lovely and added the perfect bit of entertainment, along with the stunning nighttime view accessible to all diners. Staff was friendly, accommodating and top-notch. Did not feel cramped or rushed!! Well worth every penny.

This dinner cruise is a must for anyone visiting Paris for the first time. The cruise is on a gorgeous boat that follows a route that shows you most of the major sites and attractions in Paris. The wait staff is extremely friendly and attentive and goes above and beyond to provide great service. The only thing we were unsure of is whether or not we should be tipping. I know most Europeans do not tip, and I feel that the cruise was priced at an amount that should include any tip. I would recommend doing this dinner the first evening you arrive in Paris.

If you want to take a Seine cruise at night and see some landmarks from the river in the evening and night, then this is a great cruise boat with AC and very good, attentive waiter service. My only negative commentary is that the 200€ per person dinner for the front of the boat was not worth the price. The food was very average in execution; for example, the chicken was not tender. The bread rolls were hard. The selected wines were tannic.

My husband and I are in Paris for our 20th anniversary. We were told we had to do a boat tour of the Seine. After reading reviews of purely touring boats and transportation boats, we decided to splurge and combine the tour with dinner. This dinner was very luxurious! They know what they are doing. We were in the premiere section, which means we were along the window (left side heading out), but were not in the front section. We would have booked that, but it was unavailable. If it is and you can afford it, I'd recommend that upgrade, but we honestly thoroughly enjoyed where we were at. The food was AMAZING and came with one bottle of wine per two people in the party. They also serve a black current champagne aperitif. We each chose the escargot entree and sea bass plat. For dessert, we each chose a different one to try both. One was chocolate and one was a fruit tarte. Both were excellent, but we preferred the apricot tart. We did the 6:15 p.m. because it was all that was available. The later one requires a fancier dress code, but is largely the same during July as sun doesn't set until VERY late. I would say they are equal in summer, but the later may be preferably if you can catch sunset at other times of the year. We found the dock easily. I thought the value was good when you considered you combined a Seine tour, 3 course meal, aperitif, and full bottle of wine. I would choose this method of touring the Seine over others in the future. If on a budget, consider the lunch tour, which is less expensive. I would not use the Seine boats as a mode of transportation to tour. It takes too long to dock, board, un-board, etc. to make that a practical option.

The tables are so small and close together that we were rubbing elbows with the table next to us. Anytime anyone wanted to get up, the whole group had to stand up walk into the aisle to allow the other person to get up. Not exactly ideal when you have paid for a relaxing meal. Secondly, the white wine that was assigned to us was bad, not to mention that none of our party drinks or likes white wine. Surely there should have been the option of red or white?
We drank our arrival drink and ate our first course whilst still docked up as we were waiting for over half an hour for late arrivals, and when we finally set off the rest of the boat had to wait for them to finish their first course before anyone else had their main. The food was average, we had cheaper and better meals throughout the week we were there. There was nothing on the menu that we hadn't seen or had before.
Whilst eating we were provided with the music of a singer, who much like other people had presumed would sing classic French songs or relaxing dinner music. That was not the case, instead she sang American pop songs which of course encouraged the Americans on the boat to loudly join in.
The sightseeing aspect of the cruise was lovely, there isn't anything better than seeing the city from the river.

I imagine this is some peoples ideal boat trip, but if you are looking for a relaxing, well executed dinner whilst cruising down the Seine this is not it.

Really enjoyed this experience -- food and wine were very good as was the live entertainment. The service was not the most attentive, but not the worst ever. Would have loved a refill on my wine or an offer for coffee while enjoying my dessert, but neither came. Other tables seemed to have more attentive service than we did (not sure if they paid more for a different "level" of experience or what). But overall, we enjoyed this experience at night to see the sights lit up and the beauty of the city in the evening.

I wish I could choose a negative number to express how horrible this experience was. We booked a dinner cruise a month in advance and paid close to $500 for a couple. Our taxi driver dropped us at a dock entrance about a half mile away from the dinner boat dock. We ran the whole way( in heels) and even called ahead to explain we’d be a few minutes late. When we arrived we were relieved to see that the boat was still there and docked. However we were met with the ABSOLUTELY rudest staff Ever! The woman at the counter wouldn’t even consider our situation and refused to issue us a boarding pass. We boarded with our tickets in hand and explaining we were refused boarding passes, security was called and we were asked to get off. You can’t imagine how upset this was considering how much we spent on tickets. This was the single most incredulous moment in my life. Never had I been treated with such indignation in my life. Rude is an understatement. We left and tried to take a lesser evening cruise only to find out the captain had called ahead to blackball us from ALL the other boats! We ended up finding a great private party on a yacht and watched the Eiffel Tower at midnight from there. This company has zero class. Needless to say there was NO refund or explanation. This ruined any romantic visions I ever had about Paris. It’s all an illusion.
Save your money, go to Mexico and enjoy the beach!!!

This was one of the best little dinner outings we ever did ! There was so much food and drinks and would definitely take the plunge and get a window seat ! It was a quaint, romantic dinner for two or it would be super fun with a group. We wished they would have mentioned when we went by a site, but our waiter was amazing at telling us. There was a lovely singer on board which was nice too. They are a well oiled machine, very professional and don't forget to step outside the boat for some fresh air at some point. Take advantage of this wonderful evening out...you won't regret it !

I really don't have words for how incredible of an experience this was. The food was great, but it was difficult to focus on that when you're looking out at Paris at nightfall. There's a reason they call it The City of Lights, and this cruise justifies it completely. When the light show began on the Eiffel Tower as we floated past (twinkling like stars), the whole boat gasped. The singer was perfect and very enjoyable, and I loved the photographs that were taken for us, what a great touch. Fabulous ambience for everyone, whether with family or friends or a couple. A once in a lifetime experience that you mustn't miss out on!

Everything was great. We booked the 8:30 dinner cruise. Menu had a wide selection to chose from and the food was quite delicious. The sites along the river were beautiful and lit up that evening. They provided a map of the important sites so we could follow along as we slowly cruised down the river with a live singer who had a wonderful voice. We purchased the portraits that a photographer provided. Best photos my husband and I have taken in a long while. Was a beautiful experience.

I booked this tour three months in advance and this was the most anticipated event for my trip to Paris. I booked the premier dinner cruise, guaranteeing seating at the front of the boat (just under $500 for two adults). Three factors contributed to my one star review.
First, upon being seated, the romantic ambiance was immediately ruined by a table of 14 terribly obnoxious American visitors. They were so loud that we asked our waiter if there was any way we could be moved prior to departure. Our concerns were completely dismissed.
Second, for a $500 dinner cruise, I expected to be seated at the window. In fact, our table was the only one out of all the premier tables that was not situated at a window, even though we arrived 45 minutes earlier than the other premier patrons and we ALL paid the exact same price.
These first two issues could be completely overlooked if it were not for issue number three—our table was right smack IN THE MIDDLE OF THE AISLE where the waiters walk back and forth!! Each time a waiter walked between tables, not only did our ENTIRE table shake, but the waiters bumped into the back of my chair 100% of the time. I attempted to move the table as far out of the way as possible to give the waiters more space for the aisle, but the waiters continued to bump and trip over us the whole time. I was very stressed out and this truly ruined the experience for me. I would not recommend this dinner cruise to anyone who is considering it.

An amazing end to our trip. The cruise is very well organised. You have a set table so no need to rush to get on board. The waiters and hilarious and very hard working. The food was of excellent quality considering it was mass catering on a boat! We picked the ‘etoile’, which I think was the cheapest, which meant we sat in the middle of the boat rather than by a window. It was absolutely fine and you are raised above the window guests, so get an equally good view. The food was brought out at a good pace and we enjoyed that we got Kir, a bottle of wine (between 2) and coffee all included, along with 3 excellent courses. There was no tannoy announcements telling you what you were passing, but the waiters were great at signposting attractions if they were nearby when you passed them. Overall, we think it was a fair price for an amazing experience and definitely a very special end to the trip.

On a cold afternoon, sitting up top was not a good choice. Add to that the Audio Guide never worked on our phones. While inside option was much warmer, we didn't feel safe using the audiophones during Covid. Fortunately it was a quick trip. We did not do a dinner cruise -perhaps those are better. This is included on the Citypass, reviewed separately, which we won't buy again.

Great experience overall. Food and service were top notch. Cruise was very nice. Great location to see the Eiffel Tower light show. The only thing keeping me from giving 5 stars was the fact that even if you paid for the top most expensive category, they would not guarantee a window table. We bought the next level down because we could reserve a guaranteed window. Makes no sense that the highest level would not allow a guaranteed window. We were only a party of two. We’d have gladly chosen that category had we been assured a window. Some tables in our category were VERY close together, which surprised me given the Covid suggestions. Other than that, everything was lovely. Would definitely recommend it.

I booked this as a surprise for my boyfriend's 40th and we loved it! The boat was very nice and we were sat by the window. We were greeted with a glass of champagne and a little nibble (I booked the privilege experience) and all 4 courses (starter, main, cheese, desert) along with the bottle of wine for the table were excellent! Our waiter was very attentive and friendly throughout the evening and it felt special. We got to see some of the main sights along with the sunset and then the eiffel tower lights. My only minor criticism is that if its your first time in Paris then you get a better view sightseeing on foot than you do from a boat on the river but the overall experience is definitely worthwhile if you want something memorable.

Tables too tightly packed in, even with the most expensive packages don expect any privacy. A number of times we had to ask people to stop taking photos literally right above my head and it was almost like we were eating with the couple right next to us. Only saving grace was our waiter, who was amazing!

We booked this trip excited to see the sights of Paris at night. We booked the premier service having high expectations. Upon arrival we asked which boat we where on we where directed to a check in no VIP check-in as promised. We then walked to our boat were we where greeted and shown to our table.

Then we sat and waited whilst others around us where being served Champagne and their appetisers.

Then arrived the appetisers it was a cold prawn infused starter with a bread roll that was already sitting there when we arrived and it was hard as a brick.

Then the lady came with pink champagne did not ask if we wanted it just poured it and brought us a bottle of water.

Once we sat with empty glasses with no refill or white wine poured for about 20 mins staring at us finally the server arrived with a bottle of white wine to fill our glasses, Starters arrived shortly afterwards, Snail Tart and Foie Gras.

This boat claims to be gourmet dining experience however the food is not of that standard.

Mains came i ordered seabass and my partner beef. With the beef came a tiny pot of peas and one tiny baby potato cut in two. Now i understand gourmet food but this was just ridiculous.

Dessert was a moose with biscuits through it and then coffee and another glass of champagne.

This trip cost us £400 for two adults i would rather go to the Ritz in Paris and spend that on a meal the wine was of a poor standard and the food was awful.

I will be honest and say it was a overall disappointing experience

They claim to offer a premier service i assure you nothing apart from the welcome onboard was premier.

We had a lunch for my birthday on a Sunday. We booked on a whim the day before as it was supposed to be rainy and we didn’t want to spend too much time outside. We all agreed that it was fantastic and we were so happy we did it! We had a “privilege” package meaning we had a kir for apperitif then a white wine with the first course and a red with the second. Water and coffee and also soft drinks for our pre-teen. We all ordered different things and they were all delicious and the service was very good. Everyone was nice and efficient. We had a table by the window and eating some good food in the great company of my family while crusing on the Seine under the rain was really a wonderful experience. There is no naration (other than the waiter giving some pointers) but it would have been intrusive in my view so if you are looking for a guided tour, this is not it. More than great value for the money in my view.

Absolutely amazing
We had a Premier service Sat by the window and really nice. It was my birthday and it was made extra special by our server Mikolai.. we had two bottles of wine which came included with the price.. a glass of champagne and 4 course dinner... :*>.. perfect 3 hours on a boat with extraordinary live singer who was really really talented !!!

We enjoyed the entire experience. The food was excellent! We went on the 8pm tour- well worth it if you want to see the city of lights at night. We had live entertainment- the female singer had a beautiful voice! The staff was accommodating and very pleasant. I would definitely go on this cruise again!

We did not enjoy this cruise. The staff was rude. All the people around us were given wine and apps and we were completely ignored. We had to ask for water! The food wasn’t appealing and it came to our table, after most others, lukewarm. I would not recommend especially for the price.

We booked this place for my birthday dinner and it was terrible!! We spent over 300 euros.

On the day, they told us the water was high so we were taking a different route... meaning we didnt see ANY sights apart from the eiffel tower (because the boat docks next to it), and the statue of liberty. We were given some vouchers for another cruise... someone told us its worth 100 euros, but then the waiter told us it's just a regular sight seeing cruise. Also, we left Paris the following morning and they told us to return to Paris to use the tickets another day!!! WOW.

The service was awful, and we often had to ask the waiter a few times for something. E.g. I asked if they have tea, he said he will find out, 20 mins later I had to ask him if he found out. They did not have tea, but he didn't even bother coming back to let me know.

And the food is TERRIBLE. It is like airplane food, except airplane food is better. And it's also not 6 courses. The 2 starters come together, as do the 2 mains and 2 desserts. The flavours were not balanced. If a course was sweet, it tasted like pure sugar. If it was creamy, it tasted over the top of cream.

As a big foodie, I definitely recommend to not waste your money here.

We went there with some expectations.
The reception was very friendly and well organized.
We had a very nice table in the front of the boat with great view.
The waiter was very nice and entertaining.
The live singer was annoying by her incapacity to sing.
The food was what is to be expected in this type of tourist venue, pre-cooked not exceptional, exception made for the sea bass and the steak which were very good.
The big disappointment was the cruise, because of the weather we went to Boulogne rather than the city, very very boring. We were happy when it finished.
It was raining and we asked for a taxi, the answer was to wait for one outside (under pouring rain....)
For the money paid, definitely not worth it

As the other reviews have mentioned, this is a wonderful experience. From start to finish it is professional - from the welcome to the service to the food and wine. We chose a window table and enjoyed the view - it takes about 2.5 hours and is well worth the money. We enjoyed the live music and the food was exceptional.

Would definitely recommend.

We booked premier service more for the views, but turned out the food and wine were excellent. We boarded early and they started serving us right away, almost 30 minutes prior to sailing. This allowed us more leisure time to take in the sights during the cruise and extra time for photos. The staff was attentive and put up with us not knowing French. A really great experience and food to see the sights at night.

Wonderful and pleasant experience, the food was good and the service from Boris was excellent. The entertainment, the quality of the singer, and her interpretation of some of the songs were of a very high standard. The cruise was enjoyable, the only concern was that time flew and before we realized it, the time was past 23:00 and time to disembark.

Friendly staff, and a really lovely guided "croisière" (I love this French word) on the Seine river. I wait for the pleasure to do it again, but next time for a dinner, and at a table located at the front of the boat.
Great key point: the boats start the cruise and come back at the feet of the Eiffel Tower !

Fantastic!! We had a wonderful time. Good food, excellent wait staff, lovely singer, nice wines, and great views of Paris at night. There was a young couple that got engaged at the table near us. The man had set it all up. It surprised us: the bride-to-be was taken back by it all and cried. Very romantic moment that the will share for the rest of their lives. After 34 years of marriage to my wife I applauded his planning, and the entire boat applauded them. HIGHY RECOMMEND!

Absolutely loved this experience! It was our first time in Paris and we paid extra for the window seats etc. It was so worth it. However, I think anywhere we had been sat would still have been lovely. Everything ran perfectly to time with no delays or problems. Our waiter was very friendly and attentive and stopped at our table several times to point out sights and explain what we were passing. The singer was great and created a lovely atmosphere - yes he did covers alongside other songs but it was all pitched just right - relaxing and then more upbeat as the night went on. Food was great and there was as much wine as we wanted! We had 3 bottles of white in a cooler next to our table and red on the table over dinner! The boat had air con and due to it being one of the hottest days ever we were definitely glad of this. This was my favourite thing that we did in Paris and couldn’t recommend it highly enough.

My husband and I chose to take this dinner cruise our first night in Paris. It was enjoyable, the waitress was sweet, the food was pretty good and the views were nice but there was not much else. They played jazz music over the speakers and we rode 30 minutes down the river and 30 minutes back. The only thing you could really see was the Eiffel Tower. We paid extra to be in a window seat but the boat was pretty empty the night we went and could have easily been in a “non window” seat without an obstructed view. It was nice but I would not pay $200 to do it again.

We decided to take the lunch cruise on our last day in Paris. The cruise was smooth and the views were beautiful. We splurged for a window-side table and we’re glad we did. The food was well-prepared and presented, and included wine with each course. It was all very delicious. It’s a great way to say goodbye to Paris on your last day. There is an evening cruise as well, which would be lovely with the city all lit up, but it started at 8:30 p.m., which was a bit late for us as we had an early flight out the next morning.

This is more of a 4.5 star experience. The food was great and the staff was great but the dinner option just makes it tough to see some of the structures from the river. The cheaper option is great and I would recommend doing that if you can and doing the lunch instead of dinner. Still a very fun and enjoyable experience!

Everything was amazing. The food, the drink, the location. Despite the busy location it was so easy to access the boat.

I’d also just like to thank the staff. Everyone on that boat was amazing and so helpful. Even with a slight language barrier with French/English they made everything as good as possible for us. The waiters were so skilled and so polite.

Definitely recommend this to anyone travelling to Paris, it’s absolutely worth the money :)

We did the Premier option and it was amazing! It sounds like too much food but over 3 hours it was just right!
I would recommend getting there right when they open (45 minutes before departure) as we started getting drinks and food right away.
There was no tour guide explaining everything but there was a pamphlet that listed the larger locations and gave a little history. We saw some kids at the very front (seems to be reserved for the largest group in Premier) that we’re having a blast pointing out the different places listed.
At the beginning there was a shade overhead to keep the sun away but once it started to get darker the shade was taken away and the light of the individual lights on each table lit the boat just enough.
The wait staff were all amazing and accommodating. The food was beyond delicious and we even tried new food!

Was taken on the river cruise as a birthday treat!
Well what an amazing experience! 3 courses with a bottle of wine, the food was amazing and you didn’t have to wait long considering how many people were on the boat. The waiter was great, he made sure he took pictures for you and told you the sights as you sailed past!

I was a bit unsure what to wear but I would say there was a mix! Some people dressed to impress & others smart casual..

I think they would really benefit in getting a photographer on the boat or before you board.

The Eiffel also looked lovely at night.

Wonderful place for a date,… a bit awkward to go alone like I did. The meal was great. They were a little sketchy in that they opened a bottle of wine I didn’t ask for, poured a glass, walked off with the open bottle on the table and then tried to charge me $48 euros extra (I don’t think this happened to other people; just me because I was alone).
It’s the equivalent of a very fancy dinner. Most ladies were in dresses. Many men were in suits with ties. No tennis shoes or shorts are allowed…. It’s a fancy restaurant, but also a boat. They will try to upsell you on photos they take of you, on wine, on a cheese plate, etc.
There’s live music. That’s nice.
I enjoyed the meal and went out on the deck outside to take photos.

This was an excellent sightseeing gourmet dinner tour. All in English. The food and wine was excellent and the singer very charming and a song a great selection of music appropriate for
A gourmet dinner and tour.
The waiter was attentive and prompt.
Very romantic too!!get the privilege ticket.

The waiter I had brought the wrong starter but because we were waiting so long for food I just ate it. Everyone else had be long served their food. But I checked our order and he had also gotten my main course wrong, when I pointed it out it out, he got quite narky. The views were only so so. If you weren’t at a window seat you really didn’t see much. I probably wouldn’t recommend unless you just wanted somewhere to just relax for a few hours as it’s expensive. Also the air conditioning was blasting and we were frozen. The people next to us as for it to be turned down as it was so cold but the waiter said no.

Everything about this trip was perfect and was the highlight of our stay in Paris. The staff are friendly, the food was delicious and wonderful views of the city. There was an onboard singer who had an exceptional voice and a photographer who comes round to take your pictures. We couldn’t fault anything

Seeing Paris as you float the Seine is a must! This was a great experience! The food was outstanding, the staff friendly, and the view was amazing! We did the upgrade to sit by the window and it was worth it. So many great pictures! It was fun to see Parisiennes picnicking on the banks of the river and getting a different perspective of the city.

Oh, and there was live music! The music added even more enjoyment and the singer was very talented. She sang a wide range of music from Ave Maria (as we passed Notre Dame) to New York New York, to current pop songs.

Lastly, watching the Eiffel Tower light up and sparkle was the cherry on top! Best experience in Paris!

I enjoyed this experience in the premium class as a great romantic experience. It is especially wonderful if you or your significant other have not seen Paris before. We enjoyed the experience being in the fully glass surrounded part of the boat -- this is the most premium experience, but felt definitely worth it.

Last year we had a reservation for a river dinner cruise by the Bateaux Parisien. We arrive there and were quickly welcome to our ship, the Zodiac. The food was excellent,
salads, main course, dessert, wines, all of them with a magnificent presentation proper of the French Cuisine. There were two singers with live music, performing the most relevant French songs ever sung. I strongly recommend the Bateaux Parisien to anyone who visits Paris and wants to have a very special Parisian experience.

My wife and I booked the 3 course dinner cruise on our first night in Paris, and we have to say that it was a fabulous evening all round. The ambience, the food, the wine etc, was exceptional, we evening had a live singer on the cruise for the evening who was brilliant. The cruise takes you past every top spot on the Seine in Paris, so plenty of opportunities to get pictures, and a great way of finding your bearings of city landmarks. It may seem a little expensive, but money well spent I say.

I booked this cruise for my girlfriend's 30th birthday and, initially, we were very impressed. The welcoming was good and the seats were excellent. Unfortunately, this is where the good ends.

Our waiter constantly spilled drinks as he poured them, there was no commentary or pointing out landmarks (you just receive a map that isn't to scale) and the food was of average quality.

Worst of all, when I booked I mentioned the birthday. Other guests received a rendition of Happy Birthday and a cake, however my girlfriend received nothing. When I mentioned to the waiter that it was advised when booking, he just shrugged and said service was finished, but then later returned with two small macarons and a small candle, mumbling Happy Birthday and walking off before it finished.

We were left quite disappointed and wish we'd spent our money in a nice restaurant.

This was awful. Tourist trap. The food was mediocre it was not great. Defiantly not The wines were amazing but that was it. The singer did nothing but sing karaoke covers of American songs. That's not what you want when in Paris. We were hoping to hear french relaxing music to really set the stage as we are in France. This cruise was by far not relaxing whats so ever. I would like to speak to someone about a refund please.

We did this on our last night in Paris & we were so impressed. Great food, wine, service & views. You get a map of the places that you will pass so there's no narration as you go, which we thought was nice. We got the VIP experience so we had everything included, and we had a table for 2 next to the window. Everyone was very careful about masking up when away from their table. There are restrooms on board, as an FYI. I would suggest booking ahead of time as the night we were there we heard that people were being turned away unless they had a reservation.

My friend has never been to Paris before and I thought it would be a brilliant way to see the beautiful city especially at night. It did not disappoint. The boat was beautiful the tables were laid out brilliantly so that where ever you sat you could see all of Paris from the Seine. The staff were professional, courteous and extremely efficient. The food was utterly delicious, I literally cannot recommend this cruise more highly. Starting and finishing at the Eiffel Tower with the lights as it became dark was just such an incredible experience.
A memory to last a life time, thank you.

Our family and friends attended this memorable evening dinner cruise. Food was good and alcohol was plentiful. Live singer and lighting created a warming and romantic ambiance. Loved the open glass windows for panoramic beautiful view of the city. Highly recommend that you add this to your itinerary whenever visiting Paris.

As grandparents who have been to Paris several times on our own, I thought it would be a nice experience for our granddaughter. However I found it a wonderful experience for all
The food was very good and the wine very nice. We didn’t expect it to be so good. It was also lovely that we had a wonderful singer who chose nice music instead of a running commentary of where we were and what we were seeing; been there, done that one! Highly recommended

I really wish I could give a better review but this organization needs restructuring. They messed up on our reservation and two weeks of email, long distant calls and messages on the website went unanswered. Very stressful! The food was terrible! Overcooked chicken that resembled a brick. My wife's fish was a four-ounce piece of, I think, Sea Bass, with 8 ounces of sauce and it was cold. One of the women's rest room was broken so ridiculously long line created a long wait at the end. The boat was pretty. The cruise part was pleasant enough but everything else was not. There are several companies that do this sort of cruise. We chose Bateaux Parisiens because Rick Steves had recommended this company. Boy, were they wrong!

Special night for my daughter and I. What’s better than night dinner cruise in Paris. Great food and service, wine and champagne flowed all night. The sun sets and the city lights glowed. I literally teared up when as we past the Notre-Dame the singer sang
Ave Maria. Magical, sacred moment for us. Thank you.

To start with, boarding was a breeze and waited to be seated in a separate lobby indoors (it was freezing outside). Taken to our table, a separate table for 2 by the window as promised in the booking. We set our orders and the food was non-stop delicious, good portions and the wine was flowing, with a glass of champagne at the start. The music was nice for the ambiance and the boat ride was as smooth as it could be. The waiting staff was very accomodating and also good humour.

I can honestly say that this was money well spent and I would do this again at every chance I could. From the staff at the start all the way until my partner and I where leaving where friendly and ready to help you at any second. Our server unfortunately I do not have his name was brilliant and any questions we asked about our menu he knew the answer with out a second thought. The food was fantastic, the wine, which I wouldn't be a big drinker off, was amazing. I don't have one fault. I would highly recommend to anyone.

This experience was truly the highlight of our week in Paris. We were treated to an amazing meal, experienced wonderful service and the views of the monuments and lights of the city were truly incredible. We paid a bit extra for a table next to one of the large windows and I am so glad we did! This was definitely a splurge for us but well worth it!

The tour was a great disappointment. The food was mediocre and the views were not nearly as good as they were from simply walking or riding along the Seine. A much better option is to go to a nice restaurant along the River and enjoy a leisurely dinner and walk. The food, the view, the experience was all just subpar.

We took prestige package, worth every €uro
Access, staff and service was well organised.
The waiter who served our table all people where onboard and at their tables was excellent, very attentive and constant attention to make sure son enjoying cruise and happy as no young child menu.
Food as always very good and we had a really good time.
Not the 1st time we have done this but rates amongst the best times.

A group of 8 of us did the 8:30 PM cruise which lasted about 2 1/2 hours. There were no problems with the boat or water and it was smooth sailing. The tables and chairs are arranged in different configurations with smaller ones right along the windows and larger ones toward the inside of the boat. Because the windows were large and clean, everyone had a clear view of the river and the sites along the banks.

Everyone enjoyed the food which consisted of typical starters, entrees, and dessert (or cheese). The one mistake was that the waiter cleared one of our cheese plates before we were finished. When we pointed that out, he said “Sorry!” And walked away. The proper response should have been “Sorry! I will bring you a new plate of cheese.”

There was a photographer who took pictures, printed them out, then distributed them later on asking for 20 euro each. He wasn’t pushy. There were two singers who walked around singing to recorded music but only part of the time.

I wouldn’t say this was the best experience ever but it is a fairly quiet enjoyable way to spend an evening.

I can’t rate this boat trip highly enough, it’s has a lovely ambiance when you walk onto the boat, the waiters are very friendly helpful and attentive. The food and wine delicious and plentiful. A really enjoyable way of seeing Paris in a very relaxing manner, we felt great value for money. We had the privilege service option and glad that we did decide to have some photographs taken which where very good and reasonably priced.

I was in Paris for the International Rugby match and as it was my first time in Paris wanted to get the maximum enjoyment from the time there.
The Seine River Dinner Cruise exceeded my expectations.
I was travelling single and choose the window seat view which afforded me uninterrupted views ( if you cannot stretch yourself you will still get good views as the boat is glass topped).
The boats are moored next to the Eiffel Tower and when light up offers a magnificent view - consider night cruise vs day to see the lights. There is no running commentary however there is a explanatory sheet is given with your menu.
The service was discreet, the food top class,after my complementary glass of champagne the dinner was served. It was well spaced out with the complementary white and red wine.
I went for the Privilege service which I would recommend.
Should mention the discreet live on board entertainment on board which comprised 2 guitarists and female singer.
Total cruise time was 2hr 30mins.You can step out to the back and enjoy the view as well.
Well worth it and a memorable treat when in Paris

I’m vegetarian/vegan. I found the menu boring. The vegetarian starter was green vegetables in a white sauce. The vegetarian main course was green vegetables in a white sauce. Perhaps the chef could be more creative in offering vegetarian/vegan options? This is a direct message to him or her: be more creative with regards to plant-based options.

A wonderful evening, lovely food and atmosphere. We had a lovely waiter who was attentive even though he was busy and had a laugh with us.
A fabulous way to see Paris and the wine flowed. The singer on board, was excellent and sung a wide range of pieces. Her Ave Maria was a real surprise and beautifully done.
Thank you for a memorable evening with my mum and two girls.

I wasn't sure what to expect given the mixed reviews. Our experience was top notch. Great food, drinks, and service (waiter was Samad?). Please note there is a vegetarian option for those who aren't meat eaters. One thing I would recommend is to make sure some of the windows on the boat to be a little clearer. The windows weren't dirty but streaked.

What a wonderful dinner cruise. My husband and I enjoyed it so much! There was live music and it made the evening. We choose the premium package and it ended up basically being unlimited wine! The food it just ok but with the views, music, wine, and ambiance we didn’t even care. I would definitely recommend this tour!

Booked this as a romantic Saturday dinner for our long weekend in Paris - really pleased with the overall evening although it was expensive to secure a window seat which also had champagne aperitif. We had a lovely side position sectioned off from main area, super French couple celebrating a birthday and expecting second baby sat across the aisle. The music was perfect pitch and very relaxing; the Seine route took in 12 or so main attractions including the lit Eiffel Tower. We had hors d’ouvres, scallops starter, duck main and cheese as well as lovely dessert with coffee and petit fours. White and red wine accompaniments. The service was perfect and attentive but not intrusive. It was all timely and we got an Uber back to hotel minutes after docking. A perfect, memorable evening.

It was expensive. We took the night cruise and saw Eiffel Tower lite and it was very beautiful.
The check in and boarding was very nice. Nice touch with the sweet champagne initially. The singer and the choice of songs were very appropriate for the passing sites. The food was only ok. The sea bass was a tiny bit overcooked. I wish I had a little bit more time to go outside to take pictures. Overall, a very nice experience complimented with wonderful night time weather.

All the positive reviews have been accurate! My experience was so awesome. The food was delicious! And the singer was wonderful! She was such a gem! But the service… the service!!! One server in particular was AMAZING! CC! He thought of everything! He was a dream! I saw like 5 people (including myself) complimenting him personally. No exaggeration—he was so wonderful! Please treat yourself to this cruise and if you get seated in CC section you will be grateful!

This was a horrible experience. Hopefully it was an anomaly but we paid almost $100USD per person and ended up shuffled onto an overcrowded boat like cattle to see the city after dinner due to high water. We paid and upgrade for window seats and there was no accommodation for the upgrade. If you are going to bait then switch, even for cause there should be both a comparable service AND a refund (even if only a portion) option. We could have done many other things we would have enjoyed more and spent less. We won’t make this mistake again.

Seriously do not waste your time and money with this. You can get a super cheap river tour and go to an amazing dinner for half the cost. The food is horrible and you unless you pay for the most premier spots your seats will have a hard to see from view.

It was an ok experience for the value. We payed extra to get a window seat which really may not matter since it was hard to see with the glare on the windows. It is a smooth boat ride. The food is average and the music was like karaoke hour. You do go by some sights but if you are not tracking it on a map - you would never know. The Statue of Liberty and the Eiffel Tower were the highlights.

Food was okay but not a lot of options. We took off later than planned because a lot of people weee having problems redeeming vouchers. Also you are on your own for seeing things there is no one pointing things out. Wine was eh and no options to change it out without paying.

Great night views of many of the great attractions of Paris. Live music on board, friendly service and the dinner was much better than we had expected (had read some previous negative reviews). Definitely high on our list of things to do on your first trip to Paris!

We took the 8:30 cruise. They suggested that you check in at 8 PM and yes, you should as it takes a little while to get through the red tape and get to your table. The servers were delightful the dinner was delicious. The live entertainment was very good and really added a nice touch to the evening. The local Parisians gathered on the quays on both sides of the river, picnicking, having wine, dancing with their children and all waving and toasting us as we sailed by… An unexpected charming addition to the evening. The route is just beautiful down one side up the other around the bend and back again to the Eiffel tower. Of course, it's light until almost 10 in the evening but the cruise takes its time and you are on the boat in the dark. My only complaint was that they did not open the window coverings completely. I don't know why, but one side of the glass ceiling remained covered blocking a good portion of the view. The rest was wide open. I enjoyed the experience thoroughly and would recommend it. Well worth the $125 a person.

I unfortunately had to cancel my trip to Paris due to the current situation. However, I just wanted to say that Bateaux Parisiens has been so helpful and understanding with everything.

I have not even sailed with them yet and plan to rebook as soon as I am settled on my new dates for Paris visit. However, their customer service and attention have really impressed me and more than earned my business already.

I can not wait for my actual cruise.

I know that this is a hard time for so many in the hospitality and tourism industry so I just wanted to give appreciation to a company that is trying to do well by their guests and be as helpful as possible.

The experience was great. Check in was fast and we were seated quickly. Small delay in the initial ordering but it was a full boat that night. Be patient!

The menu is prefixed with 3-4 options per course. There’s an option for everyone, even the picky eater in our group was happy.

It was loud throughout with dining happening as well as entertainment. If you’re looking for a quiet evening this isn’t for you.

We really enjoyed it as a family with older adult children.

So before me and my fiancé traveled to Paris I knew that I would want to do a dinner cruise for his 25th birthday. I reviewed so many of these before deciding to do this one. It seemed the most elegant from pictures and most of the other reviews were great. Finding the actual boat was super easy and there was coat check. The greeters before you get on the boat were also very polite. I paid extra to sit by the window and it was worth it! The views are incredible and it was a long boat ride and I felt like I got my moneys worth. Now you are seated pretty close to other people so that was my only downside. But the food was pretty good to me and I'm from Louisiana so we KNOW good food. Our fish entree meal was so good that we ordered an extra plate. You also get TWO bottles of wine with your meal which was awesome. They also sang happy birthday to my boyfriend which was very sweet. Overall I would highly recommend this cruise if you're debating.

Booked this trip as a surprise for my partner. I decided against spending the extra for a window seat as the reviews said the views from all seating were good. As it turned out we were the seats directly next to the window seat, which were vacant so we practically got a window seat without a actually paying for it!

The food was good, there appeared to be a good selection of different meats to suit all. The value was good as our tickets also included a bottle of red wine, our waiter was full of banter and also gave us a free bottle towards the end of the trip.

The views of the Eiffel Tower as you floated past were incredible! We took the early dinner cruise which has no live entertainment.

Overall I would recommend this dinner cruise!

This was a great evening, would really recommend. We went for etoile service which was fine, we had a good view of outside so personally I wouldn't pay to upgrade.
Food was excellent and staff were good. Only thing id recommend is one or two more staff as the waiter seemed absolutely rushed off his feet.
Still a really wonderful evening, would highly recommend to anyone thinking about it.

The combination of location, food, drink, and music created the perfect ambiance and experience. Floating slowly with the Paris sites all around was amazing. We highly recommend this dinner! We would recommend upgrading to the window seat for sure, but you can go out back anytime for photos outside. It was extra special as our first time in Paris.

My husband and I did the dinner cruise, we got the premiere option ( I think that’s what it’s called), over all, it was a nice cruise and I don’t regret doing it, the sites were beautiful and they were Not stingy with the wine and champagne. My only complaint would be that for what you pay the food is definitely not worth it. But it was our first time in Paris and worth doing if it’s your first time there because it’s romantic (in my opinion)

We did the 8.30 dinner cruise which we found disappointing. They had no record of our reservation upon arrival (even though we had a confirmation email), the service was lacking with having to wait for drinks and food (the food had to be served 20 minutes after everyone else due to them having to find us a table last minute) and some rude staff. The sights however were lovely along the river but unfortunately we found these and our evening to be over shadowed by a series of poor service .... especially for the price of a window table.

We really enjoyed the cruise. A lot of the comments on here have indicated that the food was to their liking, but both my wife and I thought that the service, wine and food was lovely and terrific value for money.

The views offered of Paris were also superb and it was a wonderful romantic evening for us. If you are coming to Paris on a romantic vacation or honeymoon then we would thoroughly recommend this experience.

My best friend (we are mid-50’s) and I were completely wowed by the views on the cruise and the food was delicious and well prepared. Rating three stars because our server was dreadful - no greeting, just a rushed “are you ready to order?” (You place your entire courses order at once). Got one order wrong, trying to tell me I ordered a meat dish (I am vegetarian.) Never checked back on us, but scolded my friend “no!” for pouring her own wine from our bottle (?!) that was in a shared chiller with the table next to us (they were not drinking, the bottle was clearly ours). To top it off, as I was putting my coat on at the end of the meal he literally pushed past me with a tray and almost knocked me over (he picked the tray up AFTER he saw me standing and struggling to get the coat on in a small space.)
Otherwise, my only complaint about the cruise was the spotty music. Nice enough tune selection but would stop and start and suddenly get loud then quiet - odd. It was fun that they played “New York, New York” as we rounded the mini Statue of Liberty.
This is my second cruise with this line and definitely won’t be my last Seine cruise but I will try another brand next time.

I wish I could give 5 stars and talk about the amazing experience that we had here.. we came to Paris for a couple of nights and this was supposed to be our headline event for a 30th birthday, when we turned up to the dock where the cruise is supposed to pick us up we were turned away by a security guard saying that no cruises tonight as the river level was too high. This is totally an acceptable reason to cancel to cruise, however, there was no communication from the company at all. There were many people waiting for the same cruise without a notion that it's cancelled. I immediately called their head-office, the person on the phone indicated that there was an email sent 2 days ago stating that the cruise was cancelled. Checked spam, deleted emails etc., NO EMAIL.. not only did they not communicate this to any of the customers but they also lied that they did, totally disgraceful.. If we had received a notice we would of arranged a different activity for the night and moved on, but this just left us stranded by the river at 9 pm...hope they learn from this and change their ways... only a refund for this event doesn't even do justice to the customers...

The ride was nice, covered and warm. I saw many other boats that were open and the patrons looked cold! I would get there early as it takes time to check in and then get settled on the boat. I wish there was some narration as didn’t really know what I was looking at and had to constantly ask the waiter as he walked by. The food was average. Good to try once, but no need to repeat. One helpful tip is when you are finished, walk up to the main road to find a taxi. The ones outside the boat try to charge at least double what you should pay!

Well worth the trip. We did the lunch cruise with 5 courses, and wine. The food was very good, and the service was excellent. We upgraded and had the wine, cheese and window seats. The boat was very very nice, and the atmosphere was beautiful. The only complaint is that it was a little hot on the boat in August, but we would highly recommend this river cruise- it is an awesome way to see Paris on the Sienne!

I was able to wow my husband on our second evening in Paris with this dinner cruise! Very romantic and engaging with the major monuments all alight.

Taking a Seine boat cruise is the perfect way to become familiar with the layout of Paris. The tour stops at starts right at the Eiffel tower and our tour was timed to arrive back on time for the top of the hour Eiffel display.

This particular cruise was a seated dinner cruise with wine. It was so elegantly done with light music in the background and impeccable service. I had booked a window seat and it was just for the two of us (there was some lack of clarity when I had made the reservations). The food was very good with four or so options for each of the three courses. It is French food, of course, so I was unfamiliar with one of my choices until they were served. Then I was delighted as they were all beautifully presented and tasty.

I had also read mixed reviews. I noticed several other boat tour companies along the quay and wonder if that's caused some confusion with the reviews . Recognizing that we had one of their top of the line tours certainly helped.

Something I hadn't heard mention is that the layout of our boat was such that the window seats sat rather lower than the middle seats. This made for perfect viewing for most of the boat. So having center seats would have been good, as well.

Wonderful experience on board a very modern boat.
Lovely food, generous wine service.
Height of the river made it impossible to see part of Paris, but we were given a full 2 1/2 hour cruise plus free tickets for a sightseeing cruise to be undertaken any time within the next 12 months - the company going that little bit further than expected.

Staff were funny and friendly. Lawrence was our waiter. He took care of multiple tables with personalized service and attention to detail. Food was outstanding, the escargot tart and cream cauliflower salmon appetizers were to die for.
Live entertainment was pleasant, fun and enjoyable. This experience was worth every penny. Paris is magnificent.

Every time we visit Paris we always go on the Bateaux Parisiens Dinner Cruise. This cruise has three levels of service, the least expensive essentially being in the centre of the boat, the next being on the two sides of the boat, and the highest level being in the front section of the boat. Over a number of visits we've been in each of the service levels, and the short answer is that each of them is good for what they are. The boat has a glass roof so you'll be able to see things such as the Eiffel Tower lit up from where-ever you are. The food and service we've found to be very good as well. Highly recommended.

We would definitely recommend booking this for the extra money vs the tickets that include the bus/river tour. Much more posh, better food and less of a line. You need to be on time, and be prepared to dress nicer. This isn't the "shorts and jeans crowd". (In general we only saw a couple of people wearing shorts in France..) Getting there a little early helps with seating, but definitely buy the champagne package. I wouldn't waste the money if you are bringing younger children. It is more of a romantic tour.

We booked the privilege service and had a window seat.
The view is nice, but there are five different boats and the photos on the site are of a much luxurious boat from what we were on ( there are five different boats and they charge the same rate for all)
The service was good.
The food is good but not something uncommon in paris ( not gourmet)

I don't think that the rate is worth it, and should be different according to the boat.
The photos are misleading
Dress code is excessive ( this is to make you believe it is luxurious), this is not as fancy as they are leading you to believe

It was a rainy night in Parish. We did the 6.15 dinner. River was high so the boat did only 1/2 the route to the south side only.
Company was accommodating and gave us free tickets for the simple river ride for next day. Nice gesture.
Our waitor was good and attentive.
The picture people were there but we did not feel pressured to buy.
The food was "interesting " and "different ". I use these terms cause we did not like it. But when it comes to French cuisine and personal preference, things are different anyway.
Even though weather was not the best and the price was borderline high we still enjoyed the experience.

An absolute must when in Paris! I booked the privilege option. When we arrive we were on a table of two by the window with wine in a cooler next to us. The waiters are great and the live singer was fabulous. The views only the Seine are great and seeing it all lit up at night was incredible. The food was tasty and options for most palates. I would definitely recommend

This was our Granddaughter’s first trip to Paris and we wanted her to experience the Seine with a dinner cruise. We had the best experience, from making reservations to the best culinary delight of the trip! Everyone was so gracious & courteous & made us feel so special. Thank you for the memories!

We completely enjoyed this boat cruise. I had a bit of trepidation even though it got good reviews as sometimes boat cruises can be cheesy and mediocre food. This was a lovely evening. We booked the “ privilege service” as we were a party of 4 and we didn’t want to be seated with anyone else. Also, we were at the very front of the boat. There is another more expensive level but we were at the very front of the boat so I think no one selected that level. Also, the lower levels were supposed to set people in groups up to 10 but I noticed that each group seemed to have their own table so maybe due to COVID they are spacing people out. The food was very good, the cheese and the desert were my favorite. My sea bass was also good as was the beef that others had for the entree. There was more than enough champagne, wine and water . The ambience was lovely and the view of the key sights along the Seine were great. The staff was friendly and accommodating. We were very glad to have taken a chance on this tour, it was a lovely evening,

Our tour opertaor had booked us for the dinner cruise, and although it was raining it was extremely enchanting.

Once you had your boarding pass you were permitted through to the waiting lounge.

You receive your menu when you get your boarding pass, and you have an extensive choice of amazing fine dining dishes, which my husband absolutely loved and I unfortunately could not eat as I am a fussy eater.

The stewards on board were well trained, professional and served well.

The live musician was very good, but the singer was exceptional, I would pay to see him in concert he had such an awesome voice!

Although the river was a little rough, the cruiser was so well skippered that one did not even notice.

The cruise seemed quite long, although they said it was shortened for river levels, which in a way I was grateful as we managed to catch a last bus to our hotel and if we missed it then we would have had to walk.

Really enjoyed it!

A wonderful experience,seeing the sights of Paris and enjoying a magnificent dinner with live music. We departed at 8:30 pm and had a view from the front of the boat. Purchase premiere tickets and the views will be extraordinary. Highly recommend.

This was my second time and my 16yr old daughters first trip. The boat ride was nice and it was a beautiful evening but the boat is completely enclosed. The food was terrible and the service for the two of us was extremely slow. Not worth the money.

We loved our experience, the service was amazing and the food was delicious. The views were also lovely and we returned to the dock just in time to see the Eiffel Tower light show. We did not pay extra for the better view however the view from the middle of the boat was just as incredible. Would definitely go on this cruise again next time we are in Paris!

Nice boat, we had a table for two by window. Very good view of Paris at night, especially beautiful during Christmas time. Was good four course dinner with champagne aperitif, bottle of vine and cognac with desert. The highlight was an excellent duo of musicians (grand piano and violin) with wide range of live music.

Boat cruise provides breathtaking views of Paris along the Seine River. We went at night and Paris is truly the city of lights. The beautiful building architecture and landmarks are accented in the evening. Health pass and vaccination cards were checked. It wasn’t crowded when we went so it felt very safe. I shudder at the thought of a packed boat during these health concerns times.

Very easy to find boarding spot. Simple check in. We were seated quickly. Wonderful server who made sure we had everything we needed. He stopped by regularly and told us about the landmarks we were passing and what was coming up. Only negative was that the seating was a little to tight and the ship was a bit to warm. Otherwise it was a wonderful experience.

We absolutely loved our night time dinner river cruise. We only got the Etoile tickets and don’t think you need to pay any more. We had great seats, the waiters were extremely friendly and hard working. Unexpectedly we got a drink on arrival and then we also had half a bottle each of wine which we didn’t expect.
The food wasn’t amazing but the rest of the experience 100% made up for it.

The cruise is fine and the food and wine ok but nothing special. The reason for the poor rating is that they stole our money. We accidentally made a duplicate reservation and was promised no problems getting a refund by several representatives but the actual request has been ignored. I’m now disputing the charge with my credit card company. Very disappointing.

Ok, maybe more than once in a lifetime. I went on this dinner cruise a quarter of a century ago by myself. For 25 years I have described it’s as the most amazing evening of my life even though I went solo.

Fast forward 25 years. I am in Paris with a wonderful friend and date. We are scheduled to do to dinner on the cruise our last night in Paris. I paid extra for a private table alongside a window. I have to tell you, I was apprehensive because after 25 years of hyping the last time I went, I was afraid it would fall short. It not only did not fall short, but as I had hoped, sharing the experience only made it better.

The service was great. Better than great... over the moon outstanding. The pace was excellent. The live music was excellent. There really wasn't room for a dance floor, but we stood up and danced in an aisleway. The food was excellent. The wine was excellent. The cruise and site seeing was amazing. It could not have been any better.

Thank you Bateaux Parisiens for a most memorable evening!

I suppose my expectation was a bit much. Food was very mediocre or below. I actually had instant terrible stomachache right after so I spent latter part of the trip In the bathroom. One of the bread distributed was hard as a rock like stale yesterday's bread. Our serving staff, he was great and so was others. However, I do not recommend this over priced dinner cruise to anyone nevertheless friends and family. Just do the regular cruise without food and go to a nice restaurant within Paris instead. Not worth it for both my mom and myself.

We did the evening dinner cruise and it was superb
Fantastic views, service was attentive and the food was beautiful. If your going to treat yourself in Paris this is well worth the cost and you won't regret it. However if you have kids/babies please leave them at home we don't need to hear them cry when the rest of the boat is enjoying the romantic ambience.

Booked the Etoile 8.30 dinner service for 2. We expected to be seated at a table with other people but we were given an intimate table for 2 which was great.We still had amazing views even though we werent seated directly at the window. The service from our waiter was extremely friendly and attentive, nothing was too much trouble. The menu was delicious, the choice was good and I'm sure we were given more wine than the deal included! Subdued lighting, a live band and easy listening singer added to the charm. A photographer was taking photos around the cruise, he was charming and in no way pushy, good job as the photos were 20 euros each! Something I would definitely do again.

We chose the top price premier option - it did not disappoint. The cruise and views of Paris, by day and night are sensational. From the time we were greeted on board and seated with champagne, until dessert, the entire meal was an exceptional experience.

The tour was well paced to see all the sights of Paris at the best times, especially the Eiffel Tower lit up at night. The food was good, and service was excellent. The wine was also plentiful.
The entertainment was fabulous. The singer was excellent and even came to our table, the only one on one side of the ship to sing to our group personally.
We had a great time and a beautiful overview of Paris on our first night in the city.

Overall a really fun experience, we purchased the etoile package and we were seated in the middle aisle of the boat. If there’s another tier that assures being next to the window, your pics of all the sights won’t have some random couple trying to enjoy their own experience in your photo frame.
The food was decent. Impressive really if you think how swiftly they must serve an entire boat all at the same time. I’d call it decent wedding catering quality.
