My only real annoyance was the overhead running light over our tables was turned all the way up. It was blinding. It also caused a glare against the windows at night which then shows up in all of your pics… (along with the couples seated in front of them, but again, that’s a little different.)
I did eventually request that they dim them… other areas of the boat were lit less aggressively. they eventually did with about 25 min left in the cruise but the majority of the evening, it was really bothersome. It wasn’t a safety issue, so I’m assuming someone just accidentally rammed the dimmer all the way up. A little thing but the devil is in the details, or in this case, the mood lighting.
Overall tho they do a good job.

What was my favourite part of the experience? EVERYTHING!!!
I was a birthday to remember. Very friendly staff, delightful music , delicious gourmet dinner, views...oh, the views, as the sun is setting, absolutely stunning. My daughters loved to be on the deck and admire all the nice buildings, following the map that was given to us when we checked-in, and especially wave at the people that were relaxing next to the Siene. We had a really lovely time and the photographer on board made sure we have a photo to remember this amazing night. We closed our cruise with the most beautiful view, light-up Eiffel tower and Statue of Liberty. And of course with cheering music and sparklers to make my birthday even more special.
Loved it and I will definitely do it again on the next visit.

My husband and I were here for our fifth wedding anniversary and we enjoyed every single minute of it. I got the fish and it was surprisingly good. The view with really beautiful, and the singer she was so good she sounded like something from the soundtrack. Overall, I strongly recommend everyone to come and give it a try.

Good, not great views of Paris landmarks near the Seine, especially after dark. Disappointed in the seating and site lines. The online booking info and marketing material claimed all seating had unobstructed views provided by the glass ceiling on the boats. Appears to be true on some of the boats, but not the boat we were on. Our boat had a solid, opaque ceiling. So, if you didn’t have window seating, you did not have unobstructed views. I would suggest making sure to book window seating, or make sure you get on a glass ceiling boat if you want to be sure of unobstructed views. The meal was decent, if not memorable. Overall it was a relaxing and romantic experience.

We had wanted to take a boat ride on the Siene. At first we were not sure if we wanted to do it as the boat doesn't get back till 11:00. No worries. Book way in advance of your trip. Usually the Privilege service sells out first. What it does is give you more choices on food, wine and a window seat. If this is a one time visit why not spend a little more. The docks are not near any metro lines. So you will have to do some walking if you do that. Not so great late at night. When you get there you first have to check in on another dock I think it's #7. They will look at your online paper work and give you the real tickets. If your early like we were you can sit in a waiting area that is connected to the actual boat your taking. The meals and drinks are good depending on what service you bought. The boat goes by the Eiffel Tower on the hour so you should see it light up at night. When the boat docks you will see Taxis at the end of the road. What we did to avoid waiting when you get off across the parking lot you will see stairs that lead up to the street. When you get to the street you will see a Taxis stand with no wait. If you don't speak French before you leave print the name and address of your hotel and hand it to the driver. Easy as that. Most take cards for payment.

Amazing experience - me and my partner did this in December 2019. We bought the cheapest tickets sad in the middle of the boat and couldn't believe how good the view was from there, so don't worry about getting the cheapest tickets! We did the longer dinner tour and the food was delicious and served with a lot more alcohol than we expected. We can't wait to go back for my partners birthday and do this again with his family. My advice - don't even think twice just book it you won't regret it.

Bateaux parisien is been the best experience for my girlfriend and I in Paris. Starting from the way the whole service, the menu and the itinerary for the excursion was explained to us was very clear. The location was above the stunning, so stylish with an incredible and lovely staff working in there. My girlfriend made my birthday so special and this could have happened just with Bateaux parisien, and i was so impressed when my cake arrived. They put the "birthday" song in background with such a class. We were served by Sebastian, and he is been so great with us as well. And it's not all, their customer service is very top level. We lost a passport on the boat but thanks to them it was found within minutes and my girlfriend and I will never thank them enough for everything for making our trip to Paris unforgettable. I would recommend it 100% to anybody.

Beautiful ship with friendly and knowledgeable staff. Great wondow table with wonderful servers. Perfect singer with appropriate songs for the trip, including New York New York as we passed the Statue to Liberte and a helpful photographer. Uber got us there and with staff assistance got us back to our hotel, First Hotel. Romantic for our honeymoon. Thank you.

Amazing romantic dinner on the Seine. Every detail was perfect. The food and wine pairings were superb. Excellent customer service. A beautiful singer that performed Ave Maria as we passed Notre Dame, New York, New York as we passed the statue of Liberty, etc. Capped it off with sparkling Eiffel Tower and dessert at the stroke of 11 pm. Highly recommend this tour.

Was on a cruise with colleagues. My main course (gluten free) should have matched everyone else’s apart from gnocchi. It arrived after everyone else had eaten and comprised left over vegan ingredients (same as a vegan on the table had been given) and a piece of beef that was inedible it was so badly prepared.
The gluten free desert was then tinned chopped pineapple in a dish.
Only the second time I have ever been served inedible food. Very disappointed.

Privilege experience (window seat) was worth it as clear view of all monuments.
20.30 till 23.00
English menu provided as well as card showing all monuments on route.
Used Metro Bir-Hakeim as boat docked under eiffel tower. Metro runs late in the night.
Dining is exquisite and includes champagne, 2 bottles of wine red and white, water and coffee. Soft music.
Waiter service.
Dining area under glass dome and heated so very comfortable.
Very recommended

We were two couples with our hearts set on this evening cruise. One of the couples was just 10 minutes late due to the horrific traffic stemming from the Tour de France. The staff and captain were not very understanding nor accommodating so the boat left without us. We were given a voucher for tonight’s cruise but not our original private window table. We will be seated in the center of the boat. We were, by the way, not the only group unable to board because they too were waiting for family members who also arrived 10 minutes late. Under the circumstances (Tour de France) we would’ve expected some compassion and more flexibility. Let’s see how things go tonight.

The Siene River Dinner Cruise was a fantastic experience throughout. Checking in was easy, the staff were really friendly and the food was amazing. Our waiter (Boris) was very friendly, chatty and knowledgeable about the sights were sailed past which made the experience enjoyable. There was a live singer on board which made for a nice atmosphere. We paid for a window seat which I would recommend, as you have your own private area with a few other tables and better views of the sights. Couldn’t fault anything about it really.

The dinner was excellent, but the price was high for the experience. In order to really see anything you need to get the most expensive seats. We could see a little but not much. They played really loud 80’s music the entire time, which is ok but not what I expected on a fancy dinner cruise in Paris. I would save some money and walk around the beautiful Seine to see the sights.

Food was delicious! Great value for money. We booked service etpile and it included a sparkling wine upon arrival, mineral water, a bottle of red or white wine, and a 3 course meal!

The boat took around 2.5.hours to go around the river. The meal was served during this time.

Only downside was how long it took for them to serve us in the beginning. But once they got to us it was worth the wait!

Pricy but a fantastic experience. Great great food and excellent wine.
In the menu it was said that two bottles of wine (one for appetizer and one for main course) was to be shared between four people but me and my lady got two bottles for our own.

No regrets paying 179 € per person for the privilege.
Paris sure is beautiful at night.

Good way to spend an evening after a day of walking Paris. The food and wine was good but some of the sights are a little hard to see from the river. A thunder storm with some good lighting flashes made the trip interesting. My wife really enjoyed the evening, which was the goal of the dinner cruise.
Friendly staff, good food and a nice boat ride. All in all a good evening.

I could not reccomend this more. Everything about the experience was perfect, food, service and the cruise itself with beautiful views. Well worth the cost. We also had an issue which ended up with us having a double booking and the reservations team was amazing in helping sort it out and issue a refund. Fantastic customer service 👏

Pros first: The experience was overall quite positive. The boat ride was calm, steady, and was a really nice way to ride on the Seine for dinner. The service was excellent and our waiter was attentive, funny, and nice. The food was overall pretty high quality. The wine was yummy and the views were gorgeous.

For the cons: The pacing of the dinner was pretty poor. We sometimes waited over an hour between different portions of the meal and the bread was unfortunately not what you'd hope for a meal in Paris. The food selection, at least for a vegetarian unfortunately very low (two quinoa dishes for appetizer and entree), which was very disappointing and the entree was quite meh, especially for the cost of the dinner. It was also VERY hot where we were sitting and although the front carriage was cool and well-temperature regulated, where we were sitting was not at all and it felt like we were in a green house for much of the meal. I probably wouldn't recommend this because of the value vs. quality, although it was quite fun for our honeymoon.

There are few times in life when a family can quietly and serenely view the sights of Paris along the Seine River and enjoy a meal that, although not spectacular, was definitely enjoyable.

We traveled to Paris because our son had planned to propose to his girlfriend and, of course, we were delighted when she said, "Yes". Phew!

Our celebration was made that much more lovely on the Bateaux Parisiens because the setting was lovely and quiet. Such serenity was treasured by our family and was so appropriate for the occasion.

Pricey, but aren't lifetime memories worth it?

The Ecolie Seats are good. If desired someone can pay more to be by the window. Due to covid19 there is some spacing between all tables, window tables run length wise, you will not be at same table with someone unless desired. Service was very good.

Ok the boat was awsome the food was really good however the service was terrible. I bought the Premium service which was almost $800 for three. Our server was busy with three large parties on the other side of the boat and had forgot about us. We rushed to finish prior to boarding. All in all it’s a really nice boat ride and the food is good but don’t spring for the expensive package

Pretty much all aspects of this dinner cruise were great except a few. Most parts of the preset menu were good, as well as the time sailing up and down the Seine. Additionally, the service was pretty great. The only cons were: after about 30 minutes it gets pretty hot / humid, so you’re basically trolling down the river in a greenhouse. Entrees weren’t super great. And there were some aggressive bugs on board.

The river is amazing to see and this is a great experience. The singer is entertaining. The food is pretty averss as ge but the worst part is checking in. It is terribly disorganized and the 8:30 departure actually happened around 9:15.

1 star because the view at times was incredible if you could see through the glare and the lights in your eyes. The food….. was honestly the worst I have had in Paris. The tables are so close together you can hardly get through, the girl next to us left to go outside and throw up during dinner. We were not expecting 5 star, but for the money we expected a somewhat decent dinner. The veal was so tough you could hardly cut it, the escargot tart was cold and smelled of rotten cheese, the dessert was the only thing I’d consider decent because I actually ate 1/4 of it but it was still not good. Save your money.

Firstly, Anis you are an amazing waiter! Anis made our night, he was brilliant and funny and had such great energy. Food was fantastic, the setting was brilliant, the live music created a wonderful ambience and I could not fault any part of this. Someone even proposed on the boat, which I know isn’t something the boat planned for us all to see but it just goes to show how romantic of a setting it is. The boat pulled up to re dock just in time for the Eiffel Tower to sparkle at 11pm which was a perfect end to a perfect night. We would be back again if our visit wasn’t so short!

Great experience and def worth the price! Breathtaking views of Paris especially as the sunsets. Being seated was fairly easy, there was onboard entertainment with a great singer, there was a photographer, wine and good food. If you have extra money to spare book a table by the window. There should however be no children allowed on the evening cruises.

100% would recommend this experience to everyone.

Food, wine allocation, live music, service and atmosphere was fantastic. One of the highlights to our trip!

If you are unsure whether or not to upgrade to a window seat, I would highly recommend to do so.

My friends and I booked this experience separately as we were a larger group of 8. I wish that the tour listing would’ve informed us that we wouldn’t be able to sit together unless we all bought the same tier. Besides that the boat and views were amazing! Service was amazing and the live singer was the cherry on top and the food was tasty. Overall a good experience.

My husband and I really enjoyed this dinner cruise for our last night in Paris. Food was excellent and service was good. I had escargot for an appetizer and sea bass with a nice mashed potatoes with turmeric. Our dessert was okay. We were seated in the middle so not great to see the views of the Siene but overall we enjoyed. Also, there was a live singer, she was great.

Great experience. Wait staff was tremendous. Good food and kept the alcohol flowing. We scheduled the Prestige package and although paid for 1 glass of champagne. Server kept my glass full. White wine glass was kept full as well. The bottle of red wine provided to us was more than we could drink.
Great views of Paris along the Seine.
Expensive but very enjoyable

Such a wonderful experience. Highly recommend as a treat for family. Service excellent and food fantastic. Ending at Eiffel Tower when the lights come on is a great finale. If I ever come back to Paris I would do this again.

What a magical way to see Paris! We upgraded to be right by the window of the boat but I don’t think there was a bad seat anywhere! We enjoyed all the food choices and there was always plenty to eat and drink! The staff was very friendly and they pointed out places of interest. The tour is perfectly timed so that when you return you have just finished with dessert and coffee. You catch the boat under the Eiffel Tower which is spectacular at night.

Really beautiful boat and great service. The boats takes you along the River so you see a lot of great sights. Would not recommend as the food is almost unbearably bad. It takes a lot for me to say that. Skip the dinner cruise and take a River cruise on one of the boats instead - there’s too much wonderful food in Paris to waste a meal.

My husband and I did the Premier option and it was really amazing! We had a more private table at the front of the boat with less people, congestion, and the best views from the boat. The food was great! Not the best meal I've ever had but definitely really good. Service was fun and the music was great. We docked by 11p and got to see the Eiffel Tower light up! Definitely a pricey excursion but worth it if you're looking to have a fancy evening and see so much of Paris without stress!

We had the 18:15 dinner serving which in January, was dark by the time we left, meaning we got to see everything lit up. The boat itself is beautiful and the staff are very attentive. Smooth ride and very comfortable. Amazing view with the glass walls and ceiling (we had a window seat). However the food is average, especially considering the price paid. The menu was limited and if I were a fussy eater I would struggle to find anything to choose, however the food was well presented and was nice. What really makes this experience great is the boat itself and the views from it.

Amazing experience! My wife and I were so happy that we did this tour, it was a great meal and fun time cruising along the river. There was live entertainment and great views. A must stop in Paris if you are visiting from out of the country.

Good food, lovely atmosphere & superb service.
Would be a 5 star review except for the value for money as the tickets were extremely expensive.

Watch for rip off taxi drivers waiting at the end and trying for triple fares+ off the meter!!

I surprised my wife with this dinner cruise while on our honeymoon. It was absolutely worth it. The food and service were incredible. The cruise lasted a little over an hour and you’re able to see all of the major sights along the Seine. They even provide a small map highlighting the landmarks you’ll pass by. Definitely worth it and highly recommended!

Food was great! Service was great! We were a group of 8 with 2 young children, a teen, and 5 adults. We celebrated the 10th birthday of one of the kids. Everyone enjoyed the cruise! The boat had a glass roof. We were seated in the middle but could still see the view! Highly recommend!

We were a party of three adults and were seated at our own table next to a window. (our tickets were for the Privilege Service) The check in process was easy and we were warmly welcomed by the staff. The dinner was very good (I had the guinea fowl) and the alcohol was plentiful. The wait staff was very busy but our service did not suffer. There was a singer on board which added to the ambiance. The views of Paris, at night, were wonderful! Highly recommend.

I was looking so forward to this. I will start with the view was beautiful, the design and decor of restaurant was lovely. Service was great, the food was absolutely terrible. We left mid meal during the main course, it was that bad. I guess I had at least an expectation that the food would be decent being a 3 star chef. If you want the bucket list view then go for it, but way too pricey for poor quality food.
Great cruise on the River Seine. Superb meal. I highly recommend this tour. The crew treated us as royalty and the view from the river showed a view of Paris we’ll remember for some time.

We were excited with cruise dinner and it was our first time in Paris.

After getting there we was informed that boat has some tech issues and it will not go for cruise but the dinner will be held.

The good thing was the view we get closer to the windows, that why giving 2 star not zero.

Also food was okay, but could be better when paying 100 euro for each person.

Really wonderful experience - a highlight of our trip. And I was totally surprised that the food was really excellent, too! We were there with our granddaughter, age 10, who dressed up for the experience and had her magical night out in Paris, with all expectations met and surpassed.
It is late for dinner for Americans, but totally worth the wait. The experience as the sun set and the lights began to twinkle all over Paris - perfect!

My wife and I did the dinner cruise VIP tour and it was phenomenal. Service and food were surprisingly good. Very romantic and memorable. One of the highlights of the trip to Paris. The VIP is definitely worth the extra money if you can afford it. Highly recommended!!

Need to add more staff. It takes an hour to served every course. We started well with polite waiter, then we have to wait for an hour just to get our starters… then another hour for the main course… then another hour for the desserts…
Before that the guy in the entrance when approaching the resto, He said it’s only for reservation.. And when i said yes, we have a reservation, he replied rudely “ are you sure”… not a good start for our dinner cruise. Not coming back again for sure…
The supervisor tho is friendly, I think his name is Ben.

Excellent view and service but food could be better. My husband and I purchased the guaranteed window seating and the views were beautiful. At the end of the boat ride we got off right when the Eiffel Tower was sparkling, it was perfect. I wish we enjoyed the food more.

Normally I don't write reviews but I feel the need to counteract a few negative reviews I read about not being able to find the boat or getting the wrong table. First, you have to be blind to miss the boat. There's a huge sign . . . not to mention a HUGE BOAT exactly at the address given. Second, the table (like everything else) was exactly as advertised. We got the premier package and was sat at a round table in front. End of story. One last thing that wasn't entirely clear, but actually a good thing--they give you TWO bottles of wine. I thought we would have to pick either a red OR a white bottle, but you actually get both red and white bottles, plus champagne. Turns out the flask of whiskey I brought was unnecessary.

The lunch cruise was an excellent break from walking. We had the premiere package. The food and wine were all delicious. We enjoyed seeing Paris from the river. It is an excellent way to see the wide varied architecture of the city (good and bad). Be warned: it will get hot sitting at window seat on a warm, sunny day.

The cruise was very nice. However, the food wasn’t as nice as the scenery and the atmosphere. I had roast ducking for the dinner. It wasn’t good. I asked the manager if I could have something else. He said I would have to pay additional 20 Euros.

I think lunch is a good option to save money and see the good view around the river. Unfortunately, our route was changed to opposite due to the high water level. But it is still fun and the food are good. Relax and enjoy.

Was very disappointed to say the least. It got cancelled due to the river flooding which wouldn’t have been an issue because I totally understand things like that happen. Unfortunately they did not notify us or anyone else that was attending this dinner before we got there. Also still waiting for our money back.

This was not what we expected. We got the boat and the menu was all seafood with one option for veal. They had ask if we had dietary needs and we explain no seafood. We left before the boat left. We were not going to spend 3 hours without food.there is reason they don’t post the menu! Buyer beware. I am going to request refund.

This was one of the best experiences I had while in Paris. My husband was so surprised at this (since I planned our entire Paris trip). He LOVED it and so did I. The views were impeccable and the food was good. We paid for window seats and I think if you’re going to do this cruise; pay for those seats. Yes, it’s extra but nothing beats the views you get. If you’re going to Paris…go all out.

My husband would rate the food 8/10 while my dish was 10/10. Waiter forgot our dessert at one point but all is well. Service was still amazing. Go on this!!!

We had a lovely time the food was good but a bit to small portions. I asked for tee instead of coffee but they never came back and i didnt want to make a fuss. Also the AC back where we sat wasnt working (it got hot). But all in all we were very pleased : friendly waiters, fantastic views, good food.

Awesome dinner and tour. Food was very good, entertainment- singer was wonderful. The views, we were by the window in table for 2, were amazing. Our waiters were fun and gave great service- shout out to Laurent and new waiter, Thomas. Highly recommend.

We arrived early to ensure we were on time. Check in was easy and efficient. We were placed in a waiting area until the appointed time. We were ushered to our table and greeted by our waiter. There weee a few that waiters on us and they were delightful. Cracking jokes and again efficient. The entire cruise was a delight and the night of our 2 week excursion. Well done!

This dinner cruise was one of the highlights of my trip to Paris. We had a group of 11 people and had a great table. The boat ocation was easy to find. The food, service and entertainment was good. The view was absolutely amazing. To see some of the attractions at night, lite up was great. If you have the time defientely put this dinner cruise on your itinerary.

We had been told by a friend this was a great experience so we booked. Mistake. We don’t drink, so maybe the food tastes better if you have had a few drinks. But I am still trying not to throw up thinking about the food I ate last night. Awful. Also, it’s painfully long. The lady next to us actually fell asleep. 💤 The views were really nice, of course, but you won’t get any pictures sitting inside due to the windows reflection. Going outside was nice but beware of some bad smells.
It’s Paris so it is lovely.

Last weekend we enjoyed this evening cruise to celebrate a birthday. From start to finish it was excellent, staff very attentive, food good and the views superb as well as the female singer. Well worth booking !

We had a fabulous evening. Once we bit the bullet and accepted it’s not cheap we didn’t look back. The food was first class and exceeded our expectations. The bread and wine flowed, they didn’t scrimp and scrape. The live music was perfect. A truly enjoyable evening that I’d recommend

Went with the “privilege” experience. It was the middle cost of three options. Very good food and the live music (a female singer) was amazing. The views were very nice. It is an expensive tour but worth it.

The food was delightful and each plate was a work of art. The half smoked salmon appetizer was something I could have eaten all evening — forget about the other courses.

I require a gluten-free diet (and was half expecting to not have anything to eat. I was pleasantly surprised to find delicious choices on the menu that met my dietary restrictions.

And our waiter was fabulous.

This was not the experience I expected. The whole evening including the boat trip was only an hour long. They started the appetizer before we left the dock and the menu was limited and over the top; no steak, chicken or pasta options. The boat ride itself was very short. We didn’t even make it down to Notre Dame. It was not guided. There wasn’t even a print out of the sites. But the final nail in the coffin was we were served dessert when we hit the dock which simultaneously corresponded with the toilet cleaning which unleashed a vile stench. Suffice it to say, we were disappointed as we were unceremoniously kicked to the curb. The best part of the trip was the hearty crying laugh we experienced at the outrageous tourist trap we fell into.

Full disclosure, we were not drinking which may have provided more enjoyment.

Great live music, song choices, amazing food. Dessert was nothing too special. Views were very nice at night.Got a nice view of the Eiffle tower and the tops of the rest of the attractions. I got the Foie Gras and Lamb Rump.

What a wonderful way to view the City of Lights. The food was mediocre, which is what should be expected from a river cruise meal. The singer/ entertainment was phenomenal. We were very impressed with him.
The service was good. A little slow, but again, you're on a river cruise, not a Michelin rated restaurant. Do not expect a fine dining experience, you will be disappointed. Go for the views and you will leave pleased.

The dinner was nice and the service was good. We surprisingly got a full bottle of wine to share between the two of us. which was nice. The boat is good but the reflection off the windows makes it super difficult to see anything. It would’ve been nice to have a little bit of a heads up when we were passing things - but I guess I would’ve have been able to see it anyway due to the reflection and obstructed views. For the cost I didn’t think the whole experience was worth it.

From reservations to boarding the process simple and worked excellently.
The staff was well trained and experienced. One felt right at home. The meal was out of this world. Everything matched perfectly. Can only recommend to book the cruise

We thoroughly enjoyed our dinner cruise and I found it to be well worth the cost. We paid extra for a table by the window, which I highly recommend. The higher tier ticket offered perks such as upgraded champagne and wine with generous servings. Food and service were both good.

The whole experience was beautiful. I cannot praise it enough. Excellent food, drink, live entertainment, waiters and very comfortable boat. Air con was fantastic break from the heat. I never do reviews but had to with this. Made me cry was so stunning, the atmosphere, scenery and service. Do not miss the chance to do this. It is the best night in Paris ever!

Absolutely amazing time. Wait staff was tremendous. We had a bonus singer on board to create ambiance and just an amazing way to see the city, cruising the Seine while having a lovely meal with my lovely companion.

Our farewell to Paris evening cruise on the Seine was magical. Pay the extra for the better wine and window seats. The wait staff is attentive and stops by to alert you to what you are seeing. The cruise is of course timed to arrive back at the Eiffel Tower for the light show at 10:00. The food is average but that is not why you take the cruise.
Table are reserved so no need to rush onto the boat. However, I suggest as the boat approaches port you spring from your seat to get near the door to catch a cab on the dock.

The food was terrible, the waiter was always in such a hurry that it made us feel like we needed to hurry. Made us order our food 2 min after our arrival. There were no live music, and then there was this camera man who took pictures of everyone during dinner..
Overall not worth the amount of money.

My partner and I had pre-booked this for our trip to Paris.

Lovely boat, friendly staff and brilliant table service. Food was just ok, starter was fine, I had the veal for main course (never had it before) was extremely tough and chewy, I always assumed veal was supposed to be tender maybe this is not the case. Dessert was fine, wines and champagne where lovely.

But the experience was still fantastic. Brilliant sightseeing cruise, we paid extra for the privilege service, which gets you a table beside the window. Personally it was worth it.

If the food was better we would be giving it a 5* rating instead of a 3*

My husband arranged this dinner cruise for my birthday. WOW! What a lovely experience! It’s our first time visiting Paris and the cruise was our first activity. Excellent way to see the Eiffel Tower, louvre, Notre dame, and other notable monuments, along with an excellent multi course meal, 2 champagnes, and both red and white wine. Get the premiere package…WELL WORTH the cost.

The food was outstanding. Loved that even though we had some wine included with our tickets, we were able to choose from another small menu for additional bottles. The live singer was a wonderful touch. We got to see some beautiful sights and had a great time doing it! The only downside, we chose a photo from the photographer’s options at the end of the boat ride, I was thinking of getting another one, but it’s been a week and they still haven’t been uploaded to the website. The impression he gave us was that they would be uploaded within a couple days.

Book a boat trip along the Seine and enjoy views of the grand buildings of Paris.
Go on the top deck for the best photo's and different perspectives of Notre Dam.

The three course dinner was fine and the wine was even better.

Eiffel tower, bridges and much more. Do an evening trip like we did and see Paris by night all lit up especially the tower.

View lots of bands and people picnicking on the river banks.

Excellent photo opportunities. Don't miss this one.

Food was garbage. This cruise was a total scam. The duck tasted like cat food. I spent $306 US dollars for two people. I would have rather gone to a Michelin star restaurant for that price. Money not well spent. I was surprised it said on trip advisor likely to sell out. Spend your hard earned money elsewhere!!!

The Seine dinner boat cruise was a wonderful experience. Cruising along the Seine, enjoying the sights and the incredible dinner. Our waiter was fantastic at making sure we were aware of each sight, explaining the significance. The food choices were wonderful, the food itself amazing. We would definitely recommend this experience to others.

The evening was excellent and far exceeded our expectations! Beautiful boat, wonderful service, excellent food and wine, the woman singer was amazing and set the mood and of course the views. Highly recommend. We had a window seat for two that was well worth the cost!! Thank you. We had so much fun.

One of the best parts of our trip to Paris. The staff made the whole experience so enjoyable and we felt so well looked after. The food and drinks were lovely and the live singer was fantastic! Completely worth the money - a really unforgettable experience.

My wife and I had a blast! It was my birthday gift for my wife and Bateaux Parisiene didn’t disappoint. We loved every bit of our experience there. It made her night extra special and mine too. It was amazing! Thank you, Bateaux Parisiene!🥰😍 Highly recommended!😊

Booked the Premier package for this river cruise and was not disappointed.
Window table for just the two of us.
Champagne upon arrival and great bottle of Chardonnay for the meal.
Menu and food was great as was the service.
Amazing live singer.
Alighted just in time to get a selfie with a twinkling Eiffel Tower as a backdrop.

My meal was good - my wife's not so good. The waiter had too many tables - we had fair service. I had to ask three times for butter - it took one hour to get some. Over priced for what you got. Better off having dinner before and take a cruise only with narration. No narration of the sites on this cruise.

This is the third time I have taken this cruise while visiting Paris and it does not disappoint. The food & service is good but the views along the Seine river are what make this dinner cruise special. The entertainment on board is also nice.
This is a must do on your list for the city of light.

This was a first class experience, my wife and I did the Premier for our anniversary. The staff was excellent, food was good and great wine. Was really pleased with the whole experience. Highly recommend the dinner for families or couples. Thanks.

I booked the dinner cruise because it sounded like a romantic way to spend an evening. Neither of us found the experience to be romantic at all even though nothing went wrong. This is not a guided tour. There are no stops and there is no commentary. It's just a boat ride and dinner. The Eiffel Tower looks great illuminated in the evening but nothing else is particular exciting. The food was fine except the bread was quite hard.

The views were lovely, the live singer was charming, and the ambiance was great too. The one thing I will warn agains is that even though we got an English menu option, our waiter did not speak English well enough to know what veal was when we ordered off it, resulting in the wrong dish being brought out and a long exchange to explain what we did order. You may be better off using the French menu alongside google to avoid the miscommunication.

Decent food. The brazilian couple we met along this tour really made the experience. This is one of the standard "tourist traps" that local Parisiennes tend to roll their eyes at but overall it was a nice meal and great way to see the landmarks. The seating is very tight amd the meals are okay.

The experience was very enjoyable. The food was great and the service was fair considering the number of people aboard. You are seated close to other people but not too close. I would also like to point out that the boat has a glass canopy that allows you to see the sights along the Seine really well regardless of where you are seated at. If you want to spend the extra money for a seat right by the window that is up to you but I personally don't see the need considering there is not that much of a difference. A single bottle of wine comes with your meal. There is also a terrace at the stern (back of the boat) that allows you to go outside. It is a small area but is definitely worth checking out. All in all, my date and I had a great time and I would gladly do it again. If you're looking for something romantic to do in Paris, this is what you should do. Hands down!

I can’t say enough good things about this experience. The setting and food were amazing! A lot more was included than I expected. It was a great way to see the sights on our first night before having the opportunity to explore later in the week.

Did the 8:30 dinner cruise. Overall okay experience. The service was lacking. Waited and waited to get refills on our wine. The food was okay but not great. I would suggest doing the three course meal. It’s not worth doing the more expensive package.

Wow this was an amazing dinner and sightseeing cruise. Much more than we expected. Please note the dress code is enforced. The food was some of the best that we had while in Paris. We were grateful that we had seats by the windows and scenery of the city. This Dinner cruise is a must do while exploring Paris!

A romantic evening with beautiful views and good food! Service was a little slow and it was unclear what drinks we were entitled to with the Etoile choice and when, but otherwise it was a lovely experience. The singer was fabulous and really added to the ambience. I’d definitely recommend.

It is like a very Romantic movie watching to sit on dock and have a panoramic view of sightseeings. The bateaux is quite on time. We took only Seine river cruise and it was about an hour. I recommend a departure before sundown! You will almost see most of the highlights in Seine side from different view. Better to go out top on the dock and get a seats in front.

The actual boat trip and fab food. easy access to the boat. nice sailing up the river seine. great atmosphere and very professional staff and waiters and waitresses. beautiful night and got to see the lit up Eiffel Tower as part of the night.
This is one perfect way to enjoy Paris with your significant other. Boarding on the Port next to the Eiffel Tower was easy. Pleasant ambience with music and a very nice dinner. Well worth it.

Amazing experience. Perfect for your first night in Paris. We had great views of famous sights on the Sienne. The food was great and the service was very nice. Also had live singing which was really good too.

Food and service were excellent. Live singer was a lovely touch. Extremely well organised and menu card and route card were nice. The boat is very nicely kept, clean and table settings are beautiful. It is expensive, but does feel special. Only improvement would be to announce the different sights as you approach them, as in the dark and distracted by good food and wine, they are easily missed and it is part of the reason for the trip.

I have taken this cruise 2x. First by myself 25 years ago or more. And then again last night. It is hard to explain what an amazing and wonderful and romantic cruise this is in words. The meal is very good. The service was amazing. The venue and music wonderful. The sights at night were breathtaking. Individually great. All together in paralleled. Spend the money and go. It is a once... or twice in a lifetime event and memory!

Great food. Great service. Fun experience. Beautiful boat. I would go again in a minute. My daughter and her husband planned the whole trip. We were in Paris for about 15 days. This was one of the highlights of the trip for sure.

Service was really good, food was good as well. Check in good. Boat ok, a little dated other boats in area all glass better viewing. Staff could have been more forthcoming about fire in engine room. Had to change boats. Had to finish meal in the dark, emergency lighting.but all in all , nice experience. Would have been nice if management apologized for issue.

This was a memorable evening cruise down the Seine and a fantastic way to get a different look at Paris at night. The staff on the boat were great and very welcoming.
Regarding the food - the starters were okay, the main meal was very good and the desert was delicious.

Great experience. Boat was beautiful and clean. Staff professional and friendly. Dinner and entertainment (lounge singer) was excellent. Enjoyed the meal, service and sights. Plenty of wine. Convenient location. Recommend.

We enjoyed a wonderful dinner cruise, seeing the sights of Paris whilst eating a delicious meal. Great choice of food and delightful live music made this the perfect evening with good friends. Highly recommend this experience

Our favourite part of our perfect weekend in Paris. It rounded our day off beautifully. The staff were so polite and courteous. Nothing was too much trouble. The food was amazing and the views from the boat were fantastic. Definitely a must if visiting Paris. Karen

This was a neat experience. I would go for more of the scenic fun ride/view than seeing the monuments. Hard to see most of them from the boat, but it was a fun night and great atmosphere. The singer was amazing! The food was good. Little pricey, but we enjoyed ourselves. Make sure you pick what you specifically want as you cannot add anything (cheese/wine)

Our table had an excellent view of the sights. We had Kir before dinner and a bottle of wine with an excellent dinner. Very good service and beautiful views of Paris and the Eiffel tower. I highly recommend the Etoile package.
Incredible! Once in a life time. Worth every penny. Food and wine exceptional. Staff wonderful. View and experience priceless. Definitely recommend the evening experience to see the lights of Paris.

We had a great time at dinner. The views were amazing and the atmosphere was very cool. The portions of food aren’t very big, but everything we had was delicious. It seems pretty common for portions to be smaller when out for fine dining in some parts of Paris. We were a little confused on what drinks were part of the package and what was extra, but the staff answered any questions we had. The service was excellent. It’s more on the touristy side, but it’s still a good time.

The view and seeing the city this way was 5 stars. I really enjoyed the experience overall. It was beautiful to look out of the boat and going past many of the most well known spots in Paris. I liked how we were able to get up and go to the back of the boat to take pictures. The service was good as well. Although the reason the review is four stars because I didn't particularly enjoy the food. I don't enjoy small portioned type of foods.

The staff were incredibly friendly and the experience of gently cruising down the river seine is something we’ll never forget. My girlfriend was almost crying with happiness. Sebastian was a great server and the singers were great!

Excellent unique expérience! C'était magnifique! Staff were so attentive, making sure you had the best experience possible. The food was very nice (much better than some of the reviews I read before I went). Wonderful live music.
We went to celebrate my mums 70th and she loved it. It’s not just for couples but for any group big or small.

This was our highlight of seeing Paris... beautiful night tour along the river. The atmosphere on the boat was wonderful... the music, the service, decor, etc. only downside was the food. I’m not overly picky, but the food wasn’t that great. We didn’t eat much of it. I had a suspicion the food would be sub par as I read previous reviews. But the sights and atmosphere made up for the food.

Cruise was very good. Took the 8:30pm cruise. Would have classified as excellent. However the duck was tough and Baked Alaska was not good. The sights at night made the cruise. Service was also very good.

We’ve done this trip a number of times. It is always worth it. Stunning views of Paris by the Seine, a great atmosphere, good food and drinks, and everybody get a pretty good view of it all. You can also go outside whenever you want and this is a real highlight of any trip to Paris and it doesn’t cost an arm and a leg.

This boat cruise was phenomenal! Food was great, service was great and so was the atmosphere. Myself and my friends enjoyed every bit of this cruise. Staff was very informative on the architecture and history of Paris as we sailed along the seine river.

We did the 8pm dinner on the boat, Onyx. The dim lighting was perfect, the wait staff was quck and courteous. The music, food and wine was great. We sat at the window, so we saw everything. Great experience!

After several weeks of not responding to my complaint, I seem it is only fair to express my disappointment in a review in relation to the email I sent and never acknowledged.

I wonder if you will acknowledge me now??

Lead Traveler: Philip XXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Travel Date: Sunday March 18 2018
Supplier Confirmation No: 1335736
Booking Reference: BR-639260905

Hello Sophie,

I have been passed your details in order for me to formally register a complaint and express my complete dissatisfaction with the Seino Vision (Bateaux Parisiens) cruise that my wife and I boarded on March the 18th 2018.

Never in the history of dining out have I been so let down with an experience that was anticipated to be the most romantic and enjoyable birthday cruise, as it was my newlywed wife Samantha's 45th birthday. As one would imagine, I wanted to do something fitting for that milestone and give her a memorable yet romantic experience. It was certainly memorable but by no means in any good sense of the word.

To give a little context...I had only heard good things about Bateaux Parisians and was informed (now misinformed) by several people along with a host of reviews on the internet, of a fantastic dining experience. I now know and have witnessed that this could not have been any further from the truth.

I have never complained or formally written an email/letter about any restaurant at sea or on land, but I am so infuriated and shambolically let down, that I feel obligated to make my thoughts known.

I will bullet point the following areas of concern:

The cruise had departed and after waiting a considerable amount of time for a waiter to attend our table, it became quite clear that we had been forgotten about. This was apparent when all other customers/diners started to receive their food. we hadn't even been offered a beverage.
My wife kindly asked a member of staff "excuse me, sir, do you know who will be our waiter today"? The member of staff rudely retorted " I'm not your waiter"! I only found out this information post cruise, as my wife did not want to upset me. She was right to do so, as if I had been made aware of what had been said on the night, then that particular member of staff would have been screaming for a life jacket whilst being hurled overboard due to my intolerance for rudeness, especially on my wife's birthday.
When our meals finally arrived, I was giving a cold portion of veal, which I could not cut with a butter knife....yes a butter knife that was supplied to me on board.....and yes I was only given a butter knife to cut tough meat that was full of tendon and fat).
Never mind we thought, onwards and upwards, a stiff upper lip and all that jazz...However...
My wife was given sea bass that smelt and tasted extremely fishy. If you know anything about most fish, especially sea bass, it should not taste or smell like this. My wife also reassured me of this (and she would know as one of Germanys leading cookbook authors).
I was then offered an alternative meal to the veal to which the dish came with mashed potatoe on the side that had been either reheated, microwaved or made from a powder form. Embarrassing and not fit for human consumption.
The wine supplied, especially the white was acidic, cheap and downright nasty. We put this down after one sip.
Lastly and I'll cut to the chase (with a steak knife, not a butter knife) the bread was stale!
I think you can ascertain at this point that my wife and I are extremely dissatisfied. Especially seeing how I flew her to Paris from the United States for her birthday, only to be let down by Senio Vision with a dire excuse for food and hospitality on board your vessel.

Imagine how long this complaint might have been if I had a opted for the birthday package, whereby one has the privilege of paying an additional 20 Euros pp for a slice of cake while being sung Happy Birthday? Winner! Thanks but no thanks!!

I do not think I need to reiterate at this stage my utter disenchantment of the whole experience and would have been better off purchasing a happy meal from Mcdonalds and consumed my fries while rowing down the river on a dingy.

I will conclude this email by clearly stating that I would appreciate a full reimbursement for this debacle of a cruise experience and will refrain from publically embarrassing the company through a variety of reviews and social media platforms.

I look forward to your swift response on the matter.

Regards,

Philip XXXXXXXXXX

It was not clear which boat we should take. So we had to go ask from one boat to the other.

We came right on time and we were not seated next to the window... They offered the table next to the window to a couple who came before us, maybe because I am asian?....

The waiter asked for our order and I had to review to prevent miscommunication. He stopped me and he said he got it. Later, we were served chicken instead of veal, he came back and muttered he was sure we ordered chicken. When he checked the receipt, he ticked veal. He did not say sorry... The boat was not full, yet it takes time for him to re-fill our glasses with wine. He did so just twice! Good thing the bottles were just behind me so we just helped ourselves.

The whole experience was just roughly an hour or so? I did not enjoy the ride and the veal we ordered. It was dry. The waiter kept coming back and he did not even ask whether the food was okay or not.

This was my first river cruise in Paris and it exceeded expectations for service, food, atmosphere and, of course, the views! A river cruise really is a great way to unwind after a day walking this beautiful city. I booked the 'service privilege' trip for a group of 3, leaving at 830pm. This service has champagne to start, 4 courses, a bottle of white and red wine to share, guaranteed window seat and relaxing, live music. The boat was elegant and offered almost 360 degree views of the river and sights. The boat was warm and enclosed, although you can walk outside to get even better views/photos of your favourite monuments - Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty, Notre Dame, Pont Alexandre III etc. The cruise itself was about 3 hours and covers a vibrant stretch of the Seine. Even if you have seen the sights, it is lovely to see them lit up at night from the Seine! The service was superb - the waiter spoke multiple languages (we heard English, Italian, German) and was very helpful, quick and funny. We felt well looked after. The website was easy to navigate and clear instructions on where to go, suggest pre-booking at least a week in advance. Suggest diners wear smart casual dinner wear (not jacket and tie necessarily, but advise against jeans and sneakers for this option!!). The boat docks on the same side of the Seine as the Eiffel Tower, and it is very close to the Tower itself which makes it easy to find. The service privilege option was €169 pp, there are lots of options depending on time and budget. Afterwards we got a tuktuk back to the hotel which was a lovely end to the night. The only weird point was the photography - they took a lot of photos and then didn't come back for us to purchase these (not sure the story here)! Overall, I highly recommend and would happily do another cruise with Bateaux Parisiens. This is a great option for a romantic night out in Paris ❤

Bateaux Parisiens Seine River Dinner Cruise

We actually booked this cruise before we booked our hotel. We did it directly with Bateaux Parisiens. Our choice was the 6 course meal and Privilege Service for the 8:30pm departure. This is a 2 ½ hour cruise. This seemed to be the ideal length as there was time to enjoy your meal and not feel rushed and as it is longer there are several additional sights you get to see. Paris at night is special.

Our table was a window table on the port side. It was separated from the bow seating area by a high service bar. This was not so tall that we could not see over but gave us privacy. This table was probably the most intimate on the entire boat. We also could enjoy the live entertainment that was performed in the bow. The food, wine and service were simply great.

A couple of suggestions: First if you are traveling with another couple request two tables for two rather than a single table for four. By doing this everyone will have a seat next to the window to better enjoy the views. The Privilege Service is a better choice than the Premier Service because of the views and the intimacy of your table. The Premier Service is more like a normal restaurant that happens to be on a boat. You are surrounded by other guests and if you are seated at one of the inner tables the views are not great. Bring your camera. Someone will be more than willing to take your picture. The boat photographer’s shots are not all that great and appear to be staged plus the prints cost a small fortune. Finally, if you plan on taking the metro afterwards, do not dally about as shortly after the boat docks the metro will be scheduled to close.

So I'd like to preface this by saying I love traveling and experience new places and cultures and I'm really honestly very easy going and very easy to please. I'm an, "It's the little things" person. So please believe me when I say this was the BIGGEST waste of money ever. I, like you, read all the great reviews about how amazing this dinner cruise was and ignored the negative reviews. BIG MISTAKE. We decided to upgrade to the window seat since it was our first time in Paris, which ended up being about $370 for 2 people. The food was the worst food I've ever eaten in my life, it was inedible. We ordered the filet mignon and it was chewy and we had to spit it out. They gave us a butter knife to cut it which was next to impossible. The bread was stale, the dessert was crumbly and old (Chocolate Passion fruit tart) and nothing had any flavor. It was literally the worst meal I've ever had and we paid almost $400 for it. SAVE YOUR MONEY and go eat at a Michelin star restaurant for that money. You can't even see anything from the boat anyway, even WITH a window seat. This was probably the biggest disappointment of our entire trip, I actually started crying on the boat because I was so upset that we'd spent so much money for such a miserable experience. Take a $20 cruise during the day on the Siene and picnic afterwards. Then go take your $400 and eat a great meal like I suggested. This was overrated and honestly a terrible experience. I never write bad reviews, but this experience was so bad I felt compelled to warn others not to waste their money. The boat was really nice and the service was great so nothing against that. Do this dinner cruise at your own risk. You've been warned. If you've made it this far do splurge on the Fat Tire bike tour of Versaille! That was amazing and I highly recommend. :)

Sorry to report that our Bateaux Parisienes dinner was a $315.80 USD mistake. Our food was served well after those around us had finished eating and their plates had been cleared away. And other dinners were still being served after ours arrived! The food was so sad. Tough veal, watery fish (sea bass?); even the desserts were disappointing. And I was so hopeful!

If you go on this dinner cruise do not pay for premiere seats thinking you will see the sights. The management allows everyone onto the narrow gangway so the premiere seats are sights of the “butts of Paris”. Waiter says it happens every evening. Food is good and wait staff is friendly but I didn’t pay to watch people’s backsides.

I booked this dinner cruise for my husbands very special birthday. We arrived at the cruise and were checked in with very little information.
We sat for 40 minutes then were taken to the wrong table..booked and paid extra for a window seat but sat in middle of boat.
Eventually got our table but no wine or rolls. We got wine after 20 minutes and rolls much later. Orders taken and my husband got someone else’s starter. I got none so ate his whilst waiting for what he actually ordered being served. My husbands starter was vile , no other way to describe it. We both ordered beef which was very rare and chewy beyond belief. I asked the waiter why the beef was so chewy and received no explanation.
Desserts were ok.
I asked our waiter where we were as I wanted to know all the landmarks we were passing but received no explanation of anything at all.
Our waiter was totally disinterested and did not tell us one thing about the cruise or where we were.
He noticed our full food plates being returned to the kitchen but did not ask why.
I have contacted Bateaux Parisiens website several times asking g for a refund as we ate and drank so little but have not received a reply
Regards
Fiona Mowat

I booked the 8:30pm departing boat as a nice romantic evening to spend for my husbands birthday and our anniversary last weekend after being on a tour of the Eiffel Tower. I never thought the food on a river cruise was going to be exactly fine dining but I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food on board. The waiters and service was very good and attentive. Being 8 months pregnant, they even changed some of the dishes for me (no fois gras but more salmon starters, and well cooked meat etc) and nothing was too much for them. We didn't pay for window seats but still had a lovely clear view and also were able to take lots of lovely pictures of the sights as we sailed past. The live entertainment was good and not too overpowering or in your face as the singers walked around the boat. It is easy to find also being right near the Eiffel Tower near pontoon 5-7 and you can see a Bateaux Parisien sign.

Yes, it is expensive and you are paying more for the experience than anything else but out of the other river cruise options available this had the best recommendations to me from locals and others that had been on it, the best menu and the best location. I would definitely recommend this dinner trip as they do take care of you and it was a lovely romantic end to our trip.

Where do I start? Well the food was below average. We thought the boat tour meant that someone would share the highlights and history of the Paris sights. But there was not. Also it felt like you were in a bubble because we were surrounded by glass. In summary it was bad food in a floating bubble. I would not recommend this adventure.

Overall the cruise was not bad. The food was fine, but not great. The entertainment was enjoyable, although sometimes off key. The photographer had you do some poses that were a little awkward, but not uncomfortable. And the views were nice.

But what GROUND MY GEARS was at the end of the cruise, the waiter presented the French women sitting next to us with a cork so that they could take their bottle of wine away with them (the wine in prestige class is great by the way). When I asked for the same, the waiter just shook his head emphatically giving no explanation. His English was good throughout the service, but he seemed to completely lose the ability to converse in any language except for head shaking and did not provide a reason for withholding the cork. At this point, the women sitting next to us started arguing on our behalf (which was really cool of them). The Maitre d' came over and the women continued to lobby for our cause. Alas, we were still unsuccessful and I still do not have a reason for the different treatment beyond that they were French and we are not. When we left I told the Maitre d' that I would be writing a review (because this is my only recourse), so I am following through on that.

P.S. My wife got motion sickness on the boat, so for those who are prone I would spend your money elsewhere.

We had the dinner cruise at 6:15pm, the staff were amazing and we had most of the food served to us before the boat had actually set off which was delicious. Was great to see paris from the canal view at night. You can pay an exta €20 to have a window seat, we didnt do this but felt like we had pretty much the same view for less money, if your going to book just stick to the middle seats and save yourself some money. They have a photographer on board which takes photos of your table, they charge €15 a picture which i think its extortionate! So we happily delclined there photo and took one ourselves. Definitely worh the experince and lovely views.

I booked the most expensive package as it washer wedding anniversary. We had a table for just two of us at the front of the boat with a total panoramic view. Once seated we had a dedicated waiter to serve us. Good quality rose champagne to start. Our meal was simply exquisite I had snails in a Burgundy sauce, my wife had foe gras, we both had beef for our main which was cooked to perfection, cheese and biscuits followed by sweets, we had a good bottle of white wine (Macon Villages) perfectly chilled, a decent bottle of red wine and two further glasses of champagne. We didn't finish all the wine. The entertainment a female singer was excellent. To be honest I could not fault anything with this trip.. Second time we have been on this trip and we will definitely be back. Thank you for making our special night very special.

Loved this boat cruise, the staff were excellent, really nice food and great sights.

Only issue I have is that it states that it is smart causal with no shorts or trainers, so I ensured I travelled with shoes for this boat cruise, bit of a hassle as I was only in Paris for 2 days so packed light. Only to turn up and see about 10 people in trainers, hoodies & tracksuits? Either remove this dress code or do not allow them on bored. It’s unfair that people have to bring shoes for no reason.

The boat itself is alright, the city is beautiful seen from the Seine!
We arrived on the 18:00 cruise, received a menu and chose 3 different courses each - all the food was tasteless, cold, not freshly made, soggy heated vegetables, dishes dried on top, meat with a weird look and consistency, unpleasantly presented!
The worst meal we had in Paris, and overpriced - catch a daytime cruise to see the city and choose a restaurant for dinner! The wine was okey!

We had a dinner cruise and it was just okay. The woman who checked us in was very friendly. but there was a mix-up with our table seating and we were accidentally seated by the window. The manager rudely came over, yelled at the waiter saying we were at the wrong table and didn't pay for the extra service. This was all said in French (which I understand)...he was so not polite and rudely moved us to another table. Did not even smile at us and when we asked if there was a coat check...could not even be bothered to speak.

The waiter was okay, but super hurried and couldn't even spend time to fully answer our questions. We asked for a lemon slices for the water and got half a lemon (not slices...just half a lemon). No map was provided. We did not even completely do the entire circuit.

the food was okay. The poached egg was not runny as is normal for a poached egg, but hard. The veggie main was rather boring.......the views were nice, but I could have rented a kayak and seen them for a cheaper price.

Food not that good, extra €16 each just to be able to sit at the window. A waitress initially quoted us an extra €69 to move to the window but we spoke to one of the hosts so moved and paid €16 each. Service slow to start and then once we had docked we were rushed to leave the boat so that the next seating of diners could board. Personally, wouldn’t recommend this trip. Overpriced and food bland

OMG the food on the cruise was shocking! 5 out of the 10 main meals had to be returned due to raw chicken. Once I’d already eaten several mouthfuls, I realised that something wasn’t quite right, see attached image! The waiters just took them away and tried to replace with another meal, no way, I’ve been put off chicken for life!!! No surprise that I was then up all night with food poisoning and I couldn’t leave the hotel room on the last day of my holiday. No shock that their Customer Services is terrible and no-one coming back to me about a refund. Do not use this company if you want a nice meal on the Seine, try somewhere else!!

Upon being seat at our table, I informed the waiter of my food allergy and its severity, however, during dessert, I was served something that was contaminated. The wait staff and the ship crew’s failed to maintain any semblance of a First Aid kit, moreover, they had almost zero idea how to react to the situation. Instead of trying to help, they simply offered me more wine which I found to be completely unacceptable. Luckily, we were close enough to the end of the cruise that I was able to disembark, but I ended up spending the next 7 hours in the hospital. The night was completely ruined due to a lack of competence which could have been easily avoided. I reached out to the company on multiple occasions to rectify the situation but I have been disregarded for the most part. My request continues to remain at the customer service review, which is unacceptable. It has been almost 3 months.

I booked a cruise with dinner on 18th August 2019 for 5th October 2019, but decided to cancel the trip. The General Terms says you can cancel until 30 days before the cruise booked date. I couldn’t find in the site how to cancel the cruise. So, on 23thAugust, I send an email asking for the cancel and the refund, but until now I had just evasive answers! I want my refund!
My name: Jorge Silva, Reservation number 1407861

We left our hotel before 7pm. Check in was between 7:45 and 8:15. Driver estimated a 20 min trip. Then we hit the traffic created by the closed roads. As it was getting late we jumped out of the taxi at 7:35. A police officer told us it would be a 20 min. walk. We walked/ran and arrived at the dock at 8:13 and were told that we were late and the boat had left. We told them what had happened and the response we got was “It’s Bastille Day” from two managers on the dock. The only option we were given was to take the regular dinner cruise. Our fancy dinner was served in a box: wrap, sandwich, chips, salad and a prepackaged brownie. And the wine? A bottle of water. We were told to dress for this event which we did. We sat on bench seats with unattended children running around jumping on and off the benches. We were sure our “dinner” would end up in our lap. After we did our u turn in the river, we passed the original boat we were to be on. If they left before us, how did it get behind us. Were we hijacked? When we left the boat, there was no means of transportation to return to our hotel. With all the boats on the river for the fireworks I would have expected a line of taxis waiting. We started to walk toward a busy street hoping to hail a cab. This did not happen. Finally, we called an Uber and returned to our hotel at 2:40am not at all happy with our night. We had bought our tickets in September. This was to be the highlight of our trip and we had so looked forward to it. But the beautiful sights from the Seine and spectacular fireworks display will forever be tarnished by the circumstances of the evening. Robert Morris

This is a worthwhile yet overpriced option. We visited Paris during the heat wave, which admittedly made things more challenging for all.
I purchased this cruise in advance, including the privilege service. This guaranteed a window seat for two. Our ticket said that check in would begin at 8:00, with the dinner to star at 8:30. We arrived just prior to 8:00 to find most of the boat already seated. As many others have reported, it is difficult to find the boat needed. Also you are dodging crowds and peddlers to get there. No metro stop is close, and taxis in Paris are few between. It is a lot of walking.
Check in occurs at a building parallel the boats, right against the peer.
Anyhow, we arrived to find a slow moving line in a very hot enclosed holding area. By the time we got to the counter we were soaked with sweat, which is not how you wish to go to a fancy dinner. At the front of the line we were given our ticket, then instructed to turn around, leave this boat, and walk two piers down to another boat. There we were seated at the very back (stern).
The good news is that we had a quiet corner to ourselves. The bad news is that the back corner is where they stack trays of dirty dishes while clearing. Also it is where people enter in and out for the smoking deck. LOTS of smoking in Paris.
The food was fine with the exception of the dinner rolls which were hard as a rock. The food was only fine- definitely not gourmet and certainly not five star. In America it would be comparable to a $30 meal.
It is a fun opportunity to do a dinner cruise on the Seine. I recommend the experience. Just go into it knowing you are overpaying for it. It is a $100 evening and you are paying $400. If you are ok with that, do it.

I dithered over booking this trip as it was expensive, but it actually proved to be very good value for money, as the whole evening was excellent!
The boat was quite hard to find but it is literally at the foot of the Eiffel Tower and we did wait a while to board, which could have been improved had there been a bar to buy a glass of bubbly or other drink to have whilst waiting.
Once aboard however the whole atmosphere was special. The tables were laid beautifully, the staff dressed very professionally and the lighting and decoration were very effective at creating a warm and welcoming ambiance.
The food and wine was very good, the exception was my salmon which was very overcooked and dry. However the manager did offer me another choice and it was dealt with very well. The starters were good, the belly pork really tasty, and all the desserts delicious. The wine was good quality and there was a choice of red or white and an allowance of half bottle per person.
As we had booked the 1815 departure we were a little concerned that it would be very rushed, as we were due to get back at 1930. However, the pace of the boat matched the serving of each course perfectly and it all seemed to go like clockwork, with plenty of time to take photos as well as enjoy the food and wine as the boat cruised along the Seine.
An unforgettable experience and one of our favourites in France.

The dinner service was chaotic, stressful, and a failure. They lost our dinners, and when they finally did bring them they were cold. They made us replacements which we did not get until the cruise was almost over. The waitress actually cried at our table she was so stressed out about the problems she was experiencing. This is something I have never experienced before.
The manager said they would give us a refund, but having contacted customer service we have not received any response.
There is no way I would recommend this company.

We were recommended the dinner cruise by a friend and we booked it more than a month in advance as we were very excited.

However when we got there, we were rushed in and told to quickly keep moving. We were also told that we were not going to do the cruise through the city, but rather head the other way outside the city. Their only compensation was a ticket another time. This was no use to us as we were leaving the next day.

Whilst the overall atmosphere was nice, the live music was pretty disappointing.

However the most disastrous part of this experience was the food poisoning I unfortunately got struck down with. I did write an email to them to give them a chance to respond but no one had the curtesy to respond.

I expected so much more for the price we paid- which was over £300!!!!

My husband and I were on holiday and were referred to this dinner cruise. I was in Paris in April and enjoyed a dinner cruise from another company and was advised that this one would be even better.

I travel abroad frequently and this was one of the worst experiences I ever had! I included a top 9 list below:

1. Our table had a short leg; which cause my husband's champagne to spill all over the table. The server covered up the spill and never offered to move us to another table replace the linens.

2. Our server forgot to take our order. not just our order.. there were 5/6 tables who did not have their order taken. The result; tables received main dishes before appetizers; wine after meals etc.

3. Worst bread in Paris. Paris is known for wonderful breads and pastries. This bread was so hard; it should have been used to steady our wobbly table.

4. We paid 300 euro for 2 people; but the menu was the same whether you paid 155/ person or 88/ person.

5. The manager on the boat did nothing to address our issues

6. The food was mediocre at best

7. During the trip; I was so upset , I began to quietly cry. The server quickly appeared; and ushered me to the top of the boat ... outside, where no one Is supposed to be (I am sure for safety reasons). When I realized what was happening I quickly return to my husband at the table.

8. Neither the server nor the manager apologized

9. The serving team on the boat only spoke English; or pretended to not understand what I was saying. This is less of a complaint; and more of a note. If you speak anything other than French; and you need help; you are on your own on this cruise.

Save your money and sight see, take the Eurostar to London, do anything but take this cruise.

We were in Paris only for 2 days and wanted to see it lighted.
This cruise is great! No need to book a window seat ( the middle one offers also great view!)
The service, the food and the general experience were amazing!

We had booked the evening dinner cruise months ago for our short weekend break to Paris via Viator (tripadvisor company). Arrived in Paris and jumped in a cab to check in to the cruise. Unfortunately when we showed up we were turned away by a security guard saying that it had been cancelled due to water levels. I get that these things happen and are unforeseen. However, there had been no notification via email/text/call from Bateaux Parisiens or Viator and the guard said that it had been cancelled for the past 2 days...

We spent the next 22mins on the phone to Viator who confirmed Bateaux had not informed them that they were not operating. I have contacted Bateaux Parisiens and they are ignoring my emails. Terrible company - total shambles.

We were left in Paris at 9pm without a plan and starving as no nearby restaurants had availability as they were fully booked. Plus an absolute waste in cab fares. If we were only told in advance we could have made other plans. No apology received thus far.

Check out the many other boats on the Siene as this company is jokes. Thank you for ruining our trip to Paris! Maybe employ some competent staff who can use email and a phone - I know some 2 year olds who can...

The atmosphere of the boat was great. There was live singing and all the staff were professional. It would be a five star review if it weren’t for the terrible food. It’s called a dinner cruise, and for the price, the quality of the food should be much better. All meats and veggies were over cooked. appetizer was not hot enough. They need to find a way to make the food fresher and less airplane style. Maybe make the menu have less options so they can really just serve great food throughout...only food that was good was desert.

There are so many reviews of this experience I'll keep it short and sweet. For the most part, this was a delightful experience. The food was good, the view was nice, and our server was very friendly and attentive.

However, here are a few issues we encountered:

- I feel like we fell victim to false advertising. On the website, it isn't clear which vessel you'll actually be on when you book. I made my decision to go on this experience based on a picture I saw that was connected to the the dinner cruise time I booked (6:00 p.m.). The image on the screen did NOT match what we actually got when we arrived. My guess is they use a picture of their nicer vessel on the website, and then when you arrive, you may or not be on that vessel. This could have been a misunderstanding on my part, but I was pretty diligent when shopping around.

- Before our dinner was even complete (we had not yet arrived back at the port), the crew began setting up for the next dinner (bread rolls came out on trays and were sitting off to the side). This made the experience feel a bit cheap and transactional.

After getting over the initial disappoint (what we got did not match the picture on the website/our expectations), we had a lovely time!

This is a cattle herd.
They shuffle you on the boat stuff you in next to someone touching elbows and put little bits of food in front of you. The wait staff is rude. Dear God, don’t ask for a beer, It’s as if the earth stopped spinning. They charge you €20 for each picture, hand your camera to the guy and ask him to take a picture. The people next to us or I should say the man rubbing my right elbow gave them €100 for €60 worth of pictures, they said they would be right back with this change and he spent the last hour of his trip trying to get his money. Save yourself the time and feeling like you’ve been ripped off, eat at a nice restaurant for half the price And take the €50 cruise in the evening. This is a complete rip off and tourist scam.

We were seated next to a window with the sun in our faces. The windows didn’t open, so there was no breeze. We asked to have our seats changed, but no luck.
