We were sitting there baking in dress clothes, because it was supposedly required, although some people were admitted in shorts. The food was mediocre at best. I gave it one star because the dessert tasted good.

I took this cruise with my best friend - no joke. While backpacking Europe we try and go on one nice dinner in every major city stop, this was it for us.
You pay up front for your "package", which is a little annoying, but at least you know the cost. We did had the dinner option and added a wine package to it, because hey! girls night. For the cruise we paid a little extra to be seated along the windows, but it was well worth it.

The Food was good, the service exceptional, and the view breathtaking.

My husband booked this cruise during our stay in Paris and it was a very beautiful experience. The dinner was served 3 courses and selection of wine was provided . The views was very stunning as we cruised chatting with other couples seated near . Ambience was very romantic & comfortable. The staff was very tentative and provided awesome service . I highly recommend this cruise!

By far worst experience in Paris. My husband and I were disappointed that such poor service is in existence. 1) This is an enclosed glass boat that feels like a green house. We, along with at least 4 other tables, were asking for the air conditioner to be turned up but they kept saying “It’s on.” Everyone on the boat was using pieces of paper to fan themselves. 2) If you decide to ignore my advice to stay away, feel free to go in jeans and sneakers. “Jeans and sneakers not accepted” is not enforced. 3) Boat does not leave on time. 4) Staff was curt and got dessert of two nearby tables wrong. 5) Food was ok but could not be enjoyed due to heat exhaustion. You’re better off going to a cafe followed by a guided cruise.

We visit Paris annually to celebrate my birthday and always book a dinner cruise. Last year we were left somewhat disappointed but the response to our comments from the management via TripAdvisor and the assurances that improvements would be forthcoming gave us hope that this year's dinner cruise would be better.

We chose a Saturday evening 8pm departure as we've previously found midweek cruises poorly attended and lacking atmosphere. This cruise was pretty well full but this meant our waiter seemed to be rushed off his feet.

Our pre-dinner drinks took an age to arrive as did some bread. Our orders were taken at the speed of light and our inclusive wine was late arriving.

We were amongst the first to board and there was a singer and musician in full flight. As soon as we sat down they stopped playing and went for a break. They returned after the boat was 15 minutes into the journey, played a couple of tunes then went for a second break. This happened again later on so in total I'm guessing they played 10 tunes maximum. I wasn't aware that singing is so taxing that it requires a sit-down after 3 tunes but in this lady's case it did.

I've previously mentioned the annoyance of the pestering photographer whose pushiness and lack of skill are equal in measure, so I won't mention her again.

Finally I was berated by our waiter when he saw me pick out the bottle of white wine from the bucket next to me that belonged to our neighbouring table. He clearly thought we were stealing the wine but even when I explained that his inattentiveness meant our neighbours had nothing to drink and I was passing over their bottle for them to self-replenish he just walked off with our an apology.

All in all this was a most disappointing evening. The atmosphere of the boat was diminished by the mostly absent band, the food was ok but mostly late and our self-service wine clearly being monitored lest we were to steal anything from others.

That was their last chance, I won't be returning.

The 3-course evening dinner and sight seeing cruise was beautiful. It was lovely to see the sights lit up when night fell. The food was very good. I would not rate the food as exceptional because I think they are trying too hard to please the tourist crowd - many of who will be drinking a lot on this tour with the wine buckets at each table. We do not drink so I feel I can give a clearer review. I do recommend this tour if you are going to Paris, which takes you on a cruise on the Seine River. It is very beautiful and is worth the price, which is not too steep - and we booked Premier Seating at a table at the window (which is the best in my opinion). Do not misunderstand, the food was good and there was a singer on board who has a lovely voice. Our waitstaff was attentive and very courteous. The day and night time views are very nice. This next part is something that happened when we got off the tour to go back to our hotel. PLEASE BE VERY CAREFUL AND BEWARE -

We had only one major issue which happened just after the cruise but it did dampen the enjoyment and it happened literally stepping off that boat. First, I am not blaming the boat company or crew at all, however, they need to step up and fix this - kick these people out that area. This is a case of "tourist should be aware and careful" but at the same time, people & companies in France need to work together on this issue which I am sure is not just here and we are by no means the first to experience it.

We were going to take a taxi back to the hotel after walking a ways to the Eiffel Tower when we got off that tour boat, but as you step off, there are drivers around on motorbikes right outside the cruise tour in the parking lot, who can take you and/or a group of people back to their hotels and places. These are not taxis but are like a conglomerate of Lyft drivers on motorbikes with carriages. We found out later that they are called Gypsy taxis. A group of drivers were there - and in this instance, they were Middle Eastern. I don't care what nationality, color, religion, sexual orientation, etc. that a person is but I am pointing this out specifically because I truly believe they are a gang group and I think they do this all the time. The man said that he could take us back to our hotel which was about 15 minutes away. I asked him if he does credit cards which are listed on his carriage, since at that time I had very little cash on me. He said that was fine. However, as we got to the hotel area, he wanted to charge us 50 Euros, then changed it to 50 Euros per person = 100 Euros and then 200 Euros. I told him that this was outrageous and unrealistic and gave him some of the money (more than normal just to get this resolved) but then he threatened me and us and insisted on the 200. It was late and no one was around, which I noticed, so there was nothing to do but go to the ATM right there and get out some of the money needed. If my husband wasn't there, I don't know what he would have done to me and because we were in a foreign country, we could not tell if his other group would show up or police that he could or have bribed would show up. This was very scary. We gave him the money and walked quickly to our hotel.

I am not blaming the Bateaux Parisienne but they need to do something about that situation right outside their docking. I truly blame us for not going to an official taxi at the Eiffel Tower and I blame the gang that decides this is how they want to make their money - by stealing and threatening those who have it. I worked damn hard for my money to make this trip happen and he can earn his money honestly like everyone else does - just because we are American does not mean that I want to give thieves my money which I honestly earned. We are very fortunate that he did not do anything else but steal from us. This also makes all the legitimate drivers like them, look bad and associated all of them in that group because of fear. Plus it doesn't exactly make Paris look wonderful to visit if you have to fear for your life and livelihood. Police and Security need to fix this problem because the more this happens, the less likely people will want to come to Paris nor spend their money there at all.

If you take this cruise, which is extremely beautiful and a wonderful treat and view of Paris. My only concern is that you NEVER take one of those types of taxis ever. Go to the official taxi stands and get them - even if you have to walk a ways. I hope this warning will help someone so you do not experience what we did...or something worse.

Before I begin, this boat moors just a short walk from the Eiffel Tower. I recommend you do what we did; tour the Eiffel Tower, and if you have extra time before the cruise begins, head down to the river where there are little bars (make a left once you reach the bottom of the stairs-opposite your cruise boat on your right), and boats that serve drinks. When ready, head over to the cruise boat (Pier 7). You can check you coat and backpack etc, in the coatroom for free before the cruise begins; you don't have to stuff all your things around/under your table.
This was an excellent cruise. We booked the dinner cruise, and it was perfect. I purchased the table right next to the window. It was a table only for two so we did not have to share it with anyone. I do not think it is worth it to pay the extra money for a table at the front of the boat because the boat turns around. You will see Lady Liberty, the Louvre, Notre Dame, and the Eiffel Tower among other sites. Because the table near the window is under a glass roof, you can see everything above you too. Accordingly, if you purchase the table near the window, you will see everything the same as if you purchase a table at the front of the boat. I would not purchase a table near the center of the boat because one person at that table will not be facing the window, rather they will be facing the interior of the boat unless they turn around. Also, for the person facing the window, in the table in the middle of the boat, they will have to look over the window table below them.
The food was very good. Plenty to eat. Also, believe it or not, we had all the champagne, red wine, and white wine we could drink. The waiter placed the chilled bucket right at our table and always asked us if we wanted refills. We may have been lucky though as he refilled other tables from the chilled bucket at our table. Still, it was all you can drink. They had a live singer who walked around singing such tunes as "New York New York" when when we went past Lady Liberty and from other smooth mellow artists such as Sade. Very calming. Not loud or obnoxious. Perfect. Yes, it is a lot of money, but I agree with the other reviews. It is well worth it. In fact it was so beautiful, and romantic, my girlfriend cried as we glided by Notre Dame. And you can't put a price on that!

If you look at my history I never write reviews period. I am a chef/restaurant owner so I feel the pain when I get a bad review, but then I fix the issues ASAP.

The cruise was a special Father/Daughter dinner cruise she is 13 with an amazing palate we opted to pay the premium window seats $$$$

We have been eating in Paris all week and food is lovely BUT this was our big dinner plans for the evening

1.champagne, wine, service was excellent we even tipped the server $20 euros

2. Escargot was not edible it tasted like 2 day old rubber canned snails over left over Israeli couscous ZERO FLAVOR ZERO PASSION FEOM CHEF

3. My daughter had the scallops which were good

4. I ordered the duck IT WAS A BREAST SPLIT DOWN THE MIDDLE AND OVER COOKED, polenta was discussing ZERO FLAVOR ZERO PASSION FROM CHEF

5, daughter had the filet mignon with
Foie Gras ( easiest steak in the world to cook and yet tough tough shoe leather
The gnocchi was flavorless

6. Desserts and coffee were good

But this was a simple menu to cook at those prices it should have been just good not expecting Michelin stars on a dinner cruise but for $340 euros is unacceptable

Lovely ship
Lovely staff
Clean, tidy, professional but BAD DINNER

We wanted to do a dinner cruise so we picked the best. The boat is very good, modern and well presented we booked the privilege package and got a great window seat but all seats are good with the glass roof. Service was good with a an extensive menu, the only disappointment was my veal main course that was very dry. We had more wine than we could possibly drink. Music was nice, not too loud. I would of liked to do a drive by the Eiffel Tower when the lights came on but we did get a great view when we got off the boat at a few minutes to 11

Very disappointing. I had booked a premier service seating which should have been at the front of the boat. I was assigned table 111 directly at the bow of the boat. Our waiter took us to our table and someone else was seat there. He went to get assistance from the manager, who returned and offered us a different table several seats back at table 15. The food service had not started and people were still boarding. I had booked this tour as a special dinner for my wife's birthday. The manager was unwilling to address the mistake in any manner. There are many other dinner cruises on the Seine. I would recommend that you consider one of them.

Wonderful meal and views on the cruise. I wasn’t sure which option to go for as I thought it was a lot of money however definitely chose the right option. I went with privilege which gets you glass of champagne each, bottle of red AND white, starter, main, cheese, dessert and coffee and macaroons. We sat near the window and saw Paris lit up at night which was great. The photographer takes photos of couples however is €20 per photo which I think is a bit steep so we didn’t buy any. Would recommend and go for it!

Was really looking forward to this after having read the great reviews on trip advisor, however we were so disappointed. First let me preface this with I don’t write negative reviews on any site because I own a but having spent nearly $400 I feel kinda ripped off. We arrived and asked them not to take a picture of us (I’m a private person and don’t like pictures being taken). They took one anyways and tried to sell it to us later. My biggest issue with the cruise was the service in general but specifically the wine service. We didn’t get any. So we paid to order 2 glasses of champagne and then I ordered a beer. When the beer didn’t come we pulled the wine steward over and asked him to purchase a bottle of wine. Prior to that our server asked if we wanted wine with our meal. We answered yes. That wine never came. I didn’t really care for the appetizer but it was ok. My fish was very over cooked so I didn’t eat it. I would have told them had anyone asked me but alas, they did not. The cheese was ok and dessert was good. Husband enjoyed his steak which is why I gave it 2 stars and not 1. The views were nice but nobody told us what we were looking at. All in all having paid $380 for the tickets plus $130 for wine (which should have been provided) we feel pretty ripped off. Not recommended.

We really enjoyed this. Highly recommend!

Pros:
Great meal and wine
Beautiful sights
Lovely music - with a live band and singer

Cons:
Long wait time for check-in
Long wait in between appetizers and main course (the table next to us completely finished their main course before we had even been served)

The cons were so minor - I'd still give it 4.5 stars. Overall a great and special experience!

There were a lot of choices of the river cruise, we chose the one with dinner and wine, it was the best choice, we had so much fun, it left at the perfect time and it came back with a different mood of the Eiffel Tower . It starts just right below the tower and ends right there. Very accessible I booked online via trip advisor . My headband and I had so much fun , food , service and entertainment were excellent. It’s a must when visiting Paris !

I must admit I was very reluctant to book this Evening river trip with evening meal, as there are so many other companies doing the same thing. I really wanted the best value for money but I am so glad I did. This was a perfect evening. This is an elegant restaurant where there is a choice of food, which was delicious. The staff were very attentive and friendly. There did not appear to be a 'bad' positioned table. You can see all around you. You are not all shoved together. It is spacious and airy. The live entertainment was a talented group of musicians with a male singer who had a very soft velvet voice. The staff nicely fussed the birthday celebrating tables. The atmosphere was exciting classy and elegant. Dress up and enjoy. Highly recommended

We were at Premier service and sat at front of boat. It was good seating and good views. However the food was awful. Entre, main and dessert was just not up to standard. The beef and duck was tough and inedible. It would have been perfect. If food was good.

Really fabulous way to see the city from the river. The boat really lends itself to the dining experience. The food was very good on the night of our visit as well as the service. Really couldn’t fault it.

This was a lovely way to spend my anniversary trip. The view was great and the sun actually set after 10pm that night amazing! The food was nothing to rave about but I expected that. I thought I cant come to Paris and not do the river cruise.

If you do one river cruise while you are in Paris, do this one! We spent the evening of our 20th wedding anniversary on the boat and I'm so glad we did. The boat was beautiful, the food was magnificent and the music was top notch. I paid a little extra for a window table for two and it was well worth it. Great views from our seat. A very romantic evening.

We arrived early as it was suggested. We were moved to a holding area that had very few seats and was very warm and uncomfortable.The staff on the cruise was excellent and very accommodating. The sites along the tour are beautiful and nice to see from the river view prospective. Unfortunately, the food was just fair and that is being kind. Most definitely the worst meal we had in 10 days touring Paris and France. We paid significantly more to be in the "premium" section in front of the boat and we were disappointed as our expectations for the amount we paid were much higher. Definitely over priced for the experience we had.

We enjoyed our 8:30 pm dinner river cruise, but I do have a few tips that I wish I knew about! #1) Get there early, as early as possible. We stepped on the boat at around 8:05, and there were several couples already seated, drinking champagne, eating bread, and having a relaxed time as everyone else was being seated. We weren't able to finish all of our champagne, but probably would have had we arrived earlier. #2) We paid quite a bit extra to be seated at the front of the boat, and I don't think this was worth it. First of all, there was a table in the center of the front of the boat, and we weren't seated there (there was a party of 8 seated at that table). We were seated at the first table to the left of that on the window. The viewing was great, it just wasn't worth the extra money because anyone seated on the window on either side would have had just as nice a view. Being seated in the front section of the boat doesn't really buy you much. The boat turns around, so as long as you're seated next to a window, you're going to have an up front view of all of the sites. Also, if you are seated in the front section of the boat, you don't see the live music performers. The music was wonderful, but if you don't walk around the boat, you wouldn't necessarily know that the music is live. I wish the singer had walked around with her mike a little. That being said, this was a wonderful way to spend our first evening in Paris.

We did the dinner cruise you have options so we picked the dinner which starts at 8.30 and it was a great choice. Ambiance / view was breathtaking, service was impeccable and delicious food. We had Foie Gras to start then I had Filet (it was cooked and tested perfect) then the cheese course and the chocolate souffle. Also wine pairing is excellent.

You might find this a bit expensive but its worth every penny. so do try this experience.

After searching for a dinner cruise, of which there are many in Paris, I booked this as I was attracted by the "panoramic views" and the pictures on the website. Unfortunately it is definitely style over substance. Do not be lured by the photos. Yes the boat is very nice looking but thats where it ends. We took the 8:30 Decouverte option for 2 and for the price - a whopping 139 Euros we were wholly underserved 2 starters and 2 mains is the selling point but the portions are miniscule and will leave you hungry. There is no real outdoor acess to enjoy the views and take photographs. The music is so loud and intrusive inside you can barely hear yourself speak. Please learn from my mistake and opt for a cheaper option with more substance. It really ended out trip on a very low point.

We thoroughly enjoyed our dinner cruise on the Bateaux Parisiens. Sitting in the bow of the boat was a bit pricey, but worth it for our experience. We felt like we were in the "lap of luxury" from the moment we were seated. Our servers were wonderful and made the evening fun. The sights of Paris from the Seine at sunset and in the evening are very special. The dinner, from amuse bouche, to appetizer to dinner, with champaigne and wine, was wonderful. The highlight was finishing at the Eiffel Tower, in full light, and sparkling glory. Everything was special.

We have done this cruise twice now. The first time we paid top dollar for the VERY front center of the boat. The second we just paid for window seats and we ended up on the Port side (left) towards the front. Both are wonderful but getting the premium front seats are worth every penny! Many photo opportunities. The dusk and nighttime views are stunning. The food is fantastic. This is a must do part of an evening in Paris but it is quite expensive. If you can fit it into the budget please pay top dollar. It is soooo worth it.

Four of us enjoyed the etoile service. We had excellent views of Paris as we drifted along. The food was lovely, the service was good and the entertainment was pleasant. Was a really great night with friends.

My wife and I booked this dinner cruise with the Privilege Service. We highly recommend the option to have a guaranteed window seat. The view was amazing!

The service staff was incredibly attentive. They came around and pointed out all the sites that we were passing by.

The food was much better than we would have expected to get on a boat. It was equivalent quality to any restaurant meal we had in Paris .

The one complaint we had was that WiFi was not available on the boat (only worked when docked).

It was a great way to see the city (including all the major sites) from a different perspective.

We rated this as the best thing we did in Paris! Why? Very relaxing but elegant dinner with GREAT food. We splurged for birthdays and sat up front “Premier” and that was special. We could see both sides of the river as we went down the river. We took the 8:30PM trip and it lasted two hours and we weren’t rushed!! The service was fabulous and everyone was friendly and helpful. People were dressed up and we were a little casual with nice slacks and tops for the ladies. We did wear tennis shoes because we were walking all day, and this was fine. We used Uber to get there and return to hotel with address as “Bateaux Parisians” and we had no problem getting there. enjoy if you go. BTW, the restrooms were nice (someone else had said, “no sinks”)—They have sinks.

We booked this dinner cruise a month prior to our visit to Paris. We chose the 8:30 pm E’toile service not on a window table. The description said we would be seated at a table of 8-10 persons in the middle of the boat. Fine, we understood we weren’t going to be at a window.

We were shown to our table of 4 on the Cristal boat and immediately we were disappointed. The table was against a center room “separator wall” that afforded the couple sitting with their backs to the window virtually NO VIEW out the other side of the boat. This was not what we were expecting and we immediately asked to speak to the Maitre d, who came over to talk to us. We expressed our displeasure and asked about reseating us at a different table. He was rude, not accommodating and basically said “this is what you paid for”. We got his name and the company auto met relations card so that we could write our complaint to the cruise company.

As for the cruise and dinner itself here are our comments:
- waiters seemed overwhelmed and we had to ask multiple times for things to be brought to the table
- food was very good and the meal overall was surprisingly elegant fine dining
- the cruise along the Seine was quite boring as most landmarks past cannot be seen well from the river
- the Eiffel Tower lit at night is the highlight of the cruise but barely worth an overpriced rude dining experience
- waiter did not bring us requested additional items including Macaroons (which we would have paid for)

Overall, find a nice restaurant or bistro near the Eiffel Tower and enjoy a nice dinner and view at a more reasonable price!

We took the 8:00 dinner cruise which gave us a perfect sunset and view of the beautifully lit Paris icons. We had a very nice upper table (you don’t need a lower one for the higher price to enjoy the view). Service was excellent and the atmosphere was lovely (great for couples). Food and wine were good, but not amazing. You are paying for the experience and the food is secondary. Just the right amount of time. Well worth the experience.

We loved it. We paid a little more for the Priveledge ticket to sit right against the glass, though all the seats seemed to have a good view. Food was delicious, the service was great, the music was excellent and we had plenty of wine to drink. We really enjoyed ourselves. In case you're wondering the food portions were a good size, we left feeling full. We received both a bottle of red and a bottle of white and it was more than the two of us could drink, but not for lack of effort, we also had water and coffee. There are bathrooms on the boat (nice ones down a spiral staircase) but not the dock. When we return to Paris this is an experience we would happily repeat, well worth the price.

The food in general is not freshly cooked. The starters are cold and the desserts are from another company so they’re not made on the boat. Overall, the service is good and the singers are great but the food brings the service down. If you’re like my girlfriend and I who love their food and like to be fed, this isn’t ideal as we both walked away starving. Worthwhile booking a return taxi also as it is very busy. Nevertheless I think it’s a little overpriced but it is a one time experience

A bit pricey, but you are paying for and will receive quality service, The servers and the band made it a smooth, sailing relaxing ride down La Siene, mixed with priceless views of the city with amazing and delicious food, wine and champagne. Highly recommend and will repeat.

It is totally worth paying the extra price to have the wine pairing and seats next to the window. It was a great experience and they have the timing down perfect. You don't feel rushed at all. And have plenty of time to eat, relax and enjoy the historic monuments you pass along the way. I also recommend doing the night cruise (8:30 pm). To see Paris at night is a whole new experience. I highly recommend this dinner cruise!

We traveled to Paris to celebrate our grandaughter's 10th birthday. We visited the Eiffel Tower in the morning and then booked this dinner cruise for her birthday dinner.

Quite honestly, I was expecting a so-so experience, but I was totally wrong and everything about the dinner cruise was fabulous.

If memory serves, there were 3-4 options for the starters, the mains, and the desserts. Everyone at our table of 4 adults and 3 children were happy with the choices and thrilled with the taste and presentation of the food. Service was top notch and the wine was continually refreshed. The value for the money was spot on.

It was lovely seeing the river at night and the return to the lit Eiffel Tower a great hit.

We booked an evening dinner cruise to celebrate a birthday and booked the PrivilegeService

The quality of the food was good and couldn't be criticised. We were surprised to be given the first course before we had even left the moorings. It did rather create the impression that they were going to rush through it. As it turned out, the timings were reasonable.

The tables were cramped and were rammed up against each other with little room without bumping into the people next door. We were also surprised to find babies and toddlers at neighbouring tables. Fortunately they were well-behaved but they had the potential to ruin the evening> frankly, I don't pay over Euros320 for two people to be crammed in and to find screaming children next to me. As it turned out, they didn't scream but on occasions they will and for that price, that is unreasonable.

An official photographer, Dimitri, came round and took lots of pictures. Teh majority of these turned out to be unavailable for purchase because they were of insufficient quality. And that's the official photographer!!

Overall, a nice concept but they need to improve.

Would I go again? Probably not. It's ok but fails on value for money against professionalism

Can not thank the staff enough for that perfect night to end a romantic trip to Paris. We had privilege seats next to the window, we had a choice of 4 starter, mains, cheese course and puddings, i had snails and veal, my partner, scallops and beef all washed down with a bottle of wine EACH, plus champagne and water. The staff was attentive and the live music non-intrusive. The whole event was about 3hours, we dressed up for the occasion and didn't feel out of place...
Had a dreadful experience with these people. Poor food, poor service, and after paying upfront, no refund offered. Would avoid at all costs.

Booked for the early evening dinner cruise along the Seine. We were warmly greeted at the booking office on the riverside at the base of the Eiffel Tower where we were issued with our boarding pass and dinner menus. We were then escorted to our riverboat where we were met by the waiting staff and taken to our allocated table. The service from the waiting staff was excellent, so informative and friendly. The menu offered a good choice of starters, main course and dessert. The food was delicious and well presented. The experience of dining while observing the views of the Parisian cityscape from the perspective of the Seine was breathtaking.
In essence, a truly wonderful experience and a delicious meal.
Recommended!

This dinner cruise was absolutely FANTASTIC. Due to the riots in Paris, we showed up 15 minutes after our boat departure time, just hoping for some luck - which we got! There was one boat left about to leave, so they changed us over to that boat and even upgraded our seats to be next to the window.

Then there was the food... it was delicious. I have Celiac, so I can't have gluten. When I told the waiter, he brought over an allergen menu and helped me figure out what to order. They even had GF bread on board to serve me! All 3 courses were some of the best food I've have in a while - foie gras appetizer, duckling main course, and chocolate cake/mousse (flourless) for desert. That food plus all the free wine we could drink made the ticket prices for this tour an absolute STEAL.

If I go back to Paris, I'd definitely book another cruise with them!

What an amazing way to spend an evening in Paris. We were celebrating our ruby wedding and had hesitated about booking this but it was really good value. You get a menu when you arrive with a choice of four starters, four mains and four desserts. You can swap your dessert for cheese and buscuits of have both for a small suppliment. We had the less expensive option with seats in the middle but as they were raised above the window seats and the windows included the roof we had an excellent view. The service which is included in the price was second to none with our waitress Sara giving extra information about the sights we were passing. We were served a Kir with nibbles to start then had a bottle of white wine and a bottle of red wine to accompany our meal with coffee served at the end. We were also given the choice of a bottle of still or sparkling water. A bar is available if required. The meal was delicious and well worth the money we paid. We had live music and a photographer took a variety of photos but there was absolutely no pressure to buy. Would highly recommend this special night out.

Booked this as a surprise for my husbands 60th Birthday! We had a fab night! Good was delicious & lots of wine included! Seemed expensive when booking but the wine alone paid more than made up for it! I had booked a window seat so able to see all the sights clearly! We had a great waiter looking after us which made the trip even more enjoyable!

Worst experience ever. We tried to book for 35 guests and they imposed on us ONE fixed meal (1 starter, 1 main and 1 desert) for all the guests and not negotiable! For a 200€/guest, this is outrageous and expensive! How can you impose on guests what to eat, what’s the difference with 13 couples coming on board or do you impose on them a fixed menu also???
Avoid it, not worth the money nor the hassle to check with them

I want to be as fair as I can be with this review. I felt initially that, if there'd been a 2.5 score, that this would've been my choice, but on balance, the negatives outweighed the positives, so I've chosen a 2. The positives first: the journey was very smooth. Dessert was delicious and starter was nice enough. Unfortunately, the main course steak was inedible. Very gristly and unpleasant to try and eat. When I raised this with the (clearly very busy) waiter, the steak was replaced and was much better, but following on from this, service was very noticeably extremely abrupt. I very rarely return food in this way and felt no pleasure in doing so, but I was disappointed with the reaction from the waiter to it. It left a nasty taste in the mouth. Finally, don't choose a window seat if there may be hot weather during your meal. It was uncomfortably hot throughout the journey.

My daughter and I took the 6:10 p.m. cruise a few days ago. The person who seated us and took our dinner order was in a hurry and obviously impatient. We felt rushed and made our food choices without really knowing what we were being offered as the menu was in French (which is fine if you can get some assistance!). We understood from the ad there would be champagne and live music, but neither were included that evening. The experience felt rushed. We sat, ate dinner, and then returned to the port. We wished we could have strolled a deck while cruising or enjoyed a little longer cruise. The food was okay, not great.

Booked this for my husband's 50th birthday and was not disappointed. The food was excellent, the music great and the staff were superb.

An excellent experience that we would definitely recommend and would do it again.

Simply the best thing my family of five (three college-aged "children") did while we were in Paris. The wait-staff was unbelievably attentive, especially regarding nut allergies that two of mine deal with. "Ave Maria" performed as we coasted by Notre Dame Cathedral brought my wife to tears. I highly recommend the Premier Service. It truly was a magical experience.

Although many people may think doing a dinner cruise on the Seine River is a bit too touristy and formulaic for a Paris visit, we booked the Premier level of service to celebrate my birthday. We were not disappointed. The service was superb, timely, the entree and plat principal were delicious. The duration of the cruise was just right. Would do it again and it is worth the price. One note, after the cruise is over and you want to use Uber to go back to your hotel, Uber drivers are not allowed to drive down to the lower level of the river embankment - only buses and taxis, so you have to meet the Uber above the embarkation point - no big deal and we were put off by a Parisien taxi driver who wanted to charge us a premium for a ride to our hotel so that is when we decided to use Uber.

My 17 year old and I recently took the 6:15 dinner cruise. It is mid-June, and the sun— surprising to me—does not set until after 10pm-ish here, so 6pm it was still up high and shining hotly. I’d booked a window table, which was more expensive. We were in the sun the entire way up the river AND back down, which my daughter and I were flabbergasted by, as from a physics perspective, that shouldn’t be possible, right? But we were, and we were dripping with sweat the entire hour and a half. The boat had air conditioning, and in the middle section, which is up a few steps, it was perfectly temperate. But be aware that, in the summer, the back left of the boat is NOT the place you want to be. The group of Chinese tourists at the four tables in front of us deployed their umbrellas and kept them up most of the trip.
Our waiter and his team were very pleasant, but we rarely saw them—certainly not enough to have our glasses filled once they’d emptied, so I followed the example of the Spanish couple in front of us and got up and served myself when my water or wine glass became empty—and yes, that felt very tacky on my part, but I was a hairsbreadth away from going up in flames and felt justified :/
The food was fine, and they had good choices to appeal to most people, and the views were certainly something you can’t get any other way but....it just wasn’t worth the money. I could’ve paid less than that for lunch at a Michelin star restaurant and received amazing food and service in an atmosphere that didn’t make me want to jump in the Seine. Again, very pleasant staff, clean and pretty boat, average food....just not worth the price. Maybe the 8:30 cruise with the sun starting to set and the lights coming on would be worth it? Don’t know—and we won’t be finding out.

I felt happy that we kick start our Paris tour with this seine river cruise. We touched down Paris city in the afternoon and we head to Bateaux Parisiens for the wonderful dinner plus cruise experience. We enjoyed our meals, live music, live performance, drinks very much! Is a must to do in Paris, I would said. Best way to see Paris, you get to see the sparking Eiffel Tower, the faces southwest NYC's Statue of Liberty, the beautiful Notre Dame shining at night and many more! I've a video reviews in my YouTube channel, feel free to visit my website found in the photo!

I went on this 2 1/2 hour dinner cruise my first night in Paris. What a start. The dinner was excellent, I had duck, and the wine just as good. Local singing entertainment. Saw all the sights. There is no narration. At the end you dock adjacent to the Eiffel Tower all lit up. Get tickets early cheaper and better selection of views.

Wanted to do something special for my 40th in Paris, so booked this cruise for me and 3 friends, and had a fantastic time. We booked the 8.30pm Premium service, which admittedly was the most expensive, but it was so worth it. There was no queue to board and check-in, and a free cloakroom on arrival. We were shown to our table at the front of the boat (about 3 tables back from the nose on the right hand side) so had excellent panoramic views. The waiter was really attentive on arrival and helped us understand what the meal consisted of and gave recommendations on what to choose. The food was amazing and just kept coming. I was a little nervous when I booked that it said there would be 1 bottle of wine for 4 people (for a 2 hr cruise), so was expecting to have to purchase additional drinks. However what they meant was 1 bottle per course! Even we could not complain about that, and again the wine & champagne was excellent and went very well with the food.
The sights were stunning, and it felt very special to be able to see them at night, from vantage points that you would not get to see on foot. Again our waiter was really helpful to show us where we were and point out sights of interest. All of this, plus a live singer and photos on board made for a truly memorable night.
Would definitely go back and do this again.

Booked evening cruise to celebrate a friends birthday whilst on weekend break to Paris.

All seemed fine on boat until the main course was served. 5 of our 10 meals had to be returned as, partway through the meal, we found the chicken was raw. This put us off a replacement meal and no alternative was offered.

We found out whilst on the trip, that others had also sent their food back as it was also raw.

Desert was ok but no coffee was offered even though it was too other tables.

The whole experience was marred by the undercooked food.

Since returning to the UK, there has been a very one sided conversation with Bateaux Parisiens via email, who eventually responded once, and said it was ok to serve chicken "rose pink"!! Chicken should never be served pink 😡😡.

No refund, either in part or full, has been offered which is the least they could do considering the implications of uncooked chicken to everyone's health.

Had a birthday celebration trip last weekend with my wife and several friends, four of us were served raw chicken with two ending up with food poisoning. Bateaux have advised that serving raw chicken as "Rose on the Bone" is perfectly acceptable and have refused our complaint. Completely spoilt our trip and I would not recommend this particular company for this tour although the views were great. Go with another operator if you are having a meal.

Amazing trip with great food and good music. Great way to see Paris by night. Very romantic as well.
If you want the window seat you should maybe do the upgrade.
This was just perfect! We upgraded to premier and I highly suggest it. We were at the front of the boat - panoramic views all around. The food was just lovely.

Very arrogant and angry lady in the phone. So we didn’t even want to try this boat trip!!!
She didn’t want to make time to explain the different prices

Really disappointed with this trip. We had a problem with our transport to the location so called to say we were going to be a couple of minutes late and check it was ok before making the journey - we were told it was tough - would you call and tell the airport that before a flight - when we turned up there was a huge queue in the rain and we were delayed for over an hour.
To add insult to injury we had to sail the wrong way so got to see none of the sights marked on the route - instead we saw industrial yards - completely the opposite of any landmark.
Food was not good.
So disappointing considering we had been on a dinner cruise with the same company in London and had enjoyed it so much.
There was no offer of a refund - we were given a voucher towards a future visit - which would be fine but we don’t live on Paris.

I was really disappointed with this tour/booking. I arrived at the port to find out the tour (dinner cruise) had been cancelled. I was not notified at all about this being cancelled. When I called the tour operator she was unaware of the dinner cruise being canceled. I tried further to speak with someone to see about getting a refund and the woman I spoke with was unsure if I could be refunded.
Overall this was a lovely experience however I do think it’s a little over priced for what you get but it is definitely worth doing.

We took one of the round tables at the front of the boat. Note there are 14 of them. Our table was on the side window which gave us an amazing view. To be honest all tables looked really nice, it didnt look to us like people were sharing tables, it was either couples or groups of 4.
The food was surprisingly really really top class - truely fine dinning. The Champaign and wine were included, and basically was free flowing, we had as much wine as we could drink - and I can drink a lot. Live singer was good. Service very friendly and professional. Overall experience was top class, it felt really special. Congratulations to bayeux parisians for maintaining a really high quality experience, and not just milking tourists.
Strongly recommend.
FYI; several people turned up whilst we were boarding to see if they had space, and they said they were fully booked for next three nights. There were quite a few empty tables, with wine on and ready to go, but obviously people had got stuck in the traffic due to the metro strike. I would recommend dressing down slightly and wearing shoes you can walk in, the walk up from metro stop champs Elise on line 1 was about 30mins, but very pleasant along the Seine looking at Eiffel Tower.

This cruise was recommended to me by a coworker, and I had moderate expectations.
I was on a business trip and brought my mom (72 yrs old). It was her birthday so gave her this cruise to celebrate her bday. This was so nicely done. Elegant setting, classy and respectful guests, talented musicians and fun server.
The music set the mood and guided us through different emotions throughout the experience. I don't think anyone had a dry eye when they sang Ave Maria as we passed the injured Notre Dame. It was beautiful and moving.
They then proceeded (later in the evening, more festive moment) to sing happy birthday to my mom. I think it was her most memorable trip and moment ever.
Thank you to the staff and musicians and the lovely operators of this cruise.
I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this particular operation, boat, etc. Reserve the table near the window (Premiere) to ensure you have the most perfect experience, comfort and view. Was worth every penny, and more.
Enjoy.

Do yourself a favor and get dinner at a great restaurant and take a stroll down the street, or ride a scooter around the water. The food on this "cruise" was the absolute worst tasting we have had in all of Europe. It's not fresh at all and was likely made earlier in the day. We did not eat our entrees and the waiter did not ask any questions about if we enjoyed the food or not. They are just getting ready for the next cruise. Worst customer service! For the money, you can have amazing food and a better dining experience elsewhere in Paris. (We paid $300€ for nothing) HUGE WASTE! Do not recommend at all!

We were looking for something fun to do for dinner one evening in Paris and grabbed a couple of tickets for the Bateaux Parisiens Seine River Dinner Cruise and it surpassed all of our expectations (especially with a few of the reviews being a bit down on it). One thing, we would recommend if you are a couple, to scale up to the Premier or Privilege service, as the locations for seeing out of the boat are much better than the over service levels (right up against the windows, perfect view, and a table for two!). However if going with a group, certainly consider doing one of the lower-level services and sit with your group in the middle of the boat. You will be spending more time having fun with them vs. seeing the sights anyway. We found the food quality and service level (again at the level we chose) to be very high and were very happy, an excellent number of menu choices for each course, very freshly prepared, wine and champagne were good, and service was excellent. Overall, on a clear night, it was great fun and really well done. We highly recommend!

We arrived 30-40 minutes prior to our set dinner time of 6:15 PM and were seated within 10 minutes at a window table for 2 (not 4, a very nice surprise). We were offered a choice of wines and a menu within 5 minutes of being seated. The menu is seasonal; however I had the pate appetizer, duck l'orange entree, and chocolate hazelnut cake dessert and was not disappointed. My husband had the vegetarian/vegan appetizer, veal entree, and semolina with raisin dessert. He preferred my appetizer and entree (as did I); both desserts were very good. The service and Seine River views were excellent. Highly Recommend.

It was my husband's birthday and which could be better than a Dinner Cruise at the Bateaux Parisiens Seine River right at the heart of the City of Paris and the Eiffel tower overlooking us? Great food and best tasting wine! Amazing experience we'll keep in our hearts.

This was a special evening. The boats are all glass on the sides and the roof top to allow for endless views. Very quiet despite the large number of passengers. There was a soloist to add to the atmosphere. Food was slightly above average and every table got a bottle of wine in addition to a glass of champagne. Tables are pretty snuggly placed so privacy is compromised. All in all this is an evening that is not to be missed when visiting Paris.

This was the highlight of our trip to Paris, my husband and I took this cruise in our last night and we both loved it. Believe me, when I say this, it's not about the food because it's very average but the overall experience. They had live music and all the monuments are light up, also the service was wonderful which it's rare in Europe. This was a great romantic way to spend a night in Paris.
Horrible food, definitely not worth the money. If I knew that it would be so bad, I would have a done a cruise without dinner. Would not do again even if it was for free!!

My Review starts in July when originally booked for my wife’s 40th Birthday, unfortunately on that occasion my Mother was taken seriously ill and following a two month ordeal finally returned to her home, during that period this trip I paid for was fully credited back as a special one off circumstance for which I will very grateful to all parties concerned, because of that we rebooked for the 8.30 sailing this Thursday, All I can say is WOW it was worth the wait, four of us dinned at the very front of the vessel, every thing was just sensational and exceeded our expectations in every way, the food was awesome and the views spectacular. Paris at its best. Thank you for being understanding first time round to enjoy this fabulous experience.

My wife and I took the 8:30 dinner cruise and it was amazing. Check-in was quick, and extremely well organized. I purchased window seats, which was a good decision as we had wonderful views throughout the trip. We were greeted with Champagne, and then selected our meals. I had the foie-gras appetizer and my wife had the crab. Both dishes were exceptional. I was pleasantly surprised that the wine was very good, definitely not cheap generic wines. We then had the steak, and the most incredible gnocchi we'd ever had. Next was a cheese course with 2 types of cheese, an emental and chamambert I believe, both were great. And finally the deserts just blew our minds, I had a chocolate cake and my wife had a mango cake. The best desserts either of us ever experienced. Post meal we were given espresso and macaroons. A magical evening, we'll be doing it again when we return.

Oh, and one more thing. The singer was also exceptional, she had a beautiful voice and sang a mixture of French and English/American songs.

I normally shun 'touristy' tours like a lunch cruise, but my parents were visiting from Canada (we live in Paris), and we thought this might appeal to them. It was AMAZING! The boat was lovely, the service excellent, the food very good (not the best, obviously, but definitely GOOD. The dessert cakes were from LaNotre, a very high end patisserie!!), and of course the view couldn't be beat! The meal service pace was perfectly timed for the 2 hr cruise. The live singer was extremely good - so "French!" (I know that's a cliche - but she was!) - and the energy on the boat was lovely. We took the etoile service, and it was fabulous. The wine and mineral water was consistently refilled. At 59EU per person this is a very good deal indeed. Treat yourself!

We took the 8pm cruise and totally enjoyed the experience. Food was good, not amazing, but the overall experience was totally enjoyable and well worth the cost. We reserved early so got the absolute best table available at the front of the boat. Also booked premium package so the champange and wine were plentiful. The service was very good and the trip through the river was really fabulous. The boat is new and well appointed, restrooms are spotless and the entertainment was enjoyable. If you are looking for an exquisite meal for this price...go to a restaruant. If seeking the full experience of the sights, food & wine, and experience, then book this tour...it's awesome! Plan to arrive early, it's a bit confusing with multiple boats leaving from the piers.

We were picked up at our hotel and driven to the very large, glass enclosed barge-like boat. It was comfortable once inside and there were tables set up on either side of the boat (each table had seats for 3 persons if needed and some tables were pushed together to hold 6 to 8). It was rainy and cold but I brought a very heavy sweater which helped. The view of the city along the river was great and we had a menu with two choices of the main dinner. They served everyone all of the choices of dessert as well as wine, water or soft drinks. All had been prepaid. I had been to Paris many times before but this was the first cruise on the river and I am glad that I did it.
This was great, the staff was very friendly, and understanding, the food was good, I would recommend this tour , during your trip to Paris ...

Check in was simple. We had a small cramped table by the window - we paid extra for it. The service was terrible - a waiter brought champagne and some cheese and then disappeared. It was nearly 45 minutes later before we caught his attention and explained he had not taken our dinner order. He took the order and appetizers appeared quickly but our main course never showed up. We complained and were served after 10:00 PM. Everything else was rushed because the cruise was ending. They didn’t announce any of the sites and our side of the boat never got to see Notre Dame. The food was awful - my filet of beef was as tough a piece of meat as I ever had. It was an expensive evening not worth the cost.

Exceeded every single one of my expectations! From the moment we sat down, I knew this was going to be a great experience. Went on this dinner cruise with 4 friends for my birthday and it did not disappoint. The food was delicious, the entertainment was extraordinary, and the service was top notch. Our waiter, Pop, even had the singer sing Happy Birthday in French which made the night even more special. Could not have asked for a better evening

We had booked a table for two on outside which we were given. Food was very good as was the service.

We enjoyed the live entertainment.

What is difficult to accept is a published dress code which is not adhered - we were overdressed as a result of it - to thus the 4 / 5.

We did the dinner cruise on the 14th July. Very expensive and marked as formal attire. Well, pretty much a waste of money.
Firstly trying to get to the pier with all the road blockages was interesting. Police were useless, one lot telling us to go to the other side of the river, then the police there would tell us to go back over to the other side. Walked over and back three times before someone indicated the stairs down. Next, we were overdressed - for a formal night you can apparently were jeans! Kicking ourselves for lugging formal gear overseas for one night. Food was OK. Disappointing was the fireworks - better to see them from outside. The glass roof struts sort of obscured the view and the reflection on the glass rendered the photos awful.
One of the best nights we have ever had. A perfect meal, service, and view of Paris at night. A bit pricy but worth every penny

It is a quick service, approximately an hour in total, so the meals are pre-prepared and served quickly. Because of this the quality of food is fairly average. The wait staff are wonderful, very efficient and friendly and the views themselves from the cruise is gorgeous. We would recommend booking a standard ferry cruise around the Seine for the same experience and dine in a nicer restaurant on land.

We were delighted with this cruise! The food and wine were wonderful, and the views were amazing no matter where we looked! The staff was attentive and forgave us for our bad French. :-) It's a nice way to see some beautiful Parisian architecture without the crowds. Plan to arrive at least 30 minutes early. Make sure to follow the instructions on your cruise voucher to know where to check in. At check in, you will receive boarding passes, menus, and instructions on which boat to board. All the docks are numbered (including check-in), so it's pretty simple. At the end of the cruise, we returned just in time to see the flickering of the Eiffel Tower lights. We used Uber for transportation to and from the dinner cruise and didn't have much of a wait at all.

We had a pre-booked dinner , upon arrival and seating we were advised we had only a set menu , this was a total surprise ( NO OPTIONS) to bad if we were , vegan, vegetarian, lactose intolerant, seafood allergy etc, etc. To bad for you sir/madam !!!!
Wine was included in the price of which we had to almost beg for a refill . The whole experience was one we definitely won’t forget , but most certainly will want to not relive 👎👎👎👎👎👎

took my terminally ill mum on this as a way to view some of the monuments of Paris in comfort. The food was lovely, our seats by the window gave us a great view and the music was unobtrusive but relaxing. Service was excellent and we had a thoroughly enjoyable three hours

I was hoping for a night to remember when I booked this trip and I wasn't disappointed! Everything was wonderful- the champagne, the wine, the food, the music - everything! The best part however, were the spectacular views of Paris at night from the Seine. If you're going to be in Paris, do yourself a favor and book this trip!
It was a highlight of our trip! Best boat we’ve been on yet. The live music was lovely. The food and wine pairing were delicious. The view and the glass ceiling was the best yet!

Most enjoyable dinner cruise EVER!! Our outstanding waiter greeted us with champagne and a very fun sense of humor. Since we booked “Privilege” level we had a table for 2 next to a window guaranteed. It also included a bottle of red wine and a bottle of white wine. The food was fine dining at its best. The views of Paris at sunset and at night are priceless. We would highly recommend this dinner cruise!

I have never been on a river cruise for the same reasons outlined in the average to terrible reviews on here. However I did want to see Paris in a different way and I wanted to trust some of the excellent and very good reviews. I went with a realistic mind and I would say the experience was average.

We opted for the 8:30 cruise and the boarding, seating etc was seamless. We paid for the cheapest seating and yet we’re sat at a window seat which was really good. Don’t panic if you’re late because they were allowing people to board at 8:35, and whilst 50% of people adhere to the smart dress code, 50% don’t, and rock up in something I’d wear to go to the corner shop in. The sooner you’re on the boat the sooner you get served but you either get served last or get served first and wait for everyone else to finish.

The food really was average and for the price this isn’t really acceptable. The starter wasn’t bad but it’s hard to get, essentially what was pate, wrong. They served these really strange cheese pastries and the bread rolls had probably been in storage since the last world war. There was a really long wait between the starters and main. For the main I had beef which I ordered medium. It came well done but to be fair it was cooked very well. The only problem was it was tasteless, as were the veg and potatoes. The dessert was quite good, I had the chocolate option which was a bit like a posh kit kat, if you’re British.

I don’t really drink so I’m the last person to take advice on when it comes to wine, but it was like vinegar to me. You get a bottle of white, a bottle of red, a welcome cava and a bottle of Evian. The drinks from the bar are extortionate and although I didn’t ask to be fair, I do think they should automatically offer a soft drinks package for those who don’t drink alcohol (20cl soft drink €4), as this would be cheaper to them than offering 2 bottles of wine per table.

The singer was average and the boat could do with a good clean. We found the last 30 mins a little tedious, as we had finished our food. The service was excellent.

For £99 per head you’d be better off finding a really nice restaurant near to the river and enjoying it that way. I definitely wouldn’t do it again.

If you have any questions message me!

This is highly recommended. Will go down as a top memory of our Paris trip. Excellent food and wine. We did the tasting menu. Waiter was funny and awesome. Music was subtle and excellent. Seeing the sights from this very different perspective was so memorable.

The ambiance on the cruise was really nice. We paid US$180 per person for this cruise, so we spent a lot of money. The service was OK but not really great. We had to wait quite some time to get red wine but the white one was readily available. We requested red, which they said we could have but by the time we got it, we had finished our appetizer.

The craziest part of the cruise: we were on the river just minutes before the Eiffel Tower was to light up. Instead of pausing, the Capt.docks the boat. Everyone is struggling to see but can’t. Not wanting to miss the lights, we all rushed off the boat to catch the last two minutes. It was anticlimactic to say the least. That left us with a bad taste in our mouths, so to speak.

Entertainment was good.

Celebrated our 28th wedding anniversary at a table for 2 by the windows. It was a bit warm waiting to board the boat and to set sail (during heat wave), but otherwise everything else went smoothly. Good food, wine, music and beautiful sights! Service was a bit robotic, but nothing really bad. Expensive, but definitely worth it for a special occasion!

A little confusing on the dock as the ticket didn't specify which boat number.
Service a little slow. We had lower deck table with window, suggest you request upper level with window view. Food was acceptable, but not desirable. Champagne and white wines included and good. The bottle of red was a little rougher.We came for the evening return view which was spectacular. The expense was a little high at
159e per person. Skip the photo shoot, they asked for over 300 e for the 16 photos they took or 20e each with paper frame. Last trip they made a deal on 4 or 5 prints, this trip they were insulted that we dint spring for the 300e and stormed off.Better to just decline and use your phone for less stress.
Great food, service and beautiful scenery! We paid for seats by the window. It was worth the extra cost. Romantic cruise with my partner.

I did a Seine tour with my girl friend including dinner with the boat leaving 19:30.

Positive:
The trip was well organised, the boat was in great shape, service was friendly, length of the cruise optimal

Negative:
Food was not good; Quality of ingredients good but cooked a long time ago, felt like eating in an airplane, especially the started & main course - desert was fine
Wine was too warm since the bottle has been standing on the table for a while

Given the price we expected more from the culinary side, everything was good
Although a little rushed, and a tiny bit stingy with the wine, it is a great way to see the views from the Seine River. Pay the extra $ and get a window table for dinner.

Everything about this boat dinner cruise was 10/10. Wait staff, condition of facilities, food was 15/10!!! Views, wine, all were wonderful. Thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. If u can afford the time and the expense, please go on this tour. Highlight of a trip to Paris.

Our family of 13 ( 5 children ages 9-18) recently took this dinner cruise. Everything was wonderful, the food was very good, sights lovely. It was a 2 1/2 hour cruise, no commentary which we all liked. Service was good. The children all said it was their favorite thing that we did that week. The reservation process involved actually calling France when I made the initial reservation. The person spoke excellent English, but note that they require a deposit which is applied to your final bill. Boat was very clean and comfortable. Bathrooms clean. The steak was very good. We did not get very dressy, but did wear nicer clothes than our day touring clothes. Men wore collared shirts. Soem people were dressier on the boat, but honestly I think you could wear anything you are comfortable in.I would recommend this cruise and would do it again. We found out about it from a friend who had been there before us.

Great 2,30 hour cruise wonderful warm night very nice food unlimited drinks no commentary but hey the landmarks were still amazing especially at dusk we weren't at the more expensive seats next to windows but still had great views entertainment was ok but more interested in food and views highly recommend this if visiting for just a few days in Paris

I was visiting for my 20th Anniversary and was told that I had to try the river cruise. I was nervous about the booking because I heard that there were good ones and bad ones. I trusted viator and booked this cruise. The staff was amazing and very courteous. We met a nice group of ladies at the next table and ended up making new friends. The quality of the pictures taking my the photographer were also nice and well priced. My only criticism is that you have to pay cash for the pics. I would have purchased more photos if credit cards were an option. I highly recommend this cruise!

Booked dinner cruise for a family treat while staying in Paris.

Cost nearly £600 for the four of us as we wanted a guaranteed window seat. Impressed with the boat and our arrival. We were seated to a nice table with comfy chairs by a window. We were served straight away with champagne and a couple of canapés which were scrummy.

Nice menu but not particularly exciting for a vegetarian but good to have an option and the other meat eaters were very happy with their food. It didn’t feel like mass catered food and the service was very good.

There was a live singer and band which was lovely background noise and added to the atmosphere.

It would have been perfect except it was so cold. We had the air con blowing in us directly. We complained on at least 4 occasions to various waiters and the boat photographer even complained for us. As one point my mother in law was wearing her coat. Really not good enough for the extortionate price we paid. I had to pace the length of the boat to find a manager to arrange the air con to be turned off. At this point we were on dessert. Though he acted quickly he was not in the slightest bit apologetic which was really disappointing.

So bar the air con and spending most of the cruise freezing, it was a lovely evening and I do recommend going. Think you would be disappointing if you didn’t have a window seat.

Very expensive for what it was but it did feel quite special being on board.

The staff worked tirelessly started with fois gras which I have never had before, but not to my taste so not again. Fillet steak was perfection, I did however refuse the snail sauce, to accompany it. Sweet was marvellous a nut and tart creation. The six of us enjoyed the cruise and food with entertainment, highlight of our five day stay. The Eiffel Tower was spectacular in the dark as it had hundreds of flashing led's, which looked wonderful, three bottles of wine for the six of us was very tasty. £630 for the six of us, not cheap but a good night.

We cruised on our one year anniversary date, check in took about 20 minutes as there were guests who were walk ons who didn't purchase tickets in advance.

We received a glass of champagne and our choice of red or white wine with dinner. I was disappointed that I didn't have the option to specify my social occasion when I booked the reservation. There were a few birthdays being celebrated onboard, and when asked about it was told it cost extra to be acknowledged. I found that to be a gouging tactic considering the cost of the cruise could easily have included the small dessert and candle provided.

There were two singers who did a wonderful job singing themed songs as we rode past the sights.

Those seated in the center of the boat spent a lot of time turned around in their seats to look out of the windows past us to see the water. I was glad that I booked the window seats. We had a lot of room at our cozy table for two.

Photos were taken by a professional photographer who took several photos of us. When the cruise ended the photos weren't ready and I had to ask for them. When they were finally presented to us, we the young lady who showed us the photos said that we could have one photo for $20 and she'd give us a second photo. The photographer walked over to us at that point and she changed her story, saying we could pay for one photo and take a photo of a second with our cell phone. We declined both and left. Aside from that experiences, I would have rated this cruise a 5.

This was priceless bonding experience with our family. The views of Paris were complimentary to the delectable dishes served on board. A great experience to sail on the Seine and see Paris from the water. I wish the deal was cheaper but regardless it was a good experience.

We had a wonderful experience and some of the best food of our trip. We were treated very warmly by all staff, the views and live music were lovely as well. Very romantic! Make sure to get there at an appropriate time and get your boarding pass. (we thought that our printed ticket was a boarding pass, it is not. Luckily we arrived pretty early) I definitely recommend this cruise to anyone looking for a candlelit multiple course meal with lovely views and lots of wine.

We did this cruise our first night in Paris and it was a great way to kick off the trip.

We had service premier at the front of the ship.Its a bit expensive but totally worth it.Perfect for a special occasion.They know how to treat people.It lasted about 2 hours aprox,the food was very good and the champagne too.They had a violinist and a singer.We had a really great time.The view was memorable.

We booked the cruise to celebrate our 30th anniversary and were not disappointed. After a typical Parisian cloudy, rainy day sightseeing, we ubered to the dock right in front of the tower and boarded the cruise. Wait was only a few minutes and we were escorted to our premier service table at the front of the boat. Amazing views all around, though frankly, I think the views would be great nearly anywhere. Then as if on cue, the skies parted, the sun came out and we enjoyed amazing light and sunset as we pulled out to see the sights of Paris from the river. Our waiter was wonderful, friendly, charming, competent. The champagne and wine were decent and free flowing all evening (and we're a bit wine snobby so I was pleased). Food was very good and the pace was nice. Onboard entertainment was also very nice and appropriate. Only drawback was a group of loud folks in the center table behind us who made sure everyone knew they were from Texas - 7 women and 1 gentleman - and who couldn't shut their mouths for 2 minutes while the entertainer attempted to sing the Ave Maria in front of Notre Dame. They also were clueluess to the hundred silent daggers being thrown at them. Despite that, when dessert and coffee came around, we'd celebrated an amazing night. Wait staff graciously took photos with our camera that we liked better than than the on-board photographer. And the return was timed perfectly as we returned to the dock right as the Eiffel Tower was starting it's stunning regular light show. Yeah it was a bit pricey, and yeah, probably a bit touristy, but for a big night out, we enjoyed it. Truly a memorable and highly recommended experience.

I had a wonderful and enjoyable experience while dining on this cruise. Really worth your money. The food is really delicious and the service on the cruise was excellent. A good choice for romantic couples to enjoy! Thumbs up!

We thoroughly enjoyed our trip on the Seine. My husband had booked a table in the centre of the boat and we had a fixed menu with 2 choices per course. The boat wasn't too busy and there was no one at the window seats so we had a fantastic view. The food was excellent, the wine very good and the staff attentive. We enjoyed the entertainment. The atmosphere was very relaxed but it felt very special. The vies were fantastic and the Eiffel Tower was lit up on our return. A lovely evening!

Once again we booked with Viatour. Everything is always perfectly arranged and of high quality. Had a window seat, which isn’t cheap but you want to see things. Great experience. Brilliant food and service. Took about 3 hours. Written guide to buildings we passed. Nice singer and also flautist. Very pleasant evening. Lovely boat with relaxed atmosphere and great lit up sites , of course. Fabulous!

I booked the 8PM dinner so we could see the lights of Paris at night. I reserved a table at the center because you do need to pay extra for a window seat. The boat does have an all glass ceiling so you can pretty much see everything even from a centrally located seating. The waiters were very attentive and quite friendly. The three course meal was quite good and the wine selection will eventually put a smile to your face. There's live entertainment and I must say, it does heighten the experience. You will see Paris landmarks like the Musee d'Orsay, the Alexander bridge, the Louvre, Notre Dame, the Statue of Liberty and of course, the Eiffel tower which is simply glorious to behold when lit up. As if on cue, the Eiffel sparkled (as it does every hour) as we passed it on the way back. I've never seen my family happier over dinner. It was quite a special night.

Food was delicious which was unexpected. Service good but would have been better if we could serve ourselves with white wine as we didn't have enough. Tables were a bit tight for space but the waiter was great with us and I would recommend.

I paid extra money for my Grandmother and her partner to have a window seat for this cruise. When I called to ask how their experience was - they said they had an amazing time, but weren't placed by a window seat. My Grandmother had to demand to be taken to a window seat even though her ticket GUARANTEED her a spot. Aside from this dramatic moment, the servers, meal and ambiance were to their satisfaction.

Treated myself to an early birthday dinner aboard the dinner cruise and it was spectacular.
We took the premium seating, next to the window and it came 4 courses including a cheese platter, bread, 1 bottle of white and red wine and a welcome champagne. It was excellent. Cannot sell it enough. Food was beautiful, waiter was lovely and provided some quick commentary, entertainment was nice, and the view stunning - Paris by night is just amazing.
I also upgraded to the celebratory package and got a piece of birthday cake with a massive candle plus another champagne.
All very worthwhile so glad i did this. Thank you for making this a great night.

What a magical evening from start to finish!
All staff were just so friendly and courteous, nothing was too much trouble. They worked together so well as a team...a well oiled machine. The boat was gorgeous, really beautifully set up and so clean and tidy.
The food was just superb! So beautifully presented and tasted delicious, cooked to perfection. The wines chosen to accompany the food were perfect, we had so much that we gave it to the family on the next table!
There were two lovely ladies singing throughout the meal and a professional photographer to take photographs of you, if you wished.
The boat sailed at a leisurely pace and we had a map of the route to follow, however, our lovely waitress told us what was just coming up and where to look etc.
There were birthday candles in the desserts (and cheese!) of everyone whose birthday was being celebrated and everyone sang happy birthday in French and English.
What an amazing treat, a fabulous memory to treasure.

We booked the 8:30pm dinner cruise expecting the sights to be amazing and the food and beverage to be average. We were so pleased that the sights were yes, amazing and we had plenty of time to enjoy, take photos, and walk outside for photos. Our waiter was entertaining & they brought a cake and sang Happy Birthday to us and many on the boat. The 2 1/2 hour cruise was so relaxing and enjoyable. The food and beverage was above average, for serving so many people for a sit down dinner. The entire experience was well above expectations and would highly recommend this boat company and the extra expense for the service privilege.

This is a must do for every couple visiting Paris! I recommend going in the evening when you can see the Eiffel Tower being lit up! It was quite a romantic experience and we were actually impressed with the food. You won’t get the best meal of your life on any boat but this one was definitely better than we expected! And you get a bottle of wine for your table! Definitely worth the money!

We celebrated our 47th anniversary with style! What a wonderful evening. Very organized and service was exceptional. We paid extra for a table along the window so it was very intimate and worth the extra for the view. Our 3 course meal was really 4 courses - starter, entree, cheeses and desert. Each course was excellent, with a great presentation. The river cruise was spectacular and fun to see all the major sites at night. Highly recommend without hesitation. Easy access from the Eiffel Tower.

Was pleasantly surprised by this trip. The service was excellent, especially our waitress Sophia who was an absolute sweetheart. I would definitely advise to pay a bit more and get the table next to the window as it makes quite a difference. Very romantic and enjoyable trip to have a unique dinner experience.

Arrived a little early after a walk across Pairs. Great location at the base of the Eiffel Tower. We had a wonderful window seat and a terrific waitress (Nicolette from Poland/Paris). Food was really delicious as was the wine. Entertainment was also top notch and not over-bearing. The only negative for us was sitting by an outside door. It was December and a bit cool but much worse were the smokers going in and out. Overall though, totally worth the price.

This cruise was a perfect romantic end to our trip. The food is delicious, tiny portions, but overall enough food for each person. The wine was delicious and the views were superb. The boat ride is very smooth as if you are just gliding along. Highly recommended for couples and groups of friends!

To some people the price may seem a lot, but in our opinion a three course meal, two bottles of wine, a Kir cocktail each at the start and some small nibbles & a whole boat cruise is pretty decent for £100 each!

We booked the dinner cruise for 2nd January. It was stunning all throughout..

We both had the scallops with butternut squash and chestnuts & the steak with pomme purée & truffle. I had the chocolate & pear cake and my boyfriend had the passion fruit cake. Big shout out to our waiter Yousef- he was very attentive and made sure we were having a pleasant night.
