We both have no faults with this experience - you just have to look out the window and see the beautiful city that is Paris. Totally recommend, perfect for couples!

The dinner was delicious. The wine was very good. The service excellent. The Eiffel Tower at night.... magnificent.
There was not a “bad” seat on the boat. It was easy to book on line, and easy to find down by the river. I highly recommend this evening excursion.

We've been to Paris several times but had never taken a cruise of any kind on the Seine. We decided to book the Premier level dinner to celebrate the birthday of a friend we were traveling with. We all agreed the experience was excellent! What a great surprise. I would easily do this again on another visit. We had window seating and all wine and champagne included in our meal. The meal was much better than I had been led to believe from some of the reviews! I absolutely recommend that anyone do this on a trip to Paris.

Let me give you a word of advice if you're spending time in Paris: TAKE THIS DINNER CRUISE! It was awesome. We booked the front of the boat and were glad we did. Though there were others in the room it was like we were in a secluded area. Views of Paris were superb. The meal was fantastic! Wine and champagne tremendous. Very romantic.

We had the Privilege service which got us a window seat and all the wine we could drink but the highlight was cruising the Seine from light to twilight to dark and seeing all the sights lit up. Food and service top notch. I had screwed up and made the reservation for the next night but somehow they found us a table. Just a lovely evening. High class. Only issue was getting back to our hotel. You'd think cabs would know to be there but it was every man (or couple) for themselves as we all tried to grab a cab. I forgot that next time use Uber or Lyft

We booked the 8:30 dinner cruise knowing the views would be phenomenal after taking a daytime non meal cruise along the Seine on a previous trip to Paris.

We have done dinner cruises in several US cities where it was mostly about the scenery with totally unremarkable food. This cruise was unlike any we have experienced in the past. It was
a truly elegant gourmet feast that would rival any in an upscale restaurant in any city....and while a boat ride on the Seine during the day reveals the majesty of the landmarks, a trip along the Seine at night is an experience of a lifetime. The live music added to the ambiance. As we passed Notre Dame they sang a chill inspiring “Ave Maria” and “ A New York State of Mind” passing their Statue of Liberty”. The candlelight from the tables reflecting off the glass windows & ceiling combined with the lights from the landmarks on shore and other boats in the river to create a wonderland of colors and textures.

We walked down the stairs to the river landing just below the Eiffel Tower to book our cruise the day before we went.

This was even better than I expected it to be. I booked a premier seating (front of the boat) for the 8:30p cruise. I expected a nice meal with beautiful nighttime views of Paris along the Seine. It was instead an ELEGANT dinner with excellent service, BREATHTAKING views, and top quality entertainment. It probably seems cliché to read that the highlight of the evening was the boat parked in front of a glittering Eiffel Tower, with the Paris Statue of Liberty twin shining brightly alongside. But words fail when attempting to describe this spectacular culmination to a flawless evening. HIGHLY recommend!

Simply wonderful, but only for the Preimier front of boat to see the panarama of lighted bridges and sights, the side seating and back, not as good. Moreover the front has a 2 small outside balconies (the right one was closed), but you can go out for photos. Gets crowded, but be out there for the stature of liberty on the return. The cruise was magic, highlight of our trip (bujt don't miss Sanit Chapelle) food eh, it was okay.

The food was very good and the wait staff were courteous and attentive. The live music was enjoyable without being overwhelming. We paid for window seating and that made it all the more enjoyable as we had unobstructed views. We had a choice of starters, main course, and dessert. All were delicious.

The trip was a fabulous experience with excellent food, service, wine and ambience.

It is a wonderful way to see the sights was eating a great dinner.

However, I was very fortunate to be able to switch the cruise from the Friday to the Sunday evening as I was delayed at the airport and only arrived in Paris (minus my luggage) at 20.45.

I tried to phone Trip Advisor which was useless and when I spoke to the cruise operator they said they could not make changes without the authority from faceless Trip Advisor.

Fortunately the young lady spoke to a manager who approved the switch from Friday to Sunday evening!

I will never book through a faceless organisation again who rely solely on websites and email as it is useless in emergencies!!

Bravo to the Bateaux Parisiens for going the extra mile for me & my family!!!

Merci Beaucoup

Roy

I decided to book this ahead of arriving as we were celebrating our 30th wedding anniversary.
Just make sure you know where you are heading as the directions on the voucher are misleading so head for river seine and you will see the boats.
Very easy to do through trip advisor and no problems with the vouchers I had printed off.
It made our evening extra special with a beautiful setting, good food, good wine which was included (a pleasant surprise) lovely service by juicy and an excellent singer -she was great!
Really enjoyed the evening, prices but I would happily do it again. Thank you x

The cruise was excellent, smooth sailing on the Seine River. Live entertainment, delicious food, and a view of the sights along the river. We had a great time. I would recommend it, after a day of sight seeing it was nice to relax and enjoy the evening on the water. The cruise ended with a beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower with sparkling lights. Well worth the money.

Parisian review:

I want to summarize my experience by saying this place is absolutely unsafe for those with gluten allergies., I read the mixed reviews on this establishment before I booked. So I emailed the establishment to see if they could accommodate gluten allergies before I made my reservation. Their representative wrote back saying they have a gluten free menu. I made the reservation and emailed the representative again who confirmed that gluten free menus were added to our reservation.

We go to the boat for the night of the cruise, and they placed vegetarian menus on our reservation instead of gluten free menus. We alerted them of this mistake, and the receptionist assured me that we would receive gluten free menus. We were seated, and our waiter makes no mention of a gluten free menu, but he says that they can modify anything on the regular menu to make it gluten free.

So we place our orders. My wife has an extreme gluten sensitivity so we stressed to them the importance of having gluten free food. I even ordered gluten free that night as well to assure no confusion or cross-contamination. Well, the waiters and kitchen had no idea what gluten free meant. They brought me out a dish with pasta although I asked for gluten free food so I had them send it back. They proceeded to bring my wife out steak covered with gluten containing onion ring crumbs, and my wife had to educate them that it contained gluten so she sent it back. They brought back the meal with gravy (that likely was made with flour, and they could not assure us whether it was safe or not) two more times. We asked to speak to the manager who said the only thing she could eat was a vegetarian meal. We had to educate him that gluten free and vegetarian are two different things. We assured him that if he brought her a steak without the crumbs or gravy then the food should be safe.

For dessert, the waiters has told us that any dessert could be made gluten free so we placed orders. The waiter decided just to bring us cut up fruit instead to ensure my wife’s safety. We did appreciate that fact, but he should have been upfront about the limited dessert options from the beginning. We did file a complaint with the head receptionist when we finished. And I even sent an email to the complaint department. But no one has contacted us back. Overall, the wait staff was very friendly and the atmosphere was very nice. But this establishment misrepresented the fact that they could accommodate gluten allergies. I highly recommend for those with gluten allergies to stay away.

I took my sister to Paris from Australia for her 50th birthday. We had limited time and wanted to see as much as possible, yet still have amazing food and wine. This was a perfect option as we cruised downs the river, being able to see Paris in the evening and into the night, whilst having fantastic food and wine. We requested a window seat and top food and wine package. Service was excellent. For special occasions, just do it!!!!

My family enjoyed this river cruise. Expensive, but good food and service, a real Parisian experience. We booked the elite service, with seating in the middle of the boat, which is not ideal for seeing the sights. We couldn't see much other than the walls on either side of the river. I would recommend upgrading to be seated near the windows. Also, watch out for the hawkers on the docks, they are VERY aggressive. They don't ask you if you'd like to buy something, they just shove it at you and demand payment.

We booked the 8:30pm dinner cruise "Privilege Service" in order to sit directly at the window - I absolutely recommend Privilege Service - sitting at the window is really the whole point of this experience! I thought the meal itself would be very good, but it was absolutely excellent, truly! You have a menu from which to choose, ours was a four course meal, starter, main, cheese course and dessert. Wine, and it was very good wine, was included. The live music was very good and helped make this special evening even more so! And of course, the views, spectacular! You're given a map of the primary sites that we see along the way. The 8:30pm sailing time at this time of the year is perfect, as you start out in the full light, but then are on board for the sunset and then the full dark, thus being able to experience the City of Lights in all of the various light forms! A big thank you to our excellent server, Gail, lovely lady, top notch.

I was not in favor of spending a lot of euros on a dinner cruise, but my wife wanted to do it so, of course, we did. The boat is very modern and smooth in the water and, if you do it, I would recommend a window table. Yes, it costs more but you’re already spending a small fortune so what’s a little bit more? The food was good and everyone around us seemed to also enjoy their meals. But, let’s be honest, you’re not there for the food. There are plenty of Michelin starred restaurants in Paris you could go to for the same money, and this is certainly not on that level. You’re there for the experience of floating on the Seine and looking at all the people on the banks looking back at you, and to see the monuments lit up at night. For the “nighttime” experience, plan to take either the early or late dinner cruise, depending upon the time of year. Worth the money? Not for the food but maybe, if you’re there to create a memory of Paris.

We did the 6 course, window seat tour. For the cost I would recommend finding an alternative cruise with roof top deck access. Our service was great but the food was just okay and although the sites are amazing you’re looking through glass vs being outside with an opportunity for clear pictures of the amazing views you’re traveling by. After the tour plan on taking time to walk around the area, the Eiffel Tower is truly spectacular at night.

This is an elegant way to experience the romantic aspects of Paris. Dress up ( the French do) for a very special evening of wine, food and scenery . This is not your typical American sightseeing tour; rather it is full of elegantly turned out Europeans.

We did the 2.5 hour dinner cruise with front of the boat seating and we recommend this longer cruise with either the front or a guaranteed window table.

The food and service were both outstanding in every regard and we admit being pleasantly surprised by the quality and quantity of the wine. In addition to the champagne we were served full bottles of both a white and red wine - more than we could finish!

Our excited group of six were greeted with smiling faces at the boarding gate and given our passes. We were escorted to our table and proceeded to have a wonderful meal. Champagne followed by white wine, then followed up with wonderful reds complimented the food perfectly!
A very smooth ride, accompanied by music, dancing and meeting with other guests added to our pleasure. Service was outstanding, not obtrusive. Opportunity to have photos taken and chance to buy ( which we did) but were not pressured to do so.
This was our highlight during our 4 day visit to Paris. Recommend to anyone. Price very reasonable. Don't miss this opportunity.

Information leading up to the cruise was not very helpful. In our confirmation letter, we were told to go to dock #5 or #7. Upon arriving at dock $5, they told us to go to #7. We then went to dock #7 and were told to go to dock #6 for get on board for the tour. We almost missed the cruise because of this. Once safely aboard, we enjoyed the sites along the Seine River and this was the best part of the experience.

We found that the service was only mediocre. Our dinner was very late coming to the table. We had to send one entrée back because it was not prepared well (the chicken was cold and tough by the time it arrived). By the time we finished our entrees, we only had 5 minutes to enjoy dessert before we had to depart from the cruise. Overall, the dining experience is too rushed and the food was far from excellent.

We took the 2.5 hour dinner cruise that started at 8ish. It was absolutely fabulous. The food was terrific, there is live music, and seeing Paris at night is the way to do this. The whole city is lit up and you have a map that outlines everything you are seeing. It’s very smooth — we even turned around and didn’t know it. This is an absolute must.

It was a very nice evening , the food was ok not that fancy , the staff were friendly but it is not as fancy as expected but good for the value of money

Staff need to be more friendly and should be able to communicate better with tourists , language barrier was very clear

The overall tour was amazing and the sightseeing is great , I don’t know about the music , it was loud with everyone talking so I could hardly hear the singer

It also could use some organising

We have had the Premier Dinner Cruise twice now. We always get the PREMIER SERVICE which is a table in the front of the boat. Our table for two was along side of a huge glass wall which let us enjoy the unobstructed view of Paris during the dinner. The food is excellent. During our dinner there we two young ladies, one singing and the other playing the violin. Very romantic. The front of the boat is separate from the main area. Dinner for the Premier service includes a table at front of boat, two glasses of Champagne (one welcome glass and one with dessert) an appetizer + choice of starter + main dish + cheese + dessert, and a selection of fine wines. Check out the full menu on their web site. We decided on our dinner in advance. You will always remember this dinner.

The premier dinner also will get you escorted in before the rest of the people in the main area.

We chose to book the 8.30pm Dinner Cruise to celebrate our first wedding anniversary and are so pleased with our decision! The dock was easy to find and we were shown to our table efficiently. We chose the Privilege service so that we would have 2 window seats as I'm not sure how much you would see if you were in the middle of the boat. The food was to a higher standard than I expected, delicious and a good choice and we had plenty of wine (ticket included a glass of champagne to start) We absolutely loved the cruise and it was a great way to see parts of Paris we hadnt had a chance to get to yet accompanied by live music and good service.
I am really disappointed. I couldn’t go on the cruise because of the rain and didn’t get a refund…..

We were booked for dinner cruise in Paris On Bastile Day for 3 of us at a cost of Euro 70/- each. We were told to reach between 5pm To 6 Pm but unfortunately we lost our way due to the confusing nature of instructions given to us . It took us about one hour & half to reach the designated spot only to find that aprox 1200 ppl were waiting to Board four vessels . We were told by one of the staff members that since they are already full we cannot be allowed to Board and we should come back the next day. Imagine our surprise and disappointment on hearing this. After all the effort we took to book in advance , pay in advance and reach the departure area after so much trouble , to be told to piss off!! No effort made by any staff member to accommodate us , to sympathise and give us some slack….??? No !!! We cannot !!! Just Go!!!!
Upon calling customer care and speaking to Mr Ken, who told us to go back again and he would ensure that we would board, we trudged our way back to Gare Pont D’Alma only to be told by the staff there that there was no way they could allow us to Board today and they didn’t have time to speak to us as well !!!
So that was that ! We went back extremely disappointed with our overall experience and we RECOMMEND our friends and anyone else who reads that to PLEASE DONT USE THIS COMLANY IN THE FUTURE.

My husband and I planned this dinner cruise as our anniversary dinner. We enjoyed this experience very much! I've read other reviews that said the food was average--yes, I've had better, but I still thought it was very good-more than average. We were treated with care by our waiter. It was all very tasty and we ate items we would not normally eat (foie gras, for example). We aren't big wine drinkers, but the kir was very good! I ended up ordering that at every restaurant for the rest of our trip. The baba was also excellent.

The cruise is not narrated, but you are given a map of the sites. It's more of a low key sightseeing experience, so if you are expecting a step-by-step narration of the sites, look elsewhere. I enjoyed the more low key atmosphere of this experience.
There is a musician on board and her lovely voice gave just the right atmosphere to the dining and experience.

Of course, the highlight of the evening was seeing the Eiffel Tower light up for the night! There are many excellent opportunities for photos, even if you do not sit at the outside windows. We moved around to take pictures when we wanted, as did everyone else.

I recommend this for those wanting a quiet sightseeing evening, with good food, and music.

Not worth it!

Awful! Don’t recommend
This is the worst expensive experience I’ve ever had !!!!
there was NO LIVE MUSIC, and the service was awful.

The price may seem steep but is great value for money, great service very helpful, isn't the most romantic setting and the say there is a dress code but saw people in very casual wear so don't worry about that.

Great food great views

Very lovely. Fun for the whole family. Food was more advanced than my kids, ages 5-8, wanted but that just meant more for me. My kids ate bread, but I suggest bringing some snacks for kids if they aren't adventurous eaters.

My trip was cancelled at the last minute due to the Coronavirus travel ban to Europe. I immediately contacted Bateaux Parisiens to see what my options were. I understand I could not receive a refund because it was within the 10-day window. However, I am completely frustrated that they were unwilling to allow me to re-book for a future dinner cruise after August 2020. I asked if they could give me a longer window and was told no. Absolutely every other vendor I am working with has been flexible in light of these extraordinary circumstances. I wasn't asking for a refund, just a chance to reschedule for March 2021. I am very upset that they weren't even willing to consider this option.

The Moulin Rouge said no refund, but I could re-book anytime in the next 24 months. La Cuisine Cooking School said no refund, but I could re-book by December 31st and use my credit for March of 2021. I just don't see why Bateaux Parisiens is being so inflexible. I am willing to re-book. I just can't do it on their timeline.

So, buyer beware. If anything goes wrong that is out of your control they will be inflexible, rude, and greedy with taking your money and giving you nothing in return!!!

I wish there was a negative star option. I can’t tell you how the dinner or the cruise was because it never happened. We showed up at the dock to be informed that the boat had a “mechanical problem” so dinner would be eaten on the boat at the dock and then they wanted to give us tickets for a separate sight seeing cruise later that evening “subject to availability” and at a much later time than we were booked for. When we asked for a refund, we were rudely given a business card with an email address and told that we would have to email our request and there was no guarantee of a refund. To add insult, when we complained, the two woman who were checking people in laughed at us. When I asked them what was so funny, they simply kept laughing and said “have a good night.” We made alternative plans and managed to have a great night in Paris despite this vendor. Terrible experience and I was shocked because I booked through Viator as I had done many times in the past and, until this night, they’ve been reliable. Horrible and rude.

What an amazing experience from the beginning to the end. Everyone was so nice and helpful. The food was great and seeing Paris at night, there is nothing like it. If you are a couple you have to do this.

I booked a river dinner cruise for valentines day in Paris. I booked through Viator. Upon arrival at the port I was advised that the river dinner cruise at 6.15pm on valentines day DID NOT EXIST.!!!!! so I was left with nothing to do on valentines day when I had spent a lot of money travelling to Paris. You ruined my valentines. I spent 2.5hours on the phone to customer service, who did not offer me any alternative plans/dinners/tours so I was left with no plans! Viator were negligent in selling me something which does not exist.
I am having to resort to writing this review on TripAdvisor because Viator refuse to provide me with details of how to make a compliant and details of their complaints department.
Bad and incompetent customer service!

Our group loved every minute of this cruise. The food was delicious, the singers were great and the views were amazing. My only con was that I thought the top of the boat was glass, our section was not, and I would have loved to have seen through the ceiling.

Had done this tour before for lunch. Did the night cruise this time. Both are very good. The food options are good. Wine is great.
Our waitress seemed to be in a bad mood, but the service was good.
Worth doing.
Overall this was a pretty decent dinner cruise. The boat is very new and clean. The food is pretty decent and the service was too. They do hand you a map, so that you can see what you are crossing.
Easy to book, food is high quality considering mass transportation for tourist, I was surprissed in the good sens. My invitees were delighted.
This Seine River dinner cruise was absolutely worth it, great views, great vibes, great food. Loved it.
Food awful, no commentary on what sights you are cruising past, total waste of money and then when i sent in complaint no response to this
Acknowledging the great empathy and fairness shown by both Bateaux Parisienne and TripAdvisor when we unfortunately missed a pre-booked cruise due to the strikes in Paris. We will be back. Thank you.

The food, atmosphere, sights and service made this boat trip a real must for anyone visiting Paris.
The views were amazing and was complimented by the outstanding food and wine we had.

Food was good and service great BUT....Unlike all of the photos, the boat did not have any glass roof, only windows. We were seated on an inside table (center of boat, not a window seat) and saw nothing from our table other than the riverbank. This was a very expensive cruise and we were disappointed by the lack of any views from the boat. It was very cramped as well.

Not sure how we lucked out getting a boat with no view and a non-window table.

Me and my fiancé booked the privilege service and I’m so so happy we did! We shared 2 bottles of wine and 2 glasses of champagne. We were pretty tipsy by the end lol. The service was very attentive and friendly. Our server Flo (sp?) was so so nice! He made us feel very comfortable. Food was fantastic. The photographer came by and took photo’s of us right as we were passing by the Eiffel Tower! Pictures were 20 euros a copy which I was happy to pay for those amazing shots she got of us. We werent able to take the boat north on the river because of water level so they gave us free tickets to a sight seeing cruise to compensate which was very nice. If we return to Paris in the future I will definitely be booking this cruise again!

We greatly enjoyed this croisière sur la Seine. The food was delicious, the wine was good, the service excellent and the atmosphere very pleasant. It was one of the best meals we had in Paris. We highly recommend it!
The boat is excellent the service brilliant I have marked down only because the food to me was disappointing and the boat didn’t do the cruise planned due to the high water.
The cruise was lovely and the food was gorgeous. Waiter service was second to none and was very romantic for mine and my girlfreinds first holiday away would highly recommend to anyone.
Food is good and service is excellent! Comes with entertainment, the singers were talented and performed well. The Seine is magical at night!
Excellent food, excellent service. Worth the expense and at night it is so romantic and IF you are lucky, there will be marriage proposals made on bent knee nearby! A birthday or two or more as well.

This is an amazing experience and one of the best thing that you can do in Paris. Amazing service, very tasty food and extremely professional. We truly enjoyed. Thank you Bateaux Parisiens and we will meet again!

My fiance and I enjoyed a romantic dinner cruise around the Seine River, thanks to Bateaux Parisiens. The food was incredible and thoughtful. There was Christmas music playing in the background, and we had the view of the Eiffel Tower lit up. We got to catch the 5-minute light show of the Eiffel Tower which was cool.

I started with the poached egg, Jerusalem artichoke mousseline with grilled bacon and red wine reduction jus, followed by the parsnip cottage pie-style duck in orange sauce, and ended with the poached pear with black berries and pear sorbet. All of it was delicious!

Would absolutely recommend for anyone celebrating something special or just wants to enjoy a nice evening out in Paris.

We arrived at the Bateaux de Parisienne just on time for our evening dinner cruise... When we sat on the boat and watched the ride passed a well lit Eiffel Tower it was a special moment for both of us... This capped off a night for a birthday surprise... Beautiful, serene and unforgettable..
Was a memorable romantic cruise dining experience for my husband and myself . Great live music , amazing cruise dining experience with great foods .

My husband and I have been very fortunate to have dined is some wonderful places. But this Dinner/River Cruise was the best! Not only was the service over the top, each course was fantastic. Usually there is something lacking, not in this experience. We will be talking and reminiscing about our experience forever.

The entire experience was very special. We were in awe of the sites along the way. Food and service were top notch and the live music was also enjoyable. Loved the older tunes and not so much the newer up tempo music...it didn’t fit. Great value for the money. I would do it again next time I return to Paris.

Booked a romantic river cruise for my partner as it was her birthday, and wow what a fabulous time we had. The service, food and the great views of Paris at night made for a very memorable experience and I would highly recommend this when you visit Paris.

I asked my girlfriend to marry me on 8:30 tour and she said yes. Food was delicious (specially the seabass) and I even took a photo of the red wine (to have again). The view was beautiful and the onboard singer made this about the best ever for us. Thank you

What an amazing way to spend a romantic evening in Paris! The boats are well organised with boarding swift and clear. Our wait staff were attentive and warm. The menu was varied with many options of food and drinks. The boat had gorgeous views, live music, opportunities for going outside and a lovely ambience.

The food itself was nice although not amazing. Wine was flowing freely and the courses were well spaced out. We had a really wonderful time embracing the sights of Paris by night through the clear glass windows and beautiful music being played.

A couple things to add would be that they would really benefit from steak knives as the meat was a little tough to cut with basic knives! Additionally they offer professional photographs for €20 which is a little pricey but worth it for the experience, however I think if they offered price packages for multiple purchases we would have been inclined to buy 2 photos instead of 1 and they would’ve made a wee bit more money.
My husband and I had a fantastic experience! The food was delicious and the service is perfect! We would definitely book this again.

We boarded the dim-lighted, well-furnished Onyx boat, which offered gorgeous views of the Parisian city from the Seine river. The French music entailed talented musicians performing gorgeous, romantic music, which certainly set a magical vibe throughout the boat. There are professional photographers on board ready to take and show you your pictures. However, in order to keep the printed photos, you must pay a price of (I believe) $20 for each printed photo -- not worth it in my opinion. The food tasted and looked mediocre. The food was probably the least impressive aspect of the boat tour. Overall, I had a fantastic time with my date on this event.

After sightseeing around crowded Paris all day, this comfortable and romantic dinner cruise was just what we needed. The food was not fabulous but it was good, service was attentive, and after dinner we enjoyed our glide down the Seine with everything lit up in the City of Lights. Watch for the Eiffel Tower lights to sparkle, on the hour after dark.

We booked this for a dinner cruise. The process of booking and boarding was easy. We had a window seat which was quite nice for viewing. The food though - most of it was unrecognizable by us Americans. I couldn't eat the appetizer - cold fish soup. The main course was just OK (some kind of fish - at least it was warm!). The dessert was the best of the evening! If we had to do it again, we would just take the cruise and skip the dinner part!

We had booked a trip to cap off a wonderful European vacation with our elderly parents. We suffered unimaginable delays due to street rioting in our attempt to get to the dock on time, in spite of leaving our apartment 90 minutes before our scheduled departure. The closest subway is a 20 minute walk to the dock which wasn't an option with our octogenarian parents. I called the office 4 times along our journey to explain that road after road was closed due to protesters. The first time I begged to rebook but they said we should continue our journey as we should be able to make it. One time our wonderful taxi driver spoke to their staff to explain and beg them to either change our reservation or hold the boat for a mere couple of minutes. We were told that as long as we made it to the dock at 8:30 it would be ok by the company representatives. When we arrived at 8:35 the boat had left and the rude people at the dock acted as if we were just lazy and incapable of making it on time. Our taxi driver was almost in tears she was so upset for us. The staff at the dock said we needed to be there by 8:15 and that everyone else seemed to get there on time. They did not care in the slightest. It is quite clear that there is NO communication between the phone reps and the arrogant folks that work the dock.

The next morning I called the office again. I finally reached a compassionate human being who was willing to put us on a lunch cruise on our last day, but unfortunately refused to refund the difference in cost which was quite a large amount of money. I wrote a lengthy letter to the customer service representative but they never even bothered to respond. Now that it has been over a month since our experience I feel confident that they truly do not care. Therefore I cannot recommend them. There are plenty of companies that offer the same service. Bateaux Parisiens is replaceable.

My boyfriend and I had the best time at the river dinner. We did not realize how much food they would give us. The three-course meal was phenomenal and to top it off we also received one bottle of white wine and one bottle of red wine. We ordered a bottle of champagne to top off the meal. The staff was very helpful and made you feel welcomed. The different attractions you got to see during the cruise was one of the best parts. So grateful we got to experience this. The next time we come to Paris we will definitely do this again.
Loved the dinner river cruise food was good and the sights were amazing. The only negative was it didn't have beer included in the drinks package

I would highly recommend this trip to anyone visiting Paris, it really made our trip that extra bit special. We paid the extra for the window seat privilege service which was worth the money in my opinion. It states 3 course but technically could be classed as a 5 course meal by the time everything is served up. The wine was also excellent with white wine being served with starters and red along with the mains and the cheese board. Staff were very attentive and professional. The service was outstanding. A must do trip whilst in Paris!

We did the 8:30 dinner cruise. Everything was wonderful... the food, service, two singers. We had inner seats because we chose to have less food included and the views were still good. They ended up moving us to an open window table (without us asking) and that view was good too. After a while of constant wine refills and rolls, we started to laugh at how efficient the servers were and had to turn them away. Be prepared to be photographed by a photographer! We did not expect it and then they give you six prints, hoping you'll purchase them. We felt guilty saying no but we had already had the waiter take some good ones of us and those were free.

This was a lot of fun. The staff was very helpful and friendly. The food was delicious and with so many courses there was plant to fill us up. Our waiter was awesome informative, friendly and entertaining. We went after nightfall and it was so beautiful to see Paris in this way.

This tour was one of the highlights of our family trip that took us from Munich to Normandy to Paris in 10 days. Our nighttime cruise began and ended under the lights of the Eiffel Tower on the Seine. The dress was nice casual and we got lucky with the weather -- i.e., no rain and no low clouds blocking our views from the see-through glass boat. There was a wonderful female singer and live music on the late evening cruise that added to the festive atmosphere. The music was neither loud nor intrusive in any way to our dinner conversations. The food and service was outstanding. My family could not have had a more delightful evening. I do recommend paying a little extra for the window seats, which we did. It was well worth it. A night that our family will remember forever.

Excellent. That's the main word. We booked a table with the 8.30 Privilege service and it was perfect. Just two of us. Great view over Paris at night. The service and the food was really good. Live music. Everything was perfect. Highly recommended
Book this. Book a window seat. Totally worth it. Enchanting experience! While it might seem pricey, it will be the highlight of your trip.

The cruise was awesome and the view from the boat was great. The food was good, the singer and the music were nice. the boat is covered by glass from sides and top which protects from rains and allow a good view. the cruise was full which resulted in high noise. It is highly recomended to have such a cruise if you are in Paris

This was a great was to see parts of Paris at night along the Siene and eating food food too! Although it's technically a 3-course meal, it's actually a 5-course meal... Amuse-bouche, appetizer, main, cheese, and dessert. Wine and champagne were included, however we're not drinkers and soda was substituted for no charge. I would be happy to do this again!

As first time visitors, a cruise along the Seine was a must. Seeing the beauty of Paris nightlife while afloat really added to our spectacular vacation. The views of the surroundings were excellent and literally all around us, The music from the band was very nice and added to the fun atmosphere. The event was well managed and seating organized and comfortable, staff attentive. There were no empty seats. Without question a must do if your budget allows. Professional photos taken on board were a bit pricey but a wonderful memory of the night and they looked great! I would definitely recommend this for all visitors!

This experience for me was one of the nicest things I've ever done, From start to finish I was literally speechless. We paid for the window seat and it was definitely worth the money, I'd say the best views of paris from the river and the eifel tower looks stunning. If you are looking for romance or even just a nice experience with friends, this will be perfect for you.

The Bateaux Parisiens Seine River Dinner Cruise capped off our vacation with style. The food and wine were exquisite. The service impeccable. The atmosphere was festive. The views of the city from the river were romantic. This was a world class excursion. Don't miss the chance to enjoy it.

The ambiance and experience is great but the food is mediocre.

A romantic boat ride on the river. You will pass by many of the must see venues of Paris. The only issue is the food is quite mediocre at best.

Despite the rain we had a lovely ride and saw the night “sights” that we couldn’t have possibly completed on foot ( or Metro!). We were treated well...smooth sailing, good food, warm staff...a perfectly lovely evening.

We had the 8:30 pm dinner cruise with champagne. The boat was easy to find at the base of the Eiffel Tower. The dinning room is enclosed in glass. Since the rain was light, that was great. They even provide a map with the major attractions along the cruise. There are different selections for the courses and you can purchase the different levels. Plus live music. Seating can be a little tight, but everyone just moves around to accommodate. The food presentation is excellent and taste outstanding. The wait staff is very efficient and friendly. Wine is included. At night it might be hard to see some of the sites, but the food is the main attraction.

Have visited Paris a number of times but never done a boat cruise until this visit. I wasn’t sure what to expect but the boat was beautiful, well appointed, comfortable seats and glass all around to make the most of the views. Service was also great. The food was mixed, my husband seemed to pick a great entree and main (the fish pie and beef cheek) while I was really disappointed in my choice of the prawns and salmon (the latter drowned in cream). It would have been great if the waiters explained the menu to us more rather than leaving it so much to chance! The chocolate dessert was lovely. I would also have liked staff to give us more commentary on the places we were going past, especially some lesser known facts.

Paris at night is magical, and cruising down the Seine dining and listening to music is such a lovely way to experience that magic. Even the rain enhanced the sparkle. I highly recommend you pay the extra to get a window view. It's totally worth it. Also, please note that one glass of champagne is included in your package. However, if you want additional wine or cocktails, you will pay for them, just so you know. The food is delicious and the wine choices were very good as well.

This dinner cruise is worth the price. The food is delicious, the service is friendly and professional, the views are stunning, and the entertainment is quality. Don't miss this incredible opportunity.

Amazing evening . Took the 8pm dinner cruise and watched the sun set . Wonderful food and alcohol and great entertainment creating a fab atmosphere. Defiantly recommend for special occasions or a date night . More of a adults setting than a place for children !

Our daughter bought us this trip as an anniversary gift and it was a lovely experience. Food was delicious. Staff were so friendly. The views obviously were superb. The boat was immaculate. Overall a lovely evening.

My friends and I really enjoyed the dinner cruise. It was the best way to end our trip in Paris. It was so relaxing, staff were awesome, food tasted great. I just wished we had a chance to sit by the window and not in the middle of the room. But since there was 3 of us, and the window seats were set for 2 people, we had to sit in the middle area.
View was still great from there though.

A wonderful evening dining as you cruise the seine. My wife and I choose the Premier experience which means we had a table for 2 along the window. The food exceeded my expectations and I was surprised that we were offered 2 full bottles of wine( one white and one red) during the course of the evening to go along with our welcome champagne. Nothing could be more romantic then cruising along the sites of Paris.

The Bateaux Parisiens Seine River Dinner Cruise was very nice. Check in was easy, the boat was nice, and the service outstanding. The food was as to be expected on a dinner cruise - it was fine, but not outstanding. But - we weren't there for the food; we were there to experience the Seine and Paris by night. The wine was surprisingly good and did not require us to upgrade. We did pay to have a seat by the window and felt it was well worth it. It was a great way to spend out last evening in Paris!

We did the evening sightseeing trip with a six course taster menu and live music and it was one of the the highlights of our trip.

The food was stunning, our waiter was so friendly, the views were spectacular and the wine was plentiful! The whole evening was very romantic and I'd highly recommend it to anyone visiting Paris.

The service was top notch and I had a great time! I expected to hear about the famous landmarks passed during the cruise, but I guess someone talking on a loud speaker would have ruined the ambience. They did mess up on my food order , but it was rectified within minutes.

The views weren’t all that great, but it was a wonderful experience. I’d recommend this cruise to anyone
My partner and I couldn’t have loved this experience anymore!!! The food, views, drinks and service were spot on. Would highly recommend doing this whilst in Paris.

Just experienced a dinner cruise on the Siene River. The boat was first class, the live music was fabulous (although not sure why the two gals couldn't have sung throughout the 2 hours evening). Food was fabulous and the sights were never-ending. We enjoyed it and paying extra for window seats and alcohol included was worth it...in our opinion.

Cruise was amazing. Food was very good (we had 3 courses which was plenty!
Not only did we have champagne, but one bottle of white wine and one of red. We had a blast with our English next table neighbors!

Booked an Evening Dinner Cruise, with an outside table for a perfect view of the sites at night. The boat was spacious, comfortable and had a feeling and ambience of class and luxury. We were warmly welcomed, given a glass of Champagne when seated and we had live music throughout the evening. The food and wine was delicious, with excellent service and never rushed. This was possibly the favourite part of our entire Paris trip, a truly memorable event that lived up to hope and expectations.
I reached out several weeks prior to the event regarding dietary needs and they communicated back to me and we’re accommodating. A lovely evening on the water with beautiful views of Paris at night!

Lovely evening celebrating our Parent's 50th Anniversary. This is an expensive dinner - but nice for a celebration. The food was kinda disappointing - It was ok - but nothing compared to the meals you would expect in Paris. You are paying for the experience. Wine and live entertainment was very good. We had a window seating and really enjoyed all of the views.....but mostly we enjoyed being outside on the little landing taking photos! It was nice to do once....won't do it again.
Good time. Good service. Great view of the city. All around solid choice to have a nice meal and a good time. Would recommend booking this.

This was our second time here after a visit 8 years ago. You are warmly welcomed an upd once on board the on board music was great and singer good. Wine was included a which meant we drunk a bottle of white and a bottle of red between us , and the food although small portions was very tasty. They will offer you a photo of your trip but 20 euros for a picture I think is a bit too expensive. A very enjoyable evening in lovely Paris.

We got the tour at 8:30pm to see the Eifell Tower lit and since this is our first time in Paris, we would like to see the City of Lights at night! This is such a great tour from start to finish! The food was nothing short of delicious! This is the tour for everyone who wants to rekindle their romance! Our server was excellent and attentive to our needs. Overall, I would defintely recommend this tour!

Phenomenal time:
Dinner cruise on the Seine; was a great way to see Paris from the water. The ambiance and food were amazing; it is definitely worth the money.

Excellent!!!
No words to describe the beautiful night.
The food was delicious , the environment superb.
Great musicians and singers .
The service is super nice.
Definitely we will do it again.
We took the dinner cruise around 6 PM beautiful scenery from the boat well worth the trip the crew is fabulous. One of the highlights of our vacation

As this is the second review - Trip Advisor löst the first in cyberspace! - it will be shorter. Wonderful night. We paid for the Premier service and had a special area with great views and pleasant ambiance, great food (not Michelin-starred but good restaurant quality) and abundant good quality wine included. Not an inexpensive cruise but most enjoyable, including the jazz vocalist. Not the fault of the cruise operators but organise your return pickup in advance. €13 to get there and it took 45 mins to find cab who would take us back to hotel for less than €40! Just be careful not to let greedy drivers spoil an excellent night.

My husband and I took this dinner cruise two weeks ago and all I can say is we should have done it so much sooner! Of all of the things we did in Paris, this was definitely a highlight!
From the moment we arrived, we were greeted by such friendly and helpful staff. Our waiter went above and beyond to make our night perfect.
We started with champagne and delicious appetizers. In fact, everything we ate was AMAZING! And with our package (service privilege) we received 2 full bottles of wine with dinner! That’s a win in my book!
Live music and gorgeous Parisian night views from our private window table made this an evening we will never forget!
If you are contemplating taking this cruise, just book it!!

Took a sightseeing cruise after the sunset. Beautiful view of the Eiffel Tower and other sites at night. The ride was smooth and comfortable. Lasted an hour and took you under several bridges on the Seine. The only complaint is that you have to use your smartphone to access the tour commentary. It took a bit to connect and sometimes slow, plus you are using your battery for an hour. Would have liked the commentary to be given over the boat's speaker. We ended up not listening to the commentary.

The experience we had on Bateaux Parisiens Seine River Dinner Cruise was a 10. From the moment we set foot upon the vessel and were greeted by courteous gentlemen, and led to our private table for two, to the special gluten free meal they provided for my celiac disease, to the glass domed sides & top which allowed all to enjoy the passing skyline as the sunset came & we drank wine & champagne & ate a delicious 4 course meal while listening to live music. It was a very romantic evening which included a photo to remember it by & the perfect ending just in time to disembark while the eiffel tower sparkled.

Went on this trip last night and it was fantastic. I went with my 20yr old daughter and we had such a good time. The food was really good, I had fois gras to start, with veal and then a chocolate nougat pudding. There was loads of wine, both red and white plus kir royal on arrival. We didn't pay for a window seat but we're very close and could see easily. It was moderately expensive (E90 each) but we both thought well worth it.

I was nervous because of the mixed reviews that I had heard about these touristy river cruises but I was not disappointed. It was indeed expensive but the food was decent, the music was good and the view was great. So happy I gave it a try for a different view of Paris. Our table was not directly at the window but in the next row closest to the window and we had a very good view.
The dinner cruise was the first thing we did when we got into Paris. We enjoyed a wonderful meal and then went outside and enjoyed the sights of Paris all lit up.

We ended our week-long trip to Paris on this dinner cruise along the Seine. Even in the rain it was a wonderful time. The food was very good. The service (our server, JusMarie, I believe) was attentive, friendly and helpful. The views of Paris were amazing from the river. We had a wonderful time.

Lovely dinner, the food was good the live music was very nice the service was EXCELLENT! The actual cruise was very nice. If you are a couple I would recommend you go all out and opt for the “front of the boat option” but if you are a family I would consider an inner table. For children at dinner there is a discount rate (to the already cheaper) inner table. However for the front table adults and children are all the same 200 euros a person. So for a group of 7 it was rather expensive. However after spending a eight days in Paris including 3 days in Disney this dinner was one of the 5 top highlights for each and everyone one of us including the four children!

We did the 20h30 cruise and It was absolutely f@&cking amazing. I knew it was gonna be good but nothing could prepare me for how amazing it really was. This should be on everyone’s to-do list. One of the most amazing experiences we have had.

A very enjoyable evening. The service was great and the food was very good.

I booked this for our first night in Paris and i enjoyed every minute of it.

This event completely exceeded our expectations. The onboard service was superb and the food was outstanding - add in the live music and incredible views and you have an unforgettable evening. Loved it!

We thoroughly enjoyed our dinner cruise. You float by beautiful landmarks while eating. Classy atmosphere, delicious food and drinks. Friendly staff (but do wish that they didn’t have to hurry around- made the mood a bit hectic). The singer 🎵🎶 was absolutely beautiful and talented.

Downsides: It was very very hot even though it was air conditioned.
We were annoyed with the photographer trying to get people to pose for pictures while eating. They should let people onto the pontoon a little early and get the photo while entering the boot. Getting the tickets were a bit old fashioned. The flower men out front (and everywhere around the Eiffel Tower) are also very annoying.
Could not have been better really, food was excellent and service first rate... well worth the treat. Great seeing Paris from the water...

The cruise itself was wonderful. There is nothing like Paris at night. Got a chance to see some magnificent sites, including the Eiffel Tower lit at night. A beautiful experience. The meal however, left a lot to be desired. I had the duck and it was tough and hard to eat and digest. Service was good for the number of people. Waiters were attentive and polite.

Highly recommend for anyone have not done any dinner Cruise on Seine River yet.

1st Star - Great cruise. Neat and luxury looking.

2nd Star - Perfect speed and enough time for checking out everything along Seine River.

3rd Star - Amazing service. Our server was very funny and professional. My water glass was never empty till I stopped him. :)

4th Star - Excellent food. We had three courses and we emptied every single plate.

0.5th Star - The wine was not the best...

Well, nothing is perfect. After all, I still highly recommend this event, with Bateaux Parisiens of course!

Paris France, great and viator with
Great people helping being involved,
Making sure things go well is more than we could have asked for. We
Will always use TripAdvisor in
The future.
Thanks
Food was good, Entertainment was good, it was fun to see Paris from the river then as it got dark, see it all lite up.

Went on this to celebrate 35yrs of being married. The dress code said formal. As there was a heatwave I emailed to see if this had been relaxed, to which they said still no shorts or sandals.

So we were shocked to see many men wearing shorts and T-shirt’s. One made even had flip flops on.

Most diners were smartly dressed tho.

The cruise itself was first class. Good to see all the famous landmarks especially as it got dark. The Eiffel Tower was amazing!!

Lovely atmosphere with the live band.

We enjoyed the food and courses well spaced out.

The staff were all very smart and courteous.

At the end of the cruise we came off to see the Eiffel Tower in full sparkles.

We would highly recommend this for a romantic special occasion.

I pre-booked our tickets for my husband’s birthday evening. Tickets and information clearly explained timings, attire, menu and drinks that would be included in the evening cruise which started promptly at 8pm.
There was live music from singers and electric violinist which added to the ambience of the evening.
It was a smart attire event and lovely to see the guests arriving dressed for the occasion, it felt special.
Great to see the iconic landmarks from
the Seine and how they lit up as it got darker - especially the Eiffel Tower at the end of the evening.
The food was of good standard, the drinks lovely and special mention should be made to the onboard photographer - you are not obliged and no pressure to buy.
We would recommend this evening cruise dinner.

We took the 8:30 pm dinner cruise with Bateaux Parisiens and enjoyed it very much. We visited Paris during the recent heat wave and it was a nice way to see the city at night while escaping the heat. There were two singers performing in French and English during the cruise. The food was enjoyable and a different wine was served with each course. Dessert and coffee completed the meal. Definitely recommend this cruise if it is in your budget.

Very wrong tour - very expensive and does not deserve to be taken into consideration. It’s a simple boat ride with a “make believe” Fancy dinner and a bottle of wine.

Food was not good

Service from staff was friendly

But it simply can be much better —
A wonderful way to see the city and eat awesome food. One of my kids had severe allergies and the cruise worked with us.

This was such a surreal experience! My teen daughter and I took the later dinner cruise. It was such beautiful scenery with great food and great staff! There was a singer that had an amazing voice that sang throughout the cruise. I had read a few reviews that said that they felt dinner was rushed. I did not feel that way at all! It was perfectly timed so that you got to enjoy each course through out the ride. As corny as it sounds, it felt like we were in the scene of a movie. The staff was absolutely adorable! Can't give this enough stars!!!

My girlfriends I did the cruise for my birthday celebration and it was nice. Our waiter was excellent and the ambiance was great. The live band was great too. The food was edible. You are definitely not paying for the food. Overall we had a good time. The boat moves slow Enron to see tour surroundings but the only thing worth seeing is the Eiffel Tower lit.

Excelent food and wine, excelent service.
An unforgetable experience !
All details of departure location were very precise.

We booked ourselves for the Premier Class of Dinner Cruise .... which is the highest and supposed to be at the front of the boat .... it was an overall great experience wherein you get to see the sights of Paris without having to walk .... the food was just about average .... the sights get better at the darkness comes and the Eiffel tower is lit up .... the boat is a bit crowded ...even in Premier class and has too much noise .... but a good trip nonetheless. A bit overpriced at over 200 euros per head

Cruise worth the price-did 8:30 seating-food/service/singer-all excellent-paid for premier section-which was worth price as you have own table and excellent view-you can go outside between meal and desert-try to be quick if going outside-as outside viewing area small and quickly crowded-wished I’d organized a ride home-we had to walk 4 ages to get a metro home

The dinner cruise at night is a must-do for anyone visiting Paris. Everything is beautiful at night and the food was tasty. Perfect for a romantic date, family, or group. Tables are a bit close together but it still feels intimate.
A truly wonderful time and worth the price of admission. Perfect for couples who want great views, excellent food, and a unique experience in Paris.

Lovely service and view. The food exceeded our expectation for a dinner cruise and all was as promised. Do plan to be there at the beginning of the boarding process as there are several boats and it may take a moment to find yours.

When booking at the window, we have a lifetime, unique and unrepeatable dinner. Every meal and drink was impeccable, I would highlight the snail cake that has no match. The whole way is pleasant music, which is even more enchanted. amusing at the sights of Paris. It is an incredible experience, not cheap but it is well worth the investment.
What an amazing night out. Live singers brilliant. Food and wine superb staff very friendly definitely a put on your to do list when in Paris
Wonderful experience! The service, food, sights, live entertainment and ambiance were impeccable. Bravo!

What a great way to celebrate our 30th wedding anniversary. Great dinner and beautiful scenery on the evening dinner cruise. Really got to see the city lights, the staff was wonderful, a dinner band, a very fun evening. I would recommend it to anybody

So glad we disregarded the bad reviews. We did the “premier” seating for our 40th anniversary dinner. It was wonderful from start to finish. Extremely warm and attentive service from everyone from coat check to maître d’ to wait staff. Our waitress Manon was charming and very helpful. Food/wine were 7.5 on a scale of 10; no complaints here. Live music and singer, but low key and not in your face — pleasant addition to the ambience. And the sightseeing was magnificent- they wisely let the spectacular nighttime beauty of Paris speak for itself. This was the end of 4 weeks in Paris for us, but we felt like we were seeing it for the first time. The cruise went from Eiffel Tower area to well beyond Notre Dame and then all the way back beyond ET to the Statue of Liberty replica. It lasted a leisurely 2.5 hours and, while the wine surely helped, we left feeling we’d had an exceptional and memorable experience. Expensive but worth it.

The total package. We had never thought to view Paris at night from the river and a friend recommended this dinner cruise. We are now highly recommending to you. French singers excellent service and just the right length of time. Would do it again on our next visit.
Major highlight of our stay in Paris. It's a must do! The view and the food were outstanding. Couldn't have been more pleased! Just do it!

This was the biggest disappointment of our trip to Paris. The service was awful. When we did finally get our appetizer it was literally thrown on our table as the staff ran by the table. The food was well below average. As a vegetarian they served me the same exact food for the main course as rhe served me for the appetizer. Exact same just different bowl. My husband’s fish was drowned in sauce. Alao it is very hot in the boat and there was no air. People were fanning themselves for air. The views are pretty once it gets dark. This is a total waste of a lot of money.

Well worth the "privilege" option. First time to Paris and thought why not? Friendly staff, excellent food. The boat was modern, an expanse of glass and movement was barely imperceptible. After dinner take pics of the Eiffel tower outside at the stern of the boat.

Great introduction to Paris on the lovely Seine. Food was delicious and service was awesome. The only hiccup we had was we missed the last RER train and had to take an expensive taxi as we didn’t want to wander around an unknown area late at night.

Can't speak highly enough. Great food and wine (didn't need to purchase any extra drinks) excellent service, very friendly and even though you might be seated in the centre of boat, you still get a great view of Paris at night. Little expensive but worth the cash.
We booked a weekend lunch cruise for our family with small children. It was fantastic. The service, food and wine were all spectacular. Unique views from the Seine and a relaxing way to see the city.

My husband and I had a lovely relaxing dinner with wine viewing all the beautiful lights of the city. The food wasn't fine dining but definitely what you might expect at a nice sidewalk cafe. Very tastey and the service was excellent. Well worth the money and a must do!
Nice clean ship with good food and excellent service. They also had a very good trio with a wonderful singer. Our guests were in Paris for the first time and loved it!

We have been to Paris 3 times and once again we took this dinner cruise! We try very hard to avoid touristy things but this dinner cruise has a combination of great food, great views along the river at night, live music, and a celebratory atmosphere! We wave to riverside partiers, drink lots of wine, indulge in the food, and take in the sites and lights of Paris that is no better enjoyed then from the river. Highly recommend!

This was just a perfect way to end what was an amazing weekend. Both I and my new fiancée had an incredible time. The Staff were all very attentive, considerate and the food was just sublime.

We opted for the premier service so our table was by the window, with ample wine throughout the service and the views of Paris at night accompanied with the live music was just magnifique.

We plan on returning again on the anniversary of our engagement.

Sam & Becky

We took an evening dinner cruise down the Seine The boat was beautiful and there was a lovely atmosphere on board. We paid extra to have a window table which was truly worth it to make the most of the experience. The food and accompanying wines were lovely and very well paired.All of the staff were very friendly and professional pointing out areas of interest.
One tip ensure you arrive early as the boarding process can be a little chaotic.

Great experience. The best time to take the tour is 8:30pm. You get on the boat when it's still a daylight and get off when it's dark.... so you get to be there and see the sun set... it's beautiful... The food is great... good service... life music... beautiful scenery. Eiffel tower looks magnificent. You can be on that boat alone... with a friend, significant other or family.. doesn't matter... good for everyone. Totally recommend.

The boat ride around the Seine was great. It was a cool way to Paris at night. I was worried that it would be overpriced but it was well worth the money.

The food and service was great. It was a cool atmosphere with a live singer.

I would recommend the Bateux Parians dinner cruise.

It was a lovely evening, with spectacular views. The timing was as stated. Food was great. The weight service was mediocre – we had to service our own wine from the wine bucket near our table, rarely saw the waiter. The live music was also pretty sparse. For the kind of money spent, a higher quality of service and entertainment is expected. I’d recommend it if priced at 100 per head....

This was a last night treat after running the marathon and we were not disappointed. The food was top class, the wine was perfect and the entertainment just topped it off. The boat is elegant with excellent views of Paris as you sail along the river. Although it seems a little pricey because you get all your wine and food included and a guide of the sites you see as a momento it actually seems really good value. We loved it.

We didnt get to go because after our flight got canceled 23 hours before the dinner neither trip advisor or the company. I tried to reschedule. Trip advisor and the river cruise company wouldn't help. I tried emailing and talking to them with no success. I received a few emails in return but then they stopped responding. I guess I wont be giving either one of them my business again.

Absolutely amazing cruise! I wish it lasted a little longer as time really does fly when your enjoying yourself with wine and great company. We had done the 6:15pm and it was absolutely beautiful. The staff were friendly and very professional. The cruise boat itself was very beautiful for fine dining. Having a window seat was definately worth it. The views environment was very pleasant. Food was delicious, especially my desert 😍. Cannot fault these guys, everything was perfect! Would definitely recommend to do this while in Paris. One of the highlights of my stay in Paris.

My daughter and I are "foodies" and Paris is an easy place to get lost in good food. It's also an easy place to get tourist-trapped in sight of a monument and receive bland, careless food so when hunting for a dinner cruise I wanted to be sure we were receiving a meal that was done with care.

Our meal about the Cristal was a delight. It truly was. No corners were cut to provide an exemplary meal in a second-to-none setting.

The Cristal was a fantastic boat with glass walls and ceilings affording luxuriant views of the night city and it's life.

Our table service was attentive and charismatic too. Our servers treated us like special guests. They were never hurried or harried and always polite and generous with our poor grasp of french.

I know there are cheaper options but this was absolutely the best choice and languidly cruising along the river for two and a half hours visiting on the sites and the live along the river provided a look at Paris we could not have seen otherwise. At night the walkways along the river come to life in unusual ways making a dramatic backdrop for our meal and a great opportunity to reflect on the day of exploring and adventures.

100% highly recommended.

We took this cruise a few years ago so I wanted to take it again. The food was pretty and tasted good but I felt like the entire experience was rushed. We were on the 6:00 dinner cruise which I suspect doesn’t go as far as the later cruise because we didn’t pass the Statue of Liberty. In the future I will just go on a basic river cruise during the day and then go somewhere else for a more leisurely special dinner. For 267 euro I would like a less hurried meal.

Simply a must !! Not not to be missed!! We got the privileged option and was worth it!!! First of all the service was fantastic from the moment you checked in till to moment you left the boat. Arrived to table with glass of champagne with window seat with fantastic views . The whole experience with four course meal , service , views is a must !!

My girlfriend and I were on a 8.30pm dinner cruise and had a great evening. Only slight criticism was that someone in front of me had an issue with their pass so we boarded a little late.

There were 4 choices for starter, main and dessert each so there was plenty of choice. I found the food to be very tasty for all 3 courses. The waiters/waitresses are bilingual so had no issues there. They were very friendly! There was a very generous serving of wine, my girlfriend and I got through 2 bottles. 1 was a nice Chardonnay Viognier and the other was a bottle of Shiraz. Complimented the meal very nicely.

We covered most of Paris starting at the Eiffel Tower and passing other attractions like The Louvre and Notre Dame.

Unfortunately, someone got too drunk on the boat so the police came at the end of the cruise. However, it didn't spoil what was a pretty special evening.

It's not cheap but I highly recommend it! definitely worth the money.
Excellent food, champagne on boarding, good bottle of wine, great table for 2, and memorable views. Would recommend for a romantic Paris interlude.

The food was very good. I read reviews that the food was mediocre. For the price, it was very good. Equal to most white table restaurants in San Francisco. The service was efficient and unobtrusive. The atmosphere was relaxing with low lights, beautiful views of Paris twinkling. It was a great ending to our trip.

My boyfriend and I booked the 8:30 dinner cruise for our last night in Paris. Definitely worth the extra money for the window seat. The live music was great as was the service and staff, which made for a lovely romantic atmosphere to go with the sights. Wine and food was good. All in all, it was a great evening and wonderful seeing Paris lit up at night from the river!

I took my boyfriend for his birthday. The food was absolutely trash. I would not recommend this boat. the waiter was really nice, however the quality of food was soooooo poor. would not be doing this again. waste of money

We took the trip for our 20th Wedding Anniversary, loved everything about it! Best way to see magical Paris at night!
Delicious 3 course dinner menu and great French wines!
Sebastian, our French Waiter spoke many languages and really made the eveing special, he was so attentive! Merci and Highly recommend!

Go early to get a seat by the window .you are packed in and not a lot of room to move the meal was ok but you had to pay extra for the steak option. You got given a glass of wine .it was a 3 course menu and drinks were extra .great way to see the scenery and architecture of the buildings . It was all a bit to quick but a enjoyable evening . As you do when in Paris

We took our 5 grown children to Paris for a week to celebrate my birthday - spent the big bucks; $1,600 for this dinner cruise... We emailed weeks ahead of time regarding three members of our party with celiac disease (CANNOT have gluten), and were assured they would have a special menu. There was NO special menu, but we did get a very annoyed waiter, who could not have been less helpful. We then got the manager, who offered one option for an appetizer: foie gras. For sure, our three children were just ecstatic about that (not). They finally came back and offered some options, but the whole process was painful and unnecessary, as they had foreknowledge. The table and view was great, dinner was passable, only a fruit option for dessert for the celiac patrons, and they plunked down a half-full cup of tea without asking if we wanted coffee, latte, etc, then never came back. NOT GOOD.

Six of us took the early dinner cruise, 6pm. Information on time and location were not clear. Boat itself is a bit shabby. Stairs down to bathroom doesn’t have rail to help getting up and down the steps. Food was ok. Wine was ok.

Difficult to get taxi from boat back to hotel.

Maybe it’s a better sightseeing venture when dark but while still light, would have been better just driving around.

My husband and I had booked this trip before getting to Paris, we chose the privilege service with the window seat. Best decision ever. We were able to see the sights and enjoyed the sparkling eiffel tower at night. The service was great, wine was flowing and the food was fantastic! We definitely thought the price was well worth it and even considered it a great deal! There was also live music during the trip which was good too. I would definitely recommend this to anyone going to Paris!

I paid for the Premier trip which guarantees a seat up front and choices from a set menu. The food was underwhelming. There was more than enough wine and champagne. I had taken a day cruise on the Seine a few days earlier, so I had a sense for what I’d see. It was fun to see the sights lit up. I was solo, and I don’t recommend going solo. Left to my own devices, taking photos is my thing. However, I was seated behind a pole; and moving around to take photos was not appropriate.

Seeing Paris lit up, whilst cruising down the Seine listening to live music and having a lovely meal with wine is simply as good as it sounds! It could be very romantic, but I did it with my Mum and we had a great time too! The service was excellent and the overall experience worth every cent. The only hiccup was that the toilet was out of action, which wasn't great being stuck on a boat after a few glasses of wine!

We decided to book this based on a recommendation from an Uber driver in London. When we said that the next stop on our trip was Paris he said this was something we could no miss. I am glad we did. The food was delicious the service attentive the pace of the trip was perfectly timed it did not feel rushed or drawn out. We did the package with rose petals and heart shaped cake as this was our Anniversary trip. I loved this tour. I booked online and picked a package but am not sure if you are able to pick a specific vessel if this is important to you I would contact the tour company directly.

My wife and I ( being huge fans of cruises ) decided to try a "smaller size" experience by booking online this 90min Seine cruise (well , it's not actually a cruise but I can't find a better word to describe the event!) when we were in Paris during this last August !
We don"t regret it for one second - all went smooth and led to a pleasant experience, though I have to confess dinner was so good we paid less attention to the spectacular views on both sides of the river !
Service was almost perfect , the young lady from the embarking desk - very polite and efficient , all in all I recommend this "adventure" for those who are interested in this kind of leisure time !
P.S. Only four stars because of the price , just a little bit TOO high !

I went on the 6pm cruise. A lovely stroll along the Seine to see most attractions. It was my birthday and the crew brought me a lovely dessert and sang happy birthday.
I was pleased with the dinner and value .

We had one night in Paris, we wanted to see the beautiful lights of Paris from the river. We selected the WIndow Seat category for $198.00 per person, for the unobstructed view. The ship was very nice, the service was excellent and the sights were magical. Even the live entertainment which I normally can't stand was enjoyable. The food could have been better. It's what I would call "banquet food" quality. Some of the dishes were tastier than others. But with that said, I still recommend this cruise. Beside for the food, everything was top notch. We had a wonderful time on the ship. Took some great photos and have a very special memory of the our night in Paris.

Magical evening with my family. My kids are 11 and 8 and loved the experience. There is no childrens menu so I was pleasently surprised they ate the fancy food served which was absolutey delicious! This was our favourite night in Paris and well worth the money. Even got serenaded by the singer with amazing voice and his band. Highly highly recommended 😁

We live in Paris and this is the third time in 5 years that we have experienced an evening cruise in Premier service at the front of the boat (always in the summer). Each time has been an unforgettable experience and I recommend this for special occasions. This 2.5-hour cruise is truly magic, with the timing of the dishes planned to perfection in a timeless travel passing by some of the most historical monuments of the city. The (live) music is not too loud, the service always impeccable, and the food definitely up to it. A slightly negative thing to note perhaps is, for those sitting closest to the bay window, the breeze from the air conditioning. This did not seem to bother others though, but bring a vest if you are sensitive to cold.

We did the 8:30pm cruise and went premier. We did wish we had done the top class at the front of the boat as you can see everything then. We were also lucky as there is 2 rows so you aren’t guaranteed a window seat but we did. This just means you have to effectively look over another couple to see the sights. It was lovely to see the sights and see the real culture of Paris throughout the tour. You get a lovely leaflet explaining the route and brief history of the main sights. Live music was fabulous and kept us entertained throughout. Staff were lovely and accommodating. The food wasn’t amazing but there was a lovely selection and it wasn’t awful. Something went wrong with us as we were clearly the last ones to get our mains then it was a little rushed from main to cheeses to dessert to coffees probably all within the space of 45 mins. Apart from the blimp we thoroughly enjoyed it and was a nice dinner for us to enjoy!

My wife and I were celebrating the 45th anniversary of our first date, which was a boat ride on the Seine as high school students on a European study tour back in the 70s. We loved this commemorative cruise. Efficient check-in process on the dock. Comfortable air conditioned boat, which was nice with the heat wave going on. Good food and wine. Service was a bit spotty, as they seemed to be a little understaffed. But servers' attitudes were cheerful and helpful. We had window seats, so we probably could see better than some of the people toward the middle of the boat. Could not see the sights as well as we expected since the flood walls on the side of the river are pretty tall. But seeing all the people picnicking, strolling, dancing, etc. along the river more than made up for not seeing as much of the picturesque buildings as we expected. One of the biggest pluses was the leisureliness of the trip, knowing we were going to sit there until the end of the journey. Made for a relaxing evening, with lots to discuss looking out the window as we motored along.
