Docking at end was timed to the 5 mins per hour sparkling light show on the Eiffel Tower, which made for a delightful end of the cruise. So service was a 3, food and wine was a 4, but overall experience made it a 5 in our estimation.
We would highly recommend this evening. We booked the premier service and it was totally worth it. Food was good, atmosphere was amazing! A must do in Paris.

Opted for the Premier package. It did not disappoint. Service and food was superb. Staff so polite and efficient. Our waitress, Sophie was excellent. If you are looking for a really good experience go for the Privilege package as it worth every cent. A most enjoyable night with a lovely table at the front of the boat with fantastic views.

We did the Étoile 8:30pm service on our first night in Paris and it was absolutely magical. What a perfect introduction to the city. The views were predictably stunning, but the unobtrusive explanations and personal commentary by staff really made the views something special. The food was also absolutely lovely, and overall was an excellent experience. I highly recommend this river cruise!

This was such a great experience. We hummed and hawed about several different options, finally decided on this cruise even though it seemed a bit more expensive. So very glad we did, it was very much worth every cent. From the check in counter to our excellent server Momo, service was great. The length of the tour is much better than other options, 2.5 hours whereas the others are only barely over an hour (we saw other boats powering past us so fast I bet they hardly had time to see anything). The interior was lovely, air conditioned and comfortable and the food was excellent. There were two ladies singing and playing instruments, we really couldn’t have asked for more. Recommend the dinner cruise as you dock just on eleven pm in time to see the Eiffel Tower sparkling.

Traveling with my grandson on a graduation trip to London and Paris and this was our last night before returning home. I took this dinner cruise 18 years ago and enjoyed it, so thought he would to. Made reservations in the states. Arrived early and it wasn't long before we were seated. This was a Sunday night 8:30 trip and not a full crowd. The food was excellent and nice wine. Always enjoy watching young couples sitting along the Siene kissing, so Paris as you sail along with our girl soloist singing in french. Seeing the Eiffel tower lit up at night from the water so awesome. Met a very nice couple from Canada. Just a really lovely last night.
Beautiful food, wonderful staff and of course superb views of the famous buildings, lit up at night and seen differently from the water.

Food was reasonably good and service excellent. Short trip.
Felt rushed and limited ability to view Paris. Would not recommend but suggest a guided focused tour only. Eat elsewhere.

We had a long weekend in Paris and decided to do this trip as a treat for our last night. I have seen these boats many times, but never been on one. We took the 8.30 sailing, so we could see the city lit up at night. We only paid for the basic package, but it was great. 3 courses and a bottle of wine to wash it down with. The food was fantastic, as was the service and ambiance. We would highly recommend this excursion, it really was the cherry on top of a wonderful stay in this beautiful city.

We had a wonderful evening on the Bateaux Parisiens Diamonte II on Saturday evening. The whole experience was fantastic, would definately recommend a dinner cruise with them it was brilliant from start to finish. Our waitress for the evening Sara was great she was so helpful and attentive with a great smile. The dinner on board was excellent and all three courses were wonderful. A great memory for all of us.

Traveling with two elderly parents, one of the mobility impaired. We did not have high expectations for the food - but we thought it was lovely for being on a boat. The big windows let us see Paris lit up at night and they timed the music with different buildings we passed so we remembered to look up and read about them. The boat was only half full and they crowded everyone onto the side with the best views.

The overall tone is very mellow and classy - ideal for our situation.

We booked this on line and received a receipt with instructions to the venue, which was very helpful, we went on the evening cruise at 8.30. The staff upon arrival were very helpful and polite, made you feel at ease, we boarded the cruiser and was greeted with a glass of Champagne, which was very nice, we received 2 bottles of wine, red and white at our table, the meal was very good, there was singing during the cruise, which was very nice and at the right time very romantic with stunning views of the many attractions of Paris lit up.
This is a must for a romantic evening with your partner, advice is do book well in advance.

On the whole the dress code was adhered to which was all part of the ambiance. Don’t bring rucksacks!
I could not fault the complete experience. Everything was perfect.
Great experience. Very nice food, good service. A unique way to see the sights. You need to go outside to take photos due to the reflection of the glass

This is an outstanding experience
Don’t skip this
My wife and I celebrated our 40th anniversary here
The views of the city at night are tremendous
Fantastic!!

The Seine dinner cruise truly exceeded our expectations! The food was delicious (much better than we expected!), the music & singer we’re awesome, and the views…Ooh La La!!! What a perfect way to see Paris by night and from a unique vantage point. Highly recommended!!!
Very good dinner cruise but on the pricey side. Service, music and food were excellent! Wine and the view of night Paris were memorable!
This dinner cruise was amazing. The ambiance was great and the food was good, the sites were beautiful even though it was raining. Don’t miss this opportunity in Paris.

Wonderful experience!. The food and wine exceeded expectations, the singer was excellent and provided a very warm atmosphere, and Paris by night just magical.
Highly recommend the Premier level.
HIGHLY recommend. Food and service was impeccable. Along with the wine. Lots of great sight seeing while on boat. Thank you
Myself and my two teenage daughters went on this earlier this week - we thoroughly enjoyed the experience and recommend it!

sightseeing on the night is ok but the food is terrible and not cook. we complain that the chicken is not cook, so they took the chicken from us and we thought that they will give us a new one but its not, they return the same chicken and its looks like it was cook from the microwave. will not recommend having a dinner in the boat. just enjoy the sightseeing in the night.
Food and service were excellent. I would highly recommend if you can to plan on taking this wonderful cruise. It’s an experience you won’t forget.
Maitre impolite. Food disappointing. Slow service. Crammed net to other tables. Reception was good and fast.
Incredible. 8:30PM best time. Great singer, good service. All staff very professional and polite. Best views at night.
A must if you are visiting Paris, really amazing views and the food was fantastic. I read the reviews on here and paid extra for a table next to the window and it absolutely paid off.

We booked six reservations for May 7th. Two people in our party tested positive for Covid on Friday the 6th and we tried to get our money for the couple credited. They would not refund the money. Viator took the reservation which is owned by Trip Advisor. They gave us the runaround. I won't use Trip Advisor again or recommend restaurants as I have in the past.
Wonderful experience. We selected Privilege seating and were sat by the windows. This cruise was the highlight of our visit in Paris. Highly recommended

Wow where to start
I had the best experience from the moment we have arrived to the last minute we were there
I went with my husband it was our first time In Paris dinner was delicious, entertainment wow
Best best time ever ❤️
So recommend it

Very unique experience, the service was excellent from start to finish, we did premium the food was very nice accompanied by quality wines and champagne, well worth the upgrade for the better view alone in addition we never had to buy any extra drinks and still had half glass when docking at 11pm, the sights were amazing and the onboard live singer just added to the atmosphere perfectly 5*

This company is horrible and unsupportive. It does not state anywhere that boarding stops at 2015 and even if you should up before departure they do not help nor let you on. They don’t help tourist at all and take your money! Modern day thieves!!!

We attended the Dinner Cruise in late April 2022 and were bitterly disappointed with the dining experience and the service onboard.

When we arrived, we were warmly greeted by the staff at the dock and shown to our seat beside the window as per our reservation. We were then greeted by our waiter who explained the menu to us and our beverage options, however throughout the introduction we felt the waiter was rushing us to get our order through and that he was delivering a monologue for the menu. We were hoping for a more warm conversation as a normal waiter would present. I do understand that the experience is only 2 hours and the kitchen needs to know the order ASAP for a smooth service, but a short 30-60 second conversation on how our trip was and where we were visiting from would've been the least to expect.

Following that, we were presented with our starter. I ordered the Salmon while my partner ordered the Snails. The salmon was tasteless, there was barely any seasoning except some chilli flakes sprinkled on top. While the salmon was well cooked, the lettuce was served with the butt, meaning it couldn't be washed properly. On top of that, the mango was so bland it made no sense being there. The avocado and guacamole on the plate didn't do much to elevate the dish either. Onto the snails - I've been lucky enough to eat snails a few times, but the snails given to us were so chewy you could've thought it was beef jerky. Normally a snail should be an easy bite, like a sauteed mushroom, but for the ones we were given, we just had to keep chewing and chewing until it finally would crumble. All in all, our starters were very poor, particularly for the price tag you've placed on this experience. I'd be able to find the equivalent dishes in a bistro on the side of the food for a 10th of the price and they'd taste 10x better.

Next, the mains. My partner ordered the sea bass while I ordered the rump of veal. On the positive note, the sea bass was quite good, very light and soft as sea bass should be served. The sauce it came with was delicate and accompanied the fish well. Unfortunately the vegetables served were tough and bitter, which was a slight let down. On the flip side, the rump of veal was utterly terrible. Overcooked, bland and dry. I was expecting a medium veal rump steak which would accentuate the flavours of the veal, but it was cooked so much that you could pass it off for a very cheap cut of pork. It was so terrible that I asked the waiter whether they could cook it medium, of which he replied saying that was the method of cooking and that others have said this problem as well. I asked why this method wasn't written on the menu to avoid confusion and then subsequently asked for another dish (the sea bass) because the veal was simply inedible.

The intermittent course of cheese was weird. You serve the cheese with cheap pieces of salad leaves, which make no sense as to whether these salad leaves are for presentation or for consuming. Also the salad leaves on my plate had wilted, making the dish look unappetising and distasteful. Both of us took 1-2 bites and that was enough.

Finally, the desserts - my partner ordered the chocolate cake while I ordered the Baba. The chocolate cake itself was nice, crumbly and not too sweet, but the orange sauce that was smeared on the plate didn't go well. The Baba was deplorable, drowned in a horrible sauce and made cheaply. It looked like raspberries and cream were thrown onto a muffin then some raspberry juice was thrown in. My muffin/cake was soaked in the juice halfway up, it made it inedible. I ate 1 bite and gave up. At that time I just wanted to get off the boat.

The service felt cold, miserable and rushed. We were hoping for a romantic experience, and at 139 euros per person we'd expect decent service from the waiters, but all we got were our plates put on the table and removed. Not once (except for when the sea bass replaced the veal) were we asked how our meal was so far or how's the experience been so far / anything we can do for you, just "can I take this away?".

We're confident to say we will never do this experience and we will never recommend anyone to do this experience. For this price we could've enjoyed a decent meal at a regular bistro for a fraction of this experience then combined it with a simple river cruise in the evening.

We expressed all of the above problems and issues with the Maitre D' on board at the end of the evening as one should, he was very understanding and apologetic, and he presented us with a card to contact the company's Head Customer Service Agent (Sophie). We email her about all the problems mentioned, and 4 days later still no reply. On top of that, the Maitre D' / Head Waiter himself said that some of the options on the menu aren't good and that many people had complained about the veal rump in the past, meaning there's something very wrong with the food selection.

First. The food is subpar to typical French food. Although the options are good they taste the same- overcooked and burned. The experience is good, but you pay for the food wine etc and it just doesn’t fit the bill. DO NOT, UPGRADE TO PREMIER. By far the waste. Our server was so consumed by other tables he barely could be described as attentive.OVERPICED.MEDIOCRE QUALITY.GO FOR THE CHEAPER ROUTE!

HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE!! I came from a different country (USA) to visit Paris for my first time ever and I booked this cruise “Premiere” better seating, food etc hoping for an amazing time but instead had a HORRIBLE Experience as they are not willing to help me or help TripAdvisor!
Im so sad that because my flight arrived late, check in at hotel took longer than expected I still only make it 5 mins late and Bateaux Parisiens company still does not recognize that sometimes there are things out of our hands. I called them earlier 3 times and on my way to please either wait or reschedule for me. They said try to get here and maybe we can reschedule for a dinner time, well they did not follow through and did not reschedule so I lost my $120+ As they do not want to even help me reschedule for a different date. It’s so sad because that was part of my budget And I am not able to afford another cruise like this. Wish they could understand that.
I DO NOT recommend this company at all!
The boat was very good, we got the best seats I. The house, the food was very good! Overall a must do in Paris! We were with 3 teenagers, they enjoyed the experience too!
What a wonderful and different way to see Paris! The views were incredible, the food was delicious, and our waiter Emil was fantastic! Tres bien!
We had an amazing time! The boat left on time, the food was delicious and filling, and every seat had a great view of the sights. A good value as well! Highly recommend!
I loved this experience, food, atmosphere and service was lovely. I don’t have a bad word to say. It was the perfect ending to our trip in Paris.

Took the full extra package (expensive at > 380€) with the soit-disant Maxim's upgrade...not worth it. The pictures on the website are from another boat as the boat you get is a plain one with a couple of art deco walls to faint the fools and 70's aluminium windows...nothing like Maxim's obviously. The food was plain and mostly cold, the service was expeditive and not very professional. So if you want to do a diner cruise either go for the cheap ones and you will get the same nice scenery or just book a good restaurant in Paris and go for a walk afterwards. Tourist trap.

I booked this dinner cruise on September 1, 2021 and my itinerary was complete. Then on December 10, 2021 they sent me an email to notify me that they are canceling my reservations since they changed the pricing and they wanted me to either cancel or pay the difference of 520 euro more.

Beware of doing business with this company if they feel like raising the price at the last minute on their consumer they will definitely do that.

We took the Bateaux Parisiens trip as part of a weekend in Paris for my wife's birthday and had a wonderful time.

The food was superb, and the views of Paris were amazing.

They closed the gate as we were standing there and wouldn't let us on. I want my money back.

The woman was so rude and would not let us on.

We had a great dinner cruise, we chose the cheapest meal option which was absolutely fine just was sat on an inside seat but still great views of the attractions along the river, not with paying an extra £70/90 for a window seat. The food was nice and the staff were friendly, would recommend this dinner cruise to friends and family visiting Paris.

This was a nice/different way to see the city. We had a lovely time, but the dinner left a lot to be desired. The meal was mediocre, but when feeding many people, all at the same time, it was about what we expected.
We would recommend this tour. After the tour ended, there are many cabs waiting to pick up passengers getting off the boats.
Beware, they told us it’s “a fixed price” to be taken back to our hotel. We were told it was $50.
My husband told the driver to f’ off & called up an Uber that arrived within 5 min & was $10.
So please be aware of unscrupulous taxi drivers at the port.

We booked this with TripAdvisor and had no issues. The food and drink were excellent on board and the service was fantastic.

We sat in one of the middle tables but it is still right by the window. Unless you really want to sit right on the window, it is not worth the extra cost.

Very nice boat but the dinner was overpriced and that was at our level of service. There were a number of higher levels and I would suggest one that got you in the front of the boat.
The food was ok.

There were 4 of us and we splurged for the 4-course meal with a table for 4 by the window. It was a great experience. No regrets or disappointments. The food was delicious and included champagne, red wine and white wine, the service was excellent, the views were fantastic and the boat was very clean and well-appointed. FYI - they give you a menu with 4 starters to choose from, 4 main courses and 4 desserts. The 4th course was a cheese plate that came before the dessert. My only complaint was at one point the music got loud and it was weird dance music. I think they should stick to soft dinner jazz or classical music.
The cruise with the boat was very nice. Unluckily the quality of the food was very poor and the music very loud (more discotheque like).
Seeing Paris at night was great, really the city of lights. Quite surprised at the quality of the meal, it was gourmet. All around a fabulous evening.

The entire experience was below our expectations. The check-in counter was through a stuff and smelly unused, dark space. There were chairs and tables stacked alongside large drapes, no signage, nothing to direct us to the counter.
The boat itself is old, the windows are streaked and bugs were crawling along the sill. The room is cold and not at all inviting. We were subjected to an hour long serenade of Whitney Houston- this is 2021, so The Bodyguard soundtrack reflected the evening, old and tired. We were served tiny pours of lousy champagne and small bites of cold mini appetizers. The meals selected along with a bottle of red. There are only 3 choices, red, white or more of the lousy champagne. We travelled along the river, no mention what we were seeing, just that Whitney Houston. The sun set, we ate, cold appetizers, cold dinner and everything bland. A photographer pressed us into some seated photos, first - he totally took us by surprise and second- this is a shakedown! If photos are included, then include them- do not ask me to pay extra on the spot, it’s so awkward. I took a trip to the toilet, located down a flight of stairs, around a bend through a small hallway used to store chairs and clothes racks. This is past the dish washing room, which smells of garbage. Then we were at the Eiffel Tower, 5 minutes of lights. Back into the dismal dining room, loud birthday music, wedding marches, I suppose there were birthdays and someone accepted a proposal. The desserts were flavorless.
We left the boat, disappointed.
We were happy to make the reservation and 300+ should have been a magnificent evening
Paris is beautiful- skip this though
It is just awful

We did and saw many things; however, this was by far was our favorite part of our 1st visit to Paris. It was simply spectacular to see the night lights of Paris as we cruised down the river eating a wonderful meal.
Booked for lunch in Premier class, expected to leave feeling ripped off. Absolutely fantastic! Let me go again please! Food good, wine flowed as freely as the river itself!

I cannot recommend this experience enough.

Pros:
- easy to find/board
- delicious food!
- friendly staff
- beautiful views
- lovely ambiance
- great accommodations (beautiful/modern boat)
- great restrooms (not accessible for those with mobility issues)

Cons:
- When the sun is still out, the class enclosed boat can get a little warm, and the AC is not very effective until the sun goes down.

This is perfect for a night out that requires little work on your part and really wows everyone in your party. See Paris from the Seine while eating delicious food from the comfort of a beautiful riverboat.
What a great way to get the feeling of Paris! Our waitress was fantastic (Alexandre), she was very pleasant and attentive
Everything was really nice, great experience! You don’t even notice the time passing by. Great and amazing staff, very good wines, spot on food! I easily give a 5⭐️ Review to this experience! 🔝
Was a delicious dinner and beautiful view. Perfect for a romantic dinner with fiancé. The cruise went up and down the river during sunset so the view was great.

Due to the unforeseen weather, my dinner cruise didn’t go ahead ,
The problem with the company in charge , was that they never inform me about cancelling the event in advance, not call, msg or email, so we know it when we arrived to the port. What a des appointment after all the arrangements I when through as we travel from London for all that.

The view was amazing and the dinner was delicious. The crew went out of there way to make sure you had a fantastic journey down the Siene.
This is a must go to when you are in Paris.
Excellent food! Friendly staff. It was a great way to see the city and better at night seeing the Eiffel Tower lit up
Great experience .Helpful and friendly waiters serving lovely food with plentiful wine .What is there not to like !!! Highlight of my trip and excellent value for money

It was a lovely meal and romantic for my partner and I. The waiter was telling us the history of the monuments as we went past. The boat was very smooth I couldn't tell that we were on a boat. The staff were lovely.
Excellent food, staff was fantastic and great ambiance! Highly recommend to experience a great Parisian meal while experiencing the Siene and the sights of the Paris water front.
It's a spectacular cruise ride. The food and wine was excellent, and the staff witty and gave us great service.

Staff were fantastic (on and off the boat) and the food was wonderful! The entertainment was very good, the two singers did just enough, the views were pleasant and all together it was a thoroughly enjoyable evening!
Amazing experience, romantic ambience at the window seat. Food was excellent, brought to you in a very timely manner, servers very polite. Some added background music would improve the ambience.
Seine River Dinner Cruise is one of the most beautiful experince. Very good to try it and to speend a nice evening. The staff is the best one!!!
I had such a good time on the dinner cruise. It was very romantic. I will say that direction to the boat is not easy. We almost missed it, because no one knew where it was.. Food was good too.

The most romantic thing we’ve ever done!

Perfect evening, food was amazing, the service was faultless, the most attentive waiters, never had an empty glass!

We forgot that wine was included and are not normally white wine drinkers but could have drank the white wine all night! The red was equally as good!

The live music and atmosphere were great too!

Perfect evening and couldn’t be faulted at all!

Would recommend anyone who visits Paris to book this!
It was a rainy night so unfortunately some pictures we took were obstructed by raindrops but the experience was excellent. This was honestly one of my favourite parts of our Paris trip.
Everything was wonderful. We had a fantastic time. The entire staff was very nice and treated us like family. Would definitely recommend.

I would recommend this special experience of seeing Paris with all its lights and beauty - especially during the holiday season. Staff was friendly and fun. Food is good but definitely not the highlight here.

Absolutely beautiful views, friendly staff, incredible live music, and delicious food! This was a very easy going ride, despite there being rough waters. The meal consisted of a starter, entree, cheese course, and dessert, and the options for each course were plentiful!

Food was amazing. Waiter was excellent. Cruise was cancelled due to high water. Tickets for separate cruise were offered. Would have appreciated the option to have the dinner cruise on a smaller boat.

The main problem with our "cruise" was that it did not leave the port, which they did warn us about the morning before. The boat was nearly empty but yet there was mass confusion and long lines. Although they tell you to get there early they won't let you on the boat early so be prepared to be outside. The food and service was good. The atmosphere was nice as well as the entertainment. Once we were at our table the evening went well but the beginning was frustrating.

The boat trip was at night and river cruise and food and service on the boat were excellent. However we weren’t aware of how chaotic the traffic could be in Paris in the evening - allow extra time! Our cruise was to start promptly at 8.30. We arrived with a few minutes to collect tickets but then had to wait 30 minutes outside in the freezing cold in a long line of annoyed people waiting for someone to check our names off a list to go onto a barge to pick up tickets to board the boat. The boat eventually left around 9pm. The wait in the cold though was worth it.

Live musics Atmosphere was great on the cruise! Food was average. Water was high when we embarked so we cruised the opposite direction and did not get to see the sites of Paris which is why we went. I would have preferred to have known that before check in so we could have made the decision to cancel and just have a nice dinner in the water at a restaurant. We were given a return voucher good for a year but who is coming back just for that. I’d recommend calling within the 24 hour period to make sure they can cruise as promised.

Great food and wine. Service was brilliant. Lovely birthday treat from the husband. Lovely views of thre River Seine. Good to see the Effiel Tower lit up.. Wonderful landmarks. I think we will be back x
The food and service was superb! I would highly recommend to anybody. The atmosphere was relaxed and the music added to the ambience.

If not for being with great friends it would have been a complete disappointment. One of our favorite things to do in Paris is cruise under the historic lighted bridges at night & see the sights along the Seine. Only as we checked in for the cruise were we told our cruise would be going the opposite direction due to high water. We paid premium prices for a table at the front of the boat to see? Service was outstanding and live entertainment good. A photographer wanted 20 € for each photo she took. The food was very mediocre. We were given a voucher for another cruise only which had to be used within 12 months. Luckily we still had a fun time with our friends but the cruise was certainly not what we signed up for.

This was a really fun evening. The route had to be changed because of the high water level, but it was beautiful seeing the Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty. Food was pretty good. The service was great! All around a very fun night to cap off our trip! Thanks!
This boat ride was amazing! It was really romantic and the food was delicious!!! If you come to Paris with a partner or a close friend, you must do this! I loved it! Great experience!

We went on the dinner cruise for my wife’s birthday. The atmosphere was absolutely amazing. Although it was raining, that didn’t distract from our enjoyment of the views at all. We truly enjoyed the sites as we cruised down the river. The service was fantastic, and the wine was good as well. The food was very good, but honestly not the best part of the experience. No complaints though. Overall, I highly recommend the trip.
Lovely boat, great food and service as well as entertainment. Of course the scenery cannot be beat. Would highly recommend!

We decided to do this dinner review based on the other reviews on trip advisor and we are so glad we did! It was such a fun night. The meal came with two bottles of wine and you could purchase more. They also had a singer and band playing music throughout the evening. The food and service on the boat were also really great. Would recommend if you have something to celebrate in Paris!
Very nice experience across the river and a good way to visit Paris, about the dinner, good menu and service.
Booking was simple. Check-in was easy. Boarding was quick. Service was impeccable. Food was fantastic. Experience was priceless - highly recommend!

Easy to book via Viator. Receptionist Daphne was an excellent hostess. Our server, I think her name is Ali...., she was very good too.
Beef was perfectly cooked (medium rare), very tender, nearly melt in the mouth.
Champagne, white wine and Bordeaux were excellent.
Escargots were ok.
Scallops were very good.
Duck was kind of tough.
Overall wry good experience.
I brought this for my boyfriends 21st and was amazing really lovely staff, lovely views and lovely food.
While the scenery was fantastic, we definitely felt rushed. It was the only time during our week in Paris that I felt like a "tourist" and not in a good way. The fish was good but the veal was dry.

My husband and I booked the “Découverte” Cruise to celebrate our 25th anniversary, and it was everything we had hoped. The champagne at the start, the varied food courses (my first time eating fois gras!), the beautiful scenery floating by and the talented performers serenading us throughout the trip made this a very memorable experience, one we can look back on for years to come. The passengers included both local residents and tourists from all over the world, we were seated between a couple from Holland celebrating. 50th birthday, and a couple from San Francisco on vacation. I would highly recommend adding this cruise to your Paris itinerary.

I wish we could go back , the most pleasant beautiful visit to Paris over the weekend , with an amazing stop off at this restaurant . The food and the scenery was just amazing . I would return to both the City and the venue .
We enjoyed seeing the city at night very beautiful. Our waiter was such a joy and so funny! Do not forget to tip these folks. they deserve it and appreciate it!

I booked via TripAdvisor for my fiancé and I to attend the evening sitting for dinner, it was the Etoile service at 20:30. This is worth every single penny, if not more. It surpassed both our expectations. The food was fantastic, as was the service and you genuinely couldn’t ask for a better setting. I managed to take some fabulous photos of the Eiffel Tower.
I was completely shocked to discover that the wine with the meal was also included in the price which we were not expecting!
I 100% recommend this trip to anyone visiting Paris. It is so romantic and genuinely one of the best dining experiences of my life and I would consider myself to be pretty well travelled.
It’s pretty much all I’ve talked about since coming back to the UK!

OK I cant give it five stars for the sole reason, the ship broke down. It was our anniversary, a special one, which my wife had booked as a surprise for me while we were in Paris. On boarding we were told the ship was going nowhere due to a broken engine and we could either have our money back or go on board and have the meal. We opted for the meal albeit a little expensive to not see any sites but the meal was fantastic. Normally I would kick off at something like this but didnt want to ruin what my wife had spent time and money on so just went ahed. I can not fault the food, the ship or the crew. So gald we did go aboard and not let it ruin out special night. We did get complimentary tickets for a cruise the following day but since we were already booked for the hop on hop off Seine cruise we did not take up the offer. I can only say, go on it. Its worth it. Just wish it had been sailing and made it the perfect evening after a long 12 months of hell due to health and other things.

The cruise is generally good and allow a good viewing of architectures along the Seine in a romantic environment. The bad thing was that we had minimally drank red wine that we were not allow to take with us, which seems wasteful!
The ride was great. We were lucky and got a window seat for the four of us. Our server was pleasant and we had good service. The food was fairly good for having to serve as many people as they did.
The service and atmosphere were really great. We had a window seat package with 4 courses. The starter was ok but the rest of the food and drinks were great.

We did the dinner cruise whilst on our honeymoon and loved it, the atmosphere was fantastic, the food great and it was a lovely way to see the sights along the river. The service was excellent and the boat very nice, the only reason we wouldn’t give it five stars is because the vegetarian option was tofu for starters and tofu for main - it felt like a bit of an afterthought, although at least there was an option! The food we had was delicious though, and there was plenty of it.

What else can i ask for more when BP has been maintaining a great standard for a perfect quality price on a dinner cruise. The meal has been excellent over the past 12 years with a smooth ride along Seine river.Love it so much that we have been repeating on may special occasion.
Very highly recommended for not just couple but for any combination of gathering.The agent on board are truly a gem with great standard of service. Though they are discreet but they are very attentive to our needs. Great big Smile along the journey and hardly find in other cruises.
Thank you Bateaux Parisiens.

My husband and I visited Paris this Fall and took this highly recommended dinner cruise and were so happy with our decision! It was our 3rd Anniversary and what better way to spend it touring the beautiful Parisian attractions! It was a formal evening with a very helpful and courteous staff who served us that evening. The food was wonderful, they have a preset menu to pick from. We were seated in the centre which gave us gorgeous views of the city. The fellow passengers were quite fun and everyone seemed to have a gala time that night. I think the duration of the cruise was perfect, not too short, not too long enough to get bored.
the entertainment of the evening was the melodious singing of the hosts which was one of my favorite moments of the tour. It was the perfect setting for a intimate yet social evening in the city.

We did this river lunch cruise on our last day. It was simply amazing. We were seated as soon as we arrived. Made our choices for our meals, everything was excellent from the Starters to the desserts. We loved our server he was friendly and fun. Thank you for our special day
We booked the cruise very last minute but so pleased we did Food, drinks and service were lovely, it was a very pleasant way to see Paris and its wonderful sights by night, definitely give it a go.

The food was amazing and the views were gorgeous. I wish the boat had gone a little slower so you could check out the amazing carvings on the bridges over the river. Other than that, it was a wonderful experience.

This was the best way to spend our last night in Paris. We had window seats, next to a lovely couple and the food, wine and sights were perfect. The entertainment was great, not intrusive but high quality jazz/pop band. Great experience overall. Highly recommend.

This was a wonderful experience! The food was good, our table was great. We enjoyed everything about this, even for the price! Loved being picked up, taken care of the whole time, and dropped back at our hotel! I would actually pay for this again! Do not plan it for your river tour of the city, do that on a cheap trip during the day, then just enjoy your evening with the lights.

Lovely cruise with a lovely meal. I especially loved the Eiffel Tower at night and later the mini Statue of Liberty and the Eiffel Tower in the same photo frame while the band sang "New York State of Mind." I'd give a 4.5/5 if I could. The only thing I didn't like was a party of three near us who kept playing loud music on their phones throughout the meal...but that's not the Bateaux's fault.

We were five friends on a special holiday trip to Paris. This was our last outing and really was the icing on the cake.
The boat was lovely and we all had a great view. The service was excellent, food was very good much better than I expected, plenty of wine and a welcome drink. The live music set the tone.
Only one small quibble. I would have liked an update on the main attractions as we passed. Perhaps some overhead sign but I would not want to ruin the ambience of the trip overall. I would definitely recommend it
Love it. Beautiful view of the Sena River, food was good and service superior. This is a must and take the 8:30pm

This dinner cruise was an amazing way to celebrate our anniversary. This group is excellent, very professional high quality service. The food and wine was also amazing. We upgraded to the window and it was well worth it.

Wonderful view of the Eiffel Tower from the river.
The three course dinner was delicious and the service was good.

The staff was so attentive and nice, the food was pretty good, and this was an ideal way to relax with friends while seeing some sights along the river. It was a really great ambiance for both couples and friends with plenty of wine and live music. I would highly recommend it!

We booked this Dinner, for our 20th wedding anniversary and it was spectacular. From the minute we arrived the service was fantastic and the food delicious. The view from the boat of the Eiffel Tower was amazing and the live music added the final touches.

The cruise provided surprisingly good food, our waiter was skillful and efficient, and the boat, although full, was not crowded to an unpleasant degree. Taking account of both the meal and the boat trip, the price was a bargain. There was, however, no commentary to explain where we were or what we should look at, and our cruise occurred in evening darkness. (Fortunately for us, two of our group live in Paris, and two others have visited Paris many times.)

The whole trip was lovely from start to finish... Paris by night and the food was great.. out waiter was also great!
Would definitely recommend

We thoroughly enjoyed the breathtaking views from the Seine which you could not imagine looking at the same monuments from the street. It is well worth going just to see the buildings lit up at night! The only way in my opinion to see the Eiffel Tower. The food I would give 3 stars and that is generous although the service was good.

Excellent service from start to finish and very attentive as my Wife was in a wheelchair. My Wife can walk a little which helps as the toilet is downstairs. Food and wine was amazing with spectacular views of Paris. Not cheap but what is in Paris.
Booked for our first night in Paris, well arranged and organised. Food was good and staff attentive, maybe would be nice if main focal points were pointed out more.

I always wanted to have a river cruise on the Seine, but always resisted for the tourist mood. This experience was unexpected: very well organized, very good service, good entertainment, good food and drinks. Not a cheap option at all. I was with my mother and we both liked it very very much!
This is a "must do" while in Paris. Delicious dinner, excellent service and a really fun amazing way to see Paris all lit up at night. I would highly recommend this activity.

We had a fabulous time. It was our anniversary and enjoyed every minute! The meal was good, wine was great and entertainment was a pleasant surprise. I would recommend it for couples who are looking for something different.
Went with my mother and teenage daughter. Loved it. Views were spectacular, service was incredible and the food was wonderful as well. Highly recommend.

Booked the two-hour dinner cruise and it was wonderful. Well-organized, polite and efficient staff with very clean boats, dining tables and incredible views. Make sure you book a table by the windows for the best experience, but really there's no bad view. The two-hour tour was just right as you are finishing dessert and coffee right before the tour ends. The food was very good, but review ahead of time because of the venue, you only have two (maybe three) options - but they were all good.

Overall a wonderful way to cap an evening of sight-seeing followed by a stroll under the very-close-by Eiffel Tower afterwards.

Highly recommended.
I had such a wonderful time on this fascinating dinner cruse. I was on a solo journey but I felt included the whole time. Great dining wonderful trip.

My family and I's experience on this dinner cruise was nothing short of amazing. Super organized company, timely, and the food was great. We also didn't know we got a bottle of wine on top of the welcome drink and appetizer drink. Amazing experience and well worth it.

We had a table by a window! What a gorgeous view of Paris architecture. The cruise was very restful and elegant.
The food was delicious! And service was very good.
So happy we planned ahead and booked it before leaving the USA.
I highly recommend this!
Not the first time we’ve used this service likely not the last good experience to be repeated, six of us three couples enjoyed the food and the ambiance

We were a table of 8 (4 couples). We went for the basic menu and we were all really impressed with the food. Great choice of French cuisine. The wine which was included was really nice and the choice of extra drinks was ok (bit pricey for the drinks not included, but that is to be expected). The staff couldn’t do enough for us and the entertainment was lovely. Seeing Paris at night was a great experience and we would definitely do it again.
Best part of our visit no doubt. Music and atmosphere was great. Great experience for couples. The time seemed to fly by while traveling down the river and back. Would definitely do it again.

It was a memorable night out in Paris on a gourmet dinner cruise along the Seine River. The food, wine and service was excellent. Live entertainment made the evening so romantic. The city of lights did not disappoint us! We paid extra for a seat by the window and it was worth it! The Paris landmarks were spectacular at night. Loved seeing the Parisians out along the river enjoying the warm evening with a bottle of wine and a baguette.
The fun and attentive staff, wonderful live entertainment, and the venue were all excellent. We had a wonderful time.

Evening cruise was excellent; the food was good, and the service was excellent, but when we went the first time, the boat was broken, and we were not able to go. Didn't find out until we got there - no email or message saying it was cancelled. Offer of a docked dinner and a separate sightseeing cruise wasn't what we paid for. Had we not been in Paris for an extra week, this would have been a disaster. Staff was helpful, but there was absolutely no consideration for the potential missed booking or inconvenience. The basic response was sorry, too bad for you. A great experience if it goes, but on our first try, it didn't.
The ambience was great, the city at night was breathtaking . Service was very good however food was mediocre at best

We did the cruise on our first night in Paris. The lighted monuments were beautiful, the food was great, and we met other interesting and lovely people from different areas. Our evening was topped off by a beautiful proposal at the next table. The vocalist sang to them and the whole boat erupted in cheers. We loved every minute!
This made my whole weekend. It was top class service an amazing setting and beautiful views. Highly recommend.
Really a wonderful evening! They even cheerfully helped us fix a glitch in our reservation that could have left us on the dock. I would reccommend them highly!

Was a great evening. Check in was easy and quick and the service on board was attentive and informative of what we were seeing.
Would recommend this.

What a beautiful evening we had on the boat. The sights were exceptional and the service was great. I didn't love the food but that could have been my selection as my partner's food was wonderful. Our wine glasses were all full which and the live music added to the atmosphere. Recommend this experience when exploring Paris
Very average experience and food for the price. Our service was very good but it seemed like we were being managed, not served.

The food, wine, atmosphere, and sights were amazing. It was much better than I expected. The staff worked their rears off to make sure we had a good experience, and their English was better than my French. I had a very good vegetarian dish. Finding the correct boat at the pier was a little challenging, so I would recommend being there a little early to sort that out. The experience was well worth the money.
Nice atmosphere, Nice staff, ,very nice and relaxing trip around the Seine with beautiful scenery of Paris! Food not that good and not a lot of varieties!

We booked this dinner cruise for our last night in Paris, where we were celebrating our 10 year wedding anniversary. We booked the premier service which guaranteed us a seat at the front of the boat. Our table for 2 was perfect! The booking and check in process were easy, and the service was impeccable. I did not read as closely as I should otherwise I would have known that, in addition to all of our champagne, we also got a bottle of red and a bottle of white wine with our meal! The service was impeccable and the food was amazing. I was a little cautious at first, wondering how they would be able to pull off a good meal on a boat like this. They did not disappoint. The site seeing was great, the entertainment was out of this world, and our overall experience, well, we could not have asked for a better ending to a perfect trip. Well worth it, in our opinion!

Food: 3/5
Wine selection: 4/5
Ambience: 5/5
Washrooms:3/5

Overall is pretty good. Views are amazing! Will repeat in future.
Food is good but not great.

Everything about the dinner cruise was romantic and magical. The service was impeccable, the food was delightful, the live music was engaging, and the cruise down the river, enchanting.
I have been on many dinner cruises, this was by far one of the most memorable one. If you plan to visit Paris, this cruise is a must!
This is a great Date Night tour or even just to go with friend and family. It was so beautiful and it's not too far from The Eiffel Tower.
Wonderful experience!!! Highly recommend. A must for your trip to Paris! Great atmosphere, food, entertainment, breathtaking night views, a truly enjoyable experience.

We really enjoyed our dinner cruise. The boat itself is extremely luxurious, well appointed, and very comfortable. The staff is organized, efficient, and highly attentive, but not intrusive. The food is really good, and there is a nice selection of options. We enjoyed the wine as well, although there was more than we could drink. We sat by the window, which was wonderful. The views were fantastic, as was the tour itself. There was a violinist and a singer, both of whom we're talented and engaging.
My only recommendation for improvement is that I wished they announced when we were passing a landmark. Although they provided a map, it was often hard to know what we were enjoying, so a heads up would have been very helpful.

A night to remember. We could discover Paris by night. See some of the most iconic monuments and places of the City. The boat was spacious. Table organise in such a way that you can really enjoy a romantic dinner.
The staff on board was really courteous, making sure you had a good evening.
The dinner was good. The only regret is that the trip only last 2:30 hours. Between the dinner and the look at Paris monuments, time really flew fast. We didn't have time to finish our wine. Great experience. Better evening. A must-do when in Paris.

Boat failed before it even left the dock. Staff is nasty and unhelpful. Made it seem like the mechanical failures were our fault. The compensation was a ferry boat tour on another day or to reschedule another dinner cruise. No option to refund.

They tried to serve dinner anyway, which was atrocious. Foie gras was frozen solid. Bread was stale. Even the wine was probably from a box. At that point we left. I've never been treated so poorly in my life. Run from this company!

Outstanding service, food and wine selection. Ours was the 8:30 departure. Lasted three hours with incredible views of landmarks and bridges. Did I mention we had a center table for 2 (cheapest) package. Don’t spend more.
Nightlife on the river was easily viewable as well.
the river cruise was excellent. the staff was nice and attentive. the food was delicious and the entertainment a plus
Fabulous time. Got exactly what we expected. Service, food and view were wonderful. Had a bit of a walk to find a taxi after the cruise was over.

We did the river cruise for the last night of our honeymoon and it was perfect. Great food and drinks - two full bottles of wine and a champagne toast. All the staff was very kind and professional as well. Definitely recommend for a couples activity!

The cruise was okay, dinner was mediocre. Would have expected a better selection of wines.. I mean, we are in France! The staff was nice, and attentive.

Tables are a bit cramped..
A fascinating way to get an overview of this amazing city with a unique perspective. Great food, service, setting and ambiance. I would recommend this experience to my friends.

We had a great dinner on the Bateaux Parisiens Dinner cruise. The staff was friendly and attentive. The ambiance was great for a nice dinner setting. They even included a nice map of all the buildings/attractions we'd be passing by inside of the menu. The only issue is that you're passing these amazing sites while you're eating the entire time, so you are not really paying attention to the tour part. Not to mention if you're sitting on the inner tables (non-waterfront) you can barely see anything that isn't large enough to see through the ceiling. Great experience overall. But it was one and done for me personally.

This is an experience that is very worthwhile for the opportunity to see Paris at night. The waiters seemed very busy but were accommodating and very polite. The live music playing was a real treat, the band were fantastic playing a range of pop hits (eg happy by Pharrell Williams) and some well known french numbers such as formi formidable. There was a photographer who came round and took photos of diners, with the option to buy them for €20 each which for some might be a nice souvenir.

The only downside was the menu was not great being a vegetarian, there was just one vegetarian option. However my partner is a meat eater and said the food was great (of course!)

Overall would highly recommend, just be prepared, if you have some kind of dietary requirement, for little choice.
Great food, music, and views along with excellent staff working the evening! I was surprised how much I liked the music. The whole evening was excellent.

The glass covered boat provided great views of many important sites in Paris. The ride was smooth; the service was very good; the food good; and the live music enjoyable and not intrusive. Overall, a great experience.

Little bit pricy should be able to up notch their food, but the service is really great. 2.5 hours was a good time to go around the see different scenes.
Last things tables are very very small they squeeze every inch..

What an incredible experience while à Paris :) highly recommend to everyone! Totally worth it. Food was incredible and the ambiance was unforgettable. When I come back to Paris in the future, I would 100% hands down go on the boat cruise again!

We planned this dinner cruise after arriving in Paris earlier in the day. Perfect for tired travelers. The dinner cruise allowed for beautiful views without too much walking. Did that earlier in the day. The boat was easy to find. Hotel and taxi driver new exactly where to embark on the dinner cruise. The service was friendly and efficient. The food was enjoyable, made better by the atmosphere and views. Overall, a very positive memory for my family of five. One warning, the taxi drivers will try to double the fair back to the hotel. Stand your ground.

We purchased the voucher for our dinner cruise via TripAdvisor and the options were a little confusing to fully understand; however, we went for the top-end package of the six course meal and, for us, it proved to be a fantastic bargain, well worth the money paid. The package included central seating (this is important because the live singers who provide the evening's entertainment move around you and your access to to the good opportunities for photographs as the ship passes by important venues, is maximized). You also start your meal with Champagne, have two (one white and one red) bottles of wine for your meals, six courses for the entire dinner and excellent wait staff. You must plan to arrive early by at least 30 minutes prior to boarding time at the dock to turn in your voucher for the actual tickets to board the assigned vessel. The entire dinner and cruise takes a little over 2 hours. Of note is that you should plan your post-dinner trip back to your hotel to take an extra 15 minutes or so to catch a taxi or get an Uber ride, If you decide to take one of the bicycle rickshaws that will be waiting near the exit stairs from the docks, be prepared to pay much higher transportation cost; although, the trip back to your location may be a more romantic journey!

Bit confusing finding right check in. Would advise leaving extra time. Cruise was excellent . Food was really good. We chose a window table and the views were amazing. Everyone was really helpful we did have to ask for coffee but it was quickly and graciously brought.

Had a fun birthday dinner evening cruise. The food and wine were good and the live music was particularly a great addition. Thank you for a great evening.
K & A from California.
This was AMAZING!! The staff was friendly, the food & wine was delicious. The boat cruise was wonderful. A great way to celebrate my 50th birthday and the last day in Paris.
We had a great experience. The staff was very nice and accommodating. I would definitely recommend this dinner cruise.
Expensive but worth every penny. This was the highlight of our trip and the staff were very welcoming and friendly.

Evening dinner cruise was a great way to end weekend in Paris. We purchased via travel agent but large group of 7 was easily catered for. Food was of a better standard than we expected and the whole experience was first class.

Booked this trip to celebrate a special birthday and we were not disappointed. Opted for a window table and the views were absolutely spectacular, Food and wine were excellent, service was good and the live entertainment made for a great atmosphere without being intrusive. One of the highlights of our trip and a must when visiting this beautiful city.

Very nice ship, great meal and service.
Punctual ....and glass walls and ceiling afforded great views. Exceeded our expectations.

Our group of 22 went on the 5 PM cruise recently and at 1 hour it was very rushed. Two years ago it was pleasant and 90 minutes. The captain said the 5 PM cruise has always been 1 hour. He told us the 2nd seating is two hours. The second seating also included live music, but it was significantly more money.
Food was great, had to pay extra for seat at the window Privilege reservation. Seat was not private as I had to share a boot with a stranger so it felt like we paid more for what is expected.
Wonderful dinner in a scenic city. Great service. I highly recommend the tables at the front of the boat. Well worth the higher price.

We visited Paris dozens of time and refused to go on those river cruise for fear of inadequate food. Well fear not! Not only the food was superb, but it was served with an industrial quantity of wine! The cruise was in the evening, so started in twilight to finish at night (with the Eiffel tower illuminated). A bit messy to return to the hotel afterward (crowd) but hey, c'est Paris!

Our family of 5, children ages 15, 12 and 9, enjoyed the sightseeing cruise and dinner. The 3 course dinner with wine was delicious. Our server was pleasant and spoke good English. The dinner was accompanied by live music and the musicians were talented. We highly recommend this experience.
An amazing evening, delightful attentive service and fabulously delicious food with wonderful views the best way to enjoy Paris and the Seine
Nice enviroment. Enjoyed the boat trip and scenery. Nice quality dinner. Service was fast. A bit cramped on seating though.

I booked this for my boyfriend and I to do for his birthday, and overall we had a very nice time. We were unfortunately seated at the wrong table (table 400 vs our assigned table 300) and as a result it felt that our server often forgot about us. In fact, she almost didn't give us our included champagne or wine and attempted to charge us for them despite me having bought a ticket that offered both, but once she realized it there was no issue. And the manager was very nice when my boyfriend's steak came out completely overdone, very quickly bringing back a perfectly cooked new one. Overall it's well worth it, but there were a few small dampers.
This was a nice relaxing way to visit Paris if you are only here for a few days. I highly recommend it.

Thank you for a great night. The food was wonderful and the wine great. The scenery breathtaking. I lost my phone at the end of the night when another guest took it by mistake. All of the staff were concerned and very helpful trying to find it. Luckily the other guest returned when she realised her mistake so all ended well.

Great dinner and cruise, sights were easily viewable and we were positioned right beside the window.
Service was excellent and the food was good and well presented.
The Seine at night is breathtaking. Watching activities along the bank before sunset and then city sights by dark was all that was anticipated

The experience overall was excellent. The boarding process could have been streamlined but the view and dinner made it worthwhile. Would definitely do again if go back to Paris. Music and ambience were very good.

I am giving this a very good rating because we happened to be seated out of the direct sun and our waiter Daniel was excellent and gave us some history and background on several things we were seeing. The food was mediocre at best. I ordered the streak and it was very stringy. For a city like Paris where every restaurant is superb this was a let down. The tables in the sun had people literally beading with sweat.

My boyfriend booked this as a suprise for my birthday and it was brilliant and so romantic. The staff were brilliant and continuously top up your wine glass throughout. The boat itself is beautiful and a great of seeing Paris especially when it goes dark and you get to see the Eiffel tower lit up, so lovely! There was live entertainment on the boat and a photographer even came round and took a picture of us which was a nice keepsake to buy. If I was to return to Paris, I would 100% do this again.

This was a great experience and well worth it. The instructions of where to go were very clear, the food was excellent, the value for the money was very high compared to other places in Paris and it was all around great. For some reason I thought this would be a tour of some sort, with commentary, but it was not. Just like eating as a restuarant but it's moving all the way through the great parts of Paris. I would definitely recommend checking it out.

We did the early bird dinner cruise with 10 people. I do think a sightseeing tour with this company would be great and possibly the late dinner cruise which lasts longer. The early bird boat ride was barely over an hour long. It felt like we were speed eating as the food (very average) was brought out very quickly. That left very little time to go on the top of the boat and see the sights. I didn't think about the wall that goes up from the water to the streets of Paris when I made the reservation, so with the roof covered with a tarp, we really couldn't see very much. I would definitely recommend doing a sightseeing only trip with this company and then getting dinner afterwards in a restaurant.

Great visual, relaxing 2 hour cruise with an excellent dinner. We ended our Paris experience taking this cruise after a morning at Versaille and it was the perfect ending to our stay in Paris. The crew was extremely courteous. The Seine is a beautiful river.

Normally, we don't take photos but the photographer on this dinner cruise took some exceptional ones that we just had to purchase and normally I am very reluctant to purchase photos.

Boarding is very near the Eiffel Tower, Taxis are readily available but you do have to walk up stairs from the river to get to the Taxi crew

Cost 356e ($399).

Although the meal, server and entertainment were exceptional, there was zero commentary about the landmarks as we floated by. There was also not even a small dance floor for our romantic final evening in Paris. Very disappointed.

I mean don’t get me wrong the view and being by the window was great. The food just wasn’t good at all. We arrived 15 minutes before check in closed and it seemed as the night progressed everyone else ate before us. I got the snail pie for a starter and duck for entree. My fiancé got the beef. It just wasn’t good. The duck was dry and very tough. The beef wasn’t good. They do have live music, but it felt for the 2.5 hour ride, they only sung like 8 songs. Overall, it was a let down and expensive. Like I said the view was great and waving to everyone but not worth the money for the food.
It was a great experience. Service was good with minimal wait times and well organized. 3-course dinner was delicious.

We took the diner at 8u30 and it was perfect! The food was great, the views were fantastic and the ambiance was wonderful!

a must do if you are in Paris for a few days!

This trip was suggested and organised by our hotel and although it wasn't exactly cheap it was worth every penny.
The food and wine served with the meal were excellent. The entertainment on the boat was really good quality and the staff were professional, efficient and friendly.
I would definitely recommend this trip to anyone wanting a grown up evening out.
We enjoyed this trip very much. The food and wine were great, the service excellent and the views of Paris are wonderful.
Views were lovely and you got to see monuments from all new angles. The food was okay but the dessert was great at least.

We paid extra for the premium package, which we were not disappointed. The service was top notch along with spectacular views of historic sites. The entrees were okay, the wines enhances the atmosphere. Both of us had the premium seating, which was what we paid for. The live music performed by the female singer was wonderful and quiet romantic. Highly recommended activity; if you could pay a little more for the prestige or premium seating, please do so.

Had a three course dinner after dark with live music. The food itself was amazing, the staff was very helpful and friendly, the musicians and singers were talented and Paris at night did what I guess only Paris can do. Fantastic experience. If anything it was slightly cramped, but it wasn't really a problem. They bring you enough food and definitely give you enough to drink. Treat yourself!

This river cruise was very well done, it was highly relaxing and the views were amazing. The food was quite good and the service was outstanding. It was a bit on the expensive side but felt worth it. We booked at the PRIVILEGE level and had a perfect table that felt quite intimate despite being on a large boat. Highly recommend.

the cruise is great, setting is perfect, food was great.
loved the fact that the food was served early which allowed time for enjoying the cruise.

very much recommended!

This was the first time we’d ever splashed out for NYE and we were a bit anxious about what to expect, but we needn’t have been! The boat was absolutely beautiful and we had an excellent table very close to the windows. The service was fantastic with a very attentive waiter who was extremely knowledgeable about the food, wine, the sights and their history. The food was exquisite and so tasty, if anything there was too much. The waiter kept offering wine and champagne so our glasses were never empty. We went up and down the river and were at the foot of the Eiffel Tower for Midnight - we were given hats and party paraphernalia for the countdown which was lovely! We did tip the waiter at the end, as you would in a restaurant. The live music was excellent and not too loud or interfering. There was a professional photographer on board but no obligation to buy. We didn’t stay for the disco once we’d docked but it looked like a good party! We were at the boat for 7:30pm and docked at 12:30pm so it was a good amount of time. If you want to do something special for NYE, I highly recommend this! It’s expensive, but SO worth it :)

This was a great way to eat dinner and experience Paris at night by water! The atmosphere was romantic and in fact, the site of a marriage proposal right beside us. I would not recommend this dining experience for young children but if you have to bring them, they are welcome.

If you are looking for a date night in Paris then this is the dinner cruise for you, the staff and service is impeccable and the views are stunning.

So worth the money for whatever option you choose for your cruise, the entire experience is memorable and something to take home in your mind long after your holiday ends.

This was our first trip to Paris, and after spending a week in and around the city I felt that the last night ought to be a romantic dinner cruise. So with high hopes I booked the early (6:15pm) cruise. We were not disappointed. We had booked a window table, and the seating area was very chic looking. Good wine flowed freely. The food was very good. Service was excellent. The views of the "city of lights" were great. Took too many more pictures of the Eiffel Tower as we neared the end of our cruise. This was exactly what I had hoped for. A great experience and a fitting, romantic end to our visit to Paris.

We decided last minute to take this tour and truely was so much fun! Already we had walked for kms taking in the sights, so to sit back enjoy delicious food and plenty of alcohol was great! We took the 79 euro package included champagne on arrival, we also drank a bottle of red and a bottle of white all included, food was amazing, service spectacular, entertainment so French!

First of all the the person they have at the door said he does not know what the cruise name is and when I went in they told me he does not know. Why do you have someone at the door who does not know the name of the cruise. Once inside I asked for the restroom and one of the guy told me to go straight to the right and I went straight to the right and a lady screamed at me that I'm not allow there. Please avoid and try a different cruise.

I went solo the last night of my stay in Paris. Some reviews said it wasn't good for a solo traveler, but I disagree. This was a perfect experience. The staff took amazing care of me and were very attentive. I paid for the window-seat upgrade and loved it, I never felt "alone". It was one of the best parts of my trip! Pay for the window seat. I didn't go for the "front of boat" seat, and I'm not sure it would've been worth the extra cost. My seat was perfect.

We loved our dinner cruise! This was a great way to start our trip, and allowed us to get our bearings in Paris early on. We expected the food to be an after-thought, but it was actually a great meal for both of us (and we can be a bit picky). As they have a limited menu with a few offerings for each to choose from, they do each one well. Do note that (at least on the 8:30pm dinner cruise), they don't announce every sight you're going to see as you see it, because they would honestly never stop making announcements, but instead give you a guide so that you can follow along while you eat and listen to the live music. Both singers were fantastic and our wait-staff was kind and accommodating throughout. I didn't find the "we leave at 8:15pm with or without you" warning to be very strict - we kicked off at about 8:30-8:35ish and they seemed to be able to allow a couple or two to board after 8:15 (though I wouldn't push it). We purchased the Privilege tickets, which gave us window seats, which I would recommend if you have yet to take in all of the sights and/or are hoping to get pictures. This was a wonderful dinner cruise and I actually wouldn't mind doing it again the next time we're in Paris!

We booked this for our last evening and were tired and quite unenthusiastic about it. As it happened it turned out to be the best meal and best experience of the whole trip. The service was excellent as was the food. Could not fault one bit.

We booked the cruise to celebrate our 10th Wedding Anniversary and it was fantastic. The food was gorgeous, our waiter was very attentive (wish i could remember his name)and the wine kept flowing. The view was great even though our table was one in from the window. Definitely worth it.

Went with 11 ladies on the 6:15 dinner cruise. We thought it included music but found that was only on the later cruise. A little disappointed. Food was good, not great. Wine was average. It was a nice trip down the Seine and we saw the bridges, Notre Dame, the statue of Liberty and Eiffel tower all lit up and beautiful. I guess for the price, I would have agreed to go for dinner and the cruise. Felt rushed off, especially when the flashed the lights off & on!

I went on this tour last week and it was incredible from start to finish. The seating, the food, the service and the entertainment were top class!
Very romantic and beautiful way to see the sights in the night. I would definitely recommend this to all. Worth every penny!

We did an early dinner cruise, just before sunset. It was very enjoyable to see Paris from the river in a boat where it was easy to see both sides of the river. The meal was very good and our waiter was very congenial.
The dinner cruise was easy to find at the bottom of the Eiffel Tower. We had good service and the food was excellent.

We planned the cruise from New Zealand to celebrate our daughter's 40th birthday with the family. The cruise and dinner lived up to everything we had hoped it would be and more. Wonderful food and wine with a great view of Paris by day and night. I would recommend this to anyone.

We had beautiful Service from Start to End!

before boarding we had an english speaking staff (which isnt very common in paris/france) who gave us our tickets and guided our way towards the right boat/pier.

followed by a check-in by a buttler and garcons who led us to our dining table. Since we had a reservation for the privilage seating weve gotten all our meals and drinks as described.

with a bottle of water, wine (white and red each) included in our menu we didnt order anything extra. the garcon really kept an eye on our glasses so that it kept being refilled without bothering us noticeably!

the food choice was good and very nice. while I had excellent food my girlfriend picked the shortstraw and got polenta which really wasnt very nice.

the wines on the other hand were really good! we arent wine drinkers but those wines we had definitly changed our minds in wine.

I can highly recommend this evening boattour if you want to have a fancy dinner/date or just wanna check out the service.

my favourite part was the live music! it was amazing!

we went end of october and even though it was like below 10°C outside temperature the boat had decent AC so it wasnt really cold. "just" chilly in normal chemises and light clothing (dress code).

Fantastic evening from beginning to end. Perfect food and wine. The view was amazing. The booking said we would be sat in the middle of the book but we were placed right by the window so that was a bonus. Music was great. The only thing that was tricky was finding the boat as the pontoons were numbered the same way in both directions. So a tip for anyone going is its the pontoons to the right when facing the water.
Our group of 3 enjoyed a wonderful meal onboard. Our boat was very nice. The food was tasty and the waiters attentive and courteous.

Booked this 830pm dinner cruise for two people. There was a good menu choice and plenty of wine to go around. The service was excellent and we had a great view of Paris from the centre of the boat. Would highly recommend! It was a lovely end to our stay in Paris.

Booked this as a birthday treat as we were staying close to the Tower near to where the pier is located. We had a table right next to the window although it seemed as though you'd get a good view from any table as the windows are large and encompass the roof.

The food and service were very good, the best sea bass I've tasted. As I'd mentioned in the reservation that it was for a birthday they even brought out a special birthday cake for dessert which was delicious.

We saw an engagement at one of the tables and this seems like a very good place albeit quite a public one.

We did the top of the line, 8:30 cruise. I wanted this to be a memorable experience for her birthday a week ago. The company went out of their way with a special "happy birthday" song by the live band and a special cake for my fiance. The service was great. Our waiter was always attentive to our requests. He filled up our glasses when we were low on wine. Food timing was not rushed and not delayed, just perfect. He even gave us some pointers about the landmarks.

We really like these cruises, both for lunch and dinner, but this one wasn't quite as good as the past two years. They have always done gluten-free perfectly and this year they brought his starter with toast on top (had to be replaced) and they didn't give him the mignardise although I gave him my macaron which I'm knew he could have. The other problem was that this was the first time we didn't have a table at the window and I had to switch seats with my husband because I had a spotlight over my head that was shining right into my eyes. I was miserable. They need to look at their lighting. I wished I could have unscrewed that light. Otherwise, very nice. Food and wines were good. Singers didn't come around as often as in the past.

We went in July 2018 during the heat wave, the boat was marvelous, the music grand, the sights at night from the river are breath taking. The actual food and wine was amazing and the staff was so friendly and attentive. I would recommend that everyone make a reservation and experience Paris at night on the river!

We enjoyed this river boat dinner cruise. Service was excellent, staff were very friendly. food was very good. Boarding and seating for the 630 PM dinner was fast and efficient. It was a nice relaxing cruise on the Seine, and we could see so many wonderful sights thru the glass windows. We recommend this dinner cruise.

We got the Privilege service.

Good
The food was good.

Bad
The service was one of the worst I have ever experienced in all of my travels across the world. McDonald’s has better service than this place.

We arrived at 8:19 to board the ship. Everyone around us was served wine and water and being attended to. The servers came by but never bother to ask us if we wanted water or wine (see pictures). We sat around for 20-25 minutes before we were finally tended to with WATER. See the pictures.

When we got our food the servers were also confused on what we ordered constantly giving us the wrong order and mixing it up with the ones behind us. Even they got annoyed at the server.

We also had to constantly ask for them to bring us a bottle of wine. Which again took forever. We didn’t get our wine until the couple next to us got their starters and wine half finished!

The windows on the ship was quite dirty so even if you tried to take picture they wouldn’t come out right.

Conclusion
I would not go on this cruise again. If I were to do a cruise again I would pick another company.

A window seat is a must to enjoy the full experience. But you pay a big premium for the experience. Perhaps explore other options for an evening boat cruise that doesn't come with such a hefty price tag.

The food was ok, as was the service. Nothing special, really.

Only had a short time in Paris which included a day in Normandy to visit D-Day sites. My friends had never been to Paris so this was a good way to see key pieces of city. Paid extra for window seats and better menu but it was worth it.

Paris at night, cruising the Seine! Absolutely magical experience! The food was delicious served with bottles of wine by a very attentive server. Highly recommend this especially for romantic couples. We took the 8:30 evening dinner cruise which lasted about 3 hours. Not for children at this hour!

We were arriving from London without much time for any sight seeing so we thought we’d give this a try. It was a beautiful night, the sights were amazing especially the Eiffel Tower all lit up. Unbeknownst to us, the couple sitting next to us were about to become engaged. As I saw him get on one knee I was able to video their important event and send it to them. It was a joyous event for all and the food was very good.

My wife and I went on the 6pm dinner cruise. Finding the dock was easy and boarding had three lines to help the boarding process go faster. Once on board our waiter was on the spot serving wine.
