If your glass got low he was there to refill. The dinner was good as well and enjoyable. As we pass landmarks the waiter would point them out. So not only a waiter but a tour guide as well. On my next visit to Paris I will book this cruise again. hats of to all of the staff who made this a great experience.

We had just arrived in Paris and this was our first experience of the city. After having researched various boat-trip options, I selected this one because it was a dinner cruise with spectacular sights, but no commentary. Yes, our waiters did point out various places as we were passing but the overall experience was a romantic dinner for 2 with live music and great atmosphere. Seeing the buildings "lit up" was very impressive - Notre Dame and Eiffel Tower in particular. The music was pleasant, not too loud and a mixture of English/French. The food was delicious and our service was excellent. I think it is definitely worth paying the extra few Euros to ensure a window table rather than being in the center of the boat (unless travelling in a larger family group maybe). Communication was via email with good directions to the quay (same side of river as Eiffel Tower, i.e. opposite side to Bateaux Mouche). A terrific evening, lovely experience, highly recommended.
Fantastic Service, beautiful food, great entertainment in the background and wonderful sights a long the way. Well worth the cost and would highly recommend

We had taken the evening dinner cruise many years ago so we decided to try the lunch cruise. We chose the Privilege Option which guarantees a window table. Great choice and first class operation from the time you board the boat.

Be warned that the Bateaux Parisiens moorings are one the Eiffel Tower side of the Seine. The lunch cruise lasted over two hours. As much wine a you could drink and a singer provided live entertainment.

Best tip I can give is to reserve a window table as the masses pay 10 Euros less and are crowded at big tables above you. You don't want to be there if you can help it. It is a much better experience on the window as those tables are a step down and separated. The views are great. They give you a card with pictures of the buildings and an explanation as well as a narration over the speakers which are difficult to hear with the singer singing:-)

Lots of fun....do it. You will not be disappointed. By the way...a few teens were on our cruise and they looked bored to tears.

This was a special occasion for us and the cruise did not disappoint. The evening cruise commenced around dusk and the main sights of the Seine river bank were seen in all their floodlight glory including the Eiffel Tower, National assembly, palaces, Notre Dame and many other magnificent buildings culminating with a view of the Statue of Liberty with the Eiffel Tower as a backdrop. Apart from the cruise itself the live entertainment and dinner were excellent giving a unique ambiance to the evening. I would recommend the evening cruise to see the floodlit sights as there are cheaper alternatives for a daytime cruise - we did both taking in a daylight cruise as part of a Big Bus hop on hop off tour. These events may seem expensive but are well worth the money - how often will you be seeing the sights of Paris, so do it in style. There are other dinner/lunch cruises available but judging by the style and pannash of Bateaux Parisien I would say they are the best. A high premium price is charged for window seats and there are different levels of service and prices. 'You pays your money and takes your choice' but our experience was not degraded at all by choosing a central table rather than a window spot - the view is panoramic wherever you are, but the price jump is considerable for moving 1.5m closer to the window to view things 50-100m away!! I recommend a prompt arrival, at least 45mins before sailing as check in queues can build up especially when coach parties arrive. We travelled under our own steam by Uber from Montmartre for a cost of around 10 Euro, about a 15 min drive in heavy traffic - another good reason for allowing plenty of time - the boat will not wait even if you've booked and paid in advance. For main course I had fillet of beef (sorry I'm a roast-a-beef english) my partner had duck which was cooked perfectly pink but proved to be a bit tough. The headwaiter didn't hesitate to change the dish and made sure our wine glasses were kept full all evening. A great night all round.

This boat/dinner cruise down the Seine was a highlight of my Paris trip. The boat was clean and comfortable, the food was good and the entertainment (singer) was good. The service was very good as well. I truly loved this experience and it was one of my favourite evenings in Paris. The sights at night from the boat were amazing. I would highly recommend this boat/dinner cruise. The only thing that I need to mention is that the only way to really get the best out of the experience is to book a window seat - but it's HUGELY EXPENSIVE! It's true that the best way to experience it is by a window. If you are stuck in the middle of the boat, you can't see as well and it just wouldn't be the same. But they charge a huge amount to reserve a window. I paid the price as it was a once in a lifetime Paris experience for me. However, the food should really be higher standard for the price. I was shocked at how much it actually cost. But I must admit, it was so much fun and an experience I won't forget. I really did my research and chose this boat company because the other companies were getting terrible reviews. I am glad I chose this Boat for our dinner. Thank you for a great time! My best friend and I loved it!

When we booked this we were advised the best way to do this is with the "premier" package which included front of the boat and premium wines. It was relatively expensive (almost $500.00 for two) but i can say it was worth the extra money to be at the front. The sights of the Seine lit up at night were spectacular. The only thing that keeps me from giving this activity a 5 star was the food. While it was good it was no where near what i expected. The wine on the other hand was excellent.

One thing we did do right was book the later cruise. The lights on the Eiffel Tower were spectacular as viewed from the boat!!!

Rick

We originally thought this cruise would have terrible food and would be very touristy. But our travel agent convinced us that it’s a “must do”, so we reluctantly agreed. We were pleasantly surprised at how wonderful the food, service and ambiance was. It was the perfect dinner/activity to do on our first night in Paris! We spent the extra money to get the upgraded seats and champagne - sitting at the front of the boat, which was great! We must have missed the small print about white and red wine being included, but it flowed all night and was nice. We found the rest of the service in Paris to be very slow and lousy, but service this night was great. We highly recommend!!

I came to Paris in the evening and was planning to take my daughter to Disneyland the next day and leave for home the following morning. So with such a tight schedule and not enough time to explore Paris on a bike and/or foot I decided to take the 1-hour boat cruise on the Seine. I bought the tickets at a vending machine at the port just across from the Eiffel Tower but would recommend buying them online because often there are offers and deals. Buying tickets online helps avoid the lines on site. Adult ticket was 15 Euros and for a child 7 Euros. The line to board the boat was really long and we had to wait for a while (make sure to pack a bottle of water but if you don't there are vending machines with various beverages). Once on board we decided to sit on the roof. If you opt to sit inside you can use the translated guides while on the roof a crew member explains the various sites the boat passes but sometimes it is hard to hear from the noise. The evening (it was just getting dark) was really nice and warm so the roof was the better choice. The tour takes about an hour and leaves from the Eiffel Tower goes down the river around Île de la Cité towards the University (passing by Notre Dame, Louvre, Pont Neuf and other bridges...).

The service was very friendly and food was good, but as a solo traveler I think I should have done the regular one hour tour instead. I was wishing someone was telling me what buildings I was seeing. It wasn’t worth the cost to me in the end. I may have felt differently if I was with someone.

This was a fantastic experience and worth every penny. I upgraded the package to a window seat and could not of been happier.
The food is not the best food I've had but it was nice and this did not matter!! The service was fantastic, the ambience was amazing, the sites as the sunset were incredible, the wine was flowing, it was just fantastic.
Nice ride down the Seine river. The only issue was the audio on the boat needs to be fixed. It screeched throughout the entire ride.

We paid almost $600 aus dollars for 2 of us to do this activity. The meal was nice, prob worth $100 at most. Tge lift wasnt working so we has to walk down 22 flights of stairs. The cruise was nice. I arranged this tour to ccelebrate our 50th wedding anniversary. I am sorry but we were dissapointed.

Amazing, the best of Paris!!!!
The foos and the wine a wonderful experience.
The music is breathtaking.

The night was faultless, very romantic. Paid for the premier service and it was worth every penny, you are taken to the very front of the boat with an impeccable view. Service was fantastic with glasses of wine and champagne constantly being topped up. Food was faultless with vegetarian options. Live music isn’t intruding and complements the atmosphere well. Would definitely do again one day.

Amazing experience for couples. We paid for the premier package and it was great. Very sociable waiter, the food was delicious and the drinks were local and very good. Live music and a lovely and romantic atmosphere on the Seine. They even had a professional photographer that took pictures of us on the cruise. I highly recommend this activity when visiting Paris as a couple!

We paid for the premier service to sit at the front of the boat and for the extra wine/menu items. It was well worth it. Service is truly exceptional. Perfect venue for our proposal with a live singer and a professional photographer on hand!

We did this tour to get a glance of the city by boat. The boat is really cool and seem very elegant inside. Everything started on time which is always good. When the doors are open, you are escorted to your table. The service was very attentive and took care of us all the time.

They first serve you a bottle of wine, either red or white, which makes the journey much more enjoyable.

Then the food was when the disappointment started. First of all they didn’t bring the correct entree but because I didn’t want to wait, I decided to eat it. For the main course, we both got the steak. Mine was cold and my wife’s very chewy.

During our trip a photographer came and asked if we wanted to take a memory picture. At the end of our trip, she came and offered 4 pictures for 15 euro each. We bought just one.

The boat had AC and a good music in the back. Since it’s glass sealing we feel the sun over our heads during the journeys, but nothing bad. We saw couples and families, so the boat seem to be kids friendly.

Overall it was a good experience for someone looking to have dinner in the sienna river and watch all the beautiful monuments around it.
What an amazing evening my husband and I had. The food was delicious and the staff were lovely. We got to see such amazing views with a great, romantic ambience. Would highly recommend.
The food was good, the wine was flavorful and the sites of Paris as we cruised along the Seine were lovely.

It’s absolutely my favourite place in Paris, it’s the third time I have dinner there and I have never been disappointed. The service was good, food was delicious, the promenade absolutely fantastic! Champagne and wine served during the dinner and live music warming up the atmosphere. The worst thing was the absence of a child menu, the best thing ever Tour Eiffel sparkling in front of us at the end of the cruise.

I booked the dinner cruise for Bastille Day which is advertised that you can view the fireworks from the boat. Which is not true. The main reason I booked the dinner cruise was so I could see the fireworks. So it was a large disappointment. The boat docked to the pier and we waited for the fireworks. Because we were docked no one on the port side could see anything but the dock.

The only place you could see the fireworks from was either the back of the boat which was outdoors but was a very small space which got filled up very quickly. Or the front of the boat which we were not allowed to go to unless you paid for seating in the front.

The food was good but service was inconsistent. Overall I would not recommend this dinner cruise. Recommend trying some of the other companies like yachts de paris or bateaux mouches

Although a bit more expensive than most meals you will have in Paris, this is absolutely worth the cost. The food is fantastic, as well as the wine. But most importantly, the views are unlike any you can get on land. This was one of my partner's favorite parts of our trip, and will probably be yours too. Don't miss your chance to see the city from the water, it really is something else!

I gave this a 4 star because if you're a "foodie" you're not going to love the food served on board. We took this tour our last night to see Paris as night. It's relaxing to float along and sip some wine. The service is really nice. I would book this more for the opportunity to tour Paris at night on the water. It's very beautiful. There is a dress code but not many adhere to it. I word a dress and flats and my husband slacks and a button down shirt but many were in shorts and flip flops and no one was turned away. Book the front of the boat for the best views.

We booked out dinner cruise last minute as we could not decide what to do for our 30th Anniversary (other than visit Paris of course!)
We were not disappointed.

We choose the Privilege service. We started with a welcome glass of bubbly and then on to the wine. Although the info stated we would receive a half bottle of wine we ended up with four glasses of white and a bottle of red between the two of us 😵 The food was very good and plentiful- 4 courses. Service was good. The waiters have their work cut out for them but appear very organised.

It was great to see the city from the river and to watching the world go by.

It was a fabulous night and although not cheap I would recommend it.

Fantastic experience viewing Paris from the river at night. We did the 8.30pm etoile dinner which was ideal as we arrived when the sun was low, got to watch it set and also enjoy the lights. In summer wouldn't recommend going any earlier than that. Food was exceptional and the service was great too, highly recommended!

We had read a number of reviews with ratings of 1, 4 and 5 stars. We had no idea what to expect. Upon arrival we moved quickly through the ticket issue and boarding process where we were lead to our table byour server, by the window as booked. The champagne was a bit long in coming but it was quite drinkable. We were served a bottle of good chardonnay and a bottle of a drinkable ref. Way too much for two people but better too much than too little. My wife had the asparagus followed by the sea bass. I had the salmon fillet and the tenderloin of beef. Despite some of hte reviews especially about the beef, our meals were absolutely delicious. My gluten intolerance was not well planned for but it was accommodated. Our server seemed knowledgeable about the condition and the foods served onboard. We were celebrating the occasion of my wife's 72nd birthday and the entire evening was special to us.

My husband was very hesitant about us spending the money to go on the dinner cruise but was happily surprised at the end. The food was wonderful, our waiter was funny and provided good service and information about the monuments. We loved the wine! It was very easy to find in front of the Eiffel Tower. Had great live entertainment and a photographer (photos were a bit pricey though). It was a great evening, very romantic. My only watch out would be the street peddlers outside, they will shove things into your hands as you are disembarking and demand to be paid for them. We highly recommend this to anyone looking to do a dinner cruise, especially on one of your first nights in Paris!

Apologies for this review being a year late! We went to Paris for my Birthday last June (2017) and the Bateaux Parisiens dinner cruise was the highlight of my trip!! Just a note of caution we almost missed the cruise as they do leave promptly so get to the dock early. We went on the 8.30pm dinner cruise which is 2 hours 30 minutes, arriving back at the dock at 11 pm, on this cruise you go past Notre Dame and Musee d'Orsay and of course the Eiffel Tower where the cruise also starts. Its worth paying more for the 8.30pm cruise as it is a more formal dining experience compared to the other dinner cruises. It is a perfect time too as you get to watch the sunset from the boat and you can see the Eiffel tower sparkle (usually from 11pm-1pm on the hour).

Though the dinner cruise is expensive (we paid 169 euros for each person) it is worth every penny, especially for a special occasion. There is entertainment on the 8.30pm cruise, the live female singer was beautiful. We paid extra for privilege seating (seating right next to the window) this meant we could really enjoy sightseeing whilst on the cruise and it felt more private. There is no need to sit at the very front of the boat in the privilege section which is 35 euros more but I would definitely pay for the window seat in privilege. If you can only afford one expensive meal in Paris I would recommend doing the 8.30 dinner cruise rather than a meal at one of the restaurants in the Eiffel tower.

The service was so attentive by our waiter, no request was too big. And they remembered that it was my birthday which was a lovely touch. For 169 euros each person had a starter, main course, bread, cheese selection, dessert and a bottle of wine to share between 4 people. The food was average but everything tasted nice, was well cooked and the portions were large. Desert was lovely!!

I would recommend going to the back of the boat, you can stand outside and take in the view properly! And book the 8.30pm dinner cruise in advance as I know it sells out quickly!

this was more than worth the money, not only is the cruise an amazing way to see the city, the food and service is well worth the money.
we done the lunch cruise, which also included a welcome kir royal, a bottle of white wine and a bottle of red wine, bottle of evian water plus a 3 course meal, outstanding food and service, would highly recommend this

We opted for the Premiere dining selection (seated next to the window) which I think was absolutely worth the extra price. Our meal included a starter of fois gras and a glass of champagne, followed by scallops and white wine, we then had veal rump as our main course and a bottle of red for us to share, a cheese course, a traditional Christmas dessert of Buche de Noel and then ended with macaroons and another glass of champagne! I was also impressed at the quality of food aboard the boat. I would definitely recommend the dinner cruise to anyone looking for a uniquely Parisian dining experience! This review is intended to be as succinct, precise, and useful as possible. I have my own subjective opinion, which I am not going to hide from you--in fact, I am going to state it right at the beginning of this review, and then not again.

To start with the subjective conclusion:

If you are hoping to have a nice cruise and get to know Paris from a different perspective: Yes, by all means try Bateaux Parisiens. It is going to be a pleasant sightseeing cruise.

But, if you are looking to spend a special day in Paris, e. g. an anniversary, do not select this cruise. You will be disappointed.

The following are the facts, as objectively as I can recount them:

My partner and I came to Paris to celebrate our anniversary together. We chose Bateaux Parisiens, 20:30 p. m. dinner cruise, Premier Service category (410 € for two), over Ducasse Sur Seine evening cruise (380 € for two).

We had let Bateaux Parisiens know beforehand, via email, that this was going to be a special night for us.

Since Bateaux Parisiens offers a birthday surprise for an additional charge of 10 € (the surprise consists of a piece of birthday cake instead of the a la carte dessert, a birthday song sung by the live singer), we had asked for a way to pay a bit more and receive an anniversary surprise.

Specifically, I had asked them if it would be possible to have someone put a small note on our table saying "Happy anniversary!". Either this or a single rose.
I would have been happy to pay extra for the service but did not even receive an email reply.

At no point did Bateaux Parisiens reply to any of our messages.

This lack of communication continued during the cruise.

One (of many) example(s) shall suffice for the purpose of illustration before moving on to the next piece of information:

My partner does not drink alcohol, which we had communicated beforehand.

When it became clear no one on board knew about it, we asked for a non-alcoholic option.
The attending waitress asked one of us (not even each of us) exactly once what we would like to drink and did not allow us/ give us the opportunity to change our drink afterwards.

This was not a singular occurence: Even when serving coffee/dessert, the waitress continued to ask only one of us, perhaps assuming my partner would have "whatever I make her have".

Thus, we paid 410 Euros for the meal and accompanying wine but were served Coke Zero the entire evening of our anniversary as a replacement for the wines.

This was especially troublesome, as my partner needs sugary drinks to regulate her blood sugar.

With a meal as long as this (2.5 hours), it is not always possible to estimate the needed medication beforehand and precisely, such that having a glass of juice/ regular soda at hand becomes a necessity.

When we tried to ask for a sugary drink, the waitress ran away.

She had much work to do and the lights on ship are dim, but it does not seem plaubsible to claim she neither heard nor saw our repeated asking while serving or cleaning our table. She was standing right next to us, when we asked her.

Eventually, after trying to get a hold of her for three times, we talked to a server who had been serving a different table.

This waiter kindly brought us the glass of pineapple juice we asked him for, but, frankly, at this point, we were too exhausted to ever want to ask for anything again. (Which I would still have done had my partner's blood sugar dropped significantly, but we really did not feel like it anymore.)

It was our anniversary, and we did not wish to waste our time arguing with the service staff over a few glasses of Coke or juice.

The live singer on board was good and very dedicated.

A photographer went around taking pictures (at least in the premier category).

But be advised: We saw her skip tables when guests seemed clothed casually, which struck us as equally rude (given everyone had paid the same price) and dumb (given some very wealthy people simply prefer comfortable clothing).

The food was as advertised.

The entire staff was hard-working and did their jobs well, but, as recounted, this job did not include tailoring their service to individual circumstances.

I have given this review not in spite or grief (as evidenced by the still average rating, which I take to mean "average for the price paid"), but in the hope of helping other travelers make the right choice for themselves.

Do not expect "premier service" to mean the service will be attentive or tactful.

Expect it to mean you will receive a seat in the front of the boat, with a good view of beautiful landmarks of one of the most beautiful cities in the world.

The work on ship seemed very difficult, and the staff timed their work perfectly to match food and music with the sightseeing tour, which is in itself miraculous.

But, this perfection comes at the cost of a severe lack of flexibility.

We had chosen Bateaux Parisiens over Bateaux mouches, expecting the lower number of guests per ship to enable the staff to be more attentive overall.
Likewise, we had chosen Bateaux Parisiens over Ducasse Sur Seine, hoping the higher service category and price would translate into a more attentive waiting staff, even on a relative, intra-ship basis. (Food was not our priority this time, as there are better restaurants on land then on water.)

Whether the other two cruises are better, I cannot judge.

But, if you find yourself in a similar position, thinking about spending your anniversary or special day on Bateaux Parisiens, I cannot recommend it.

Save yourself this option for another time, when the two/three etc. of you are happy to go with the flow, and even then, perhaps, just take the cheaper privilege service (= window seating to the sides of the boat), as there is barely a difference in view and most probably no difference at all in quality of service.

The evening tour was pretty good. The live singer stole the show! Hands down the best part of the evening. The food was sub par especially for Paris.

Me and the wife went on the evening 8.30 cruise for about £330 the food was lovely especially the cheese course the weather was beautiful we saw all the sights the female singer was fantastic it was a wonderful beautiful evening but the only bad thing our waiter was sometimes a bit funny we are not foodies but maybe it's a French thing but if you want to save money I would do the daytime cruise its half the price.
Not much to see on the river. Way overpriced for the food. Not even close to a gourmet dinner. Toughest meat I’ve ever had. Will not be going back nor would I recommend.
i HIGHLY recommend doing this wonderful gourmet food cruise on the Seine river beautiful scenery break the bank it's not that costly

I must admit I was a little nervous booking this from afar, costing so much money, and not knowing what to expect. There was no need! Check-in was good - however we were given two bay numbers to go to, went to the first, directed to the second, got our ticket and back to the first - a minor confusion and all came good in the end as the staff were professional, helpful and polite. We booked the 'upgraded' option (to get a window seat). We were seated promptly. Our seat was amazing!! Close to a window with absolute clear views. Those with the interior seats were not so far from the window though and if you chose that option you will not be disappointed. The food was first class - plenty of choice - one of use went with a complete veggie option. The timing of the meal was perfect - we never felt rushed - food came out at a comfortable pace (which is incredible given the amount of people they were catering for). We were tea-total that night but there was so much alcohol (I think the two of us sat down with 3 bottles chilling plus other drinks offered). We were adequately catered for though with non-alcoholic options. The views were beautiful - especially at night which is when we went (the 8pm ish sailing). Absolutely thoroughly recommended. A little pricey but you will not be disappointed.
Excellent service and meals. We’ll worth the price. A memorable event. High quality food, wine and entertainment.
Amazing food, good ambience, nice views!! Would definitely recommend this cruise. It’s worth the $$.

This was a very pleasant evening. The food was better than we expected. Of course the views were amazing. The boat itself was a bit worn. But, once the sun set and we were cruising through Paris at night - who cares!
Great hospitality, amazing views! Must do! The food was well presented and delicious. Would have preferred a little more of a gourmet flare.
Nice evening, but nothing stood out as memorable or worth the value. Service was slow and sporadic. Boats in good condition and comfortable.
Bread Bad, food mediocre, we didn't get our desserts. The view great, services ok. Seating uncomfortable.
Great views and a fun way to see some of the sights. Food was pretty good, wine was excellent. Our waiter looked after us well.

My partner and I opted for the premier level dinner cruise as our fancy, romantic dinner experience while in Paris last week. Overall, the views were incredible, the live music was great (and the singer was incredibly entertaining), and the food was tasty.

However, the service could have potentially marred the entire event. We arrived on the boat and sat in the very front section, where there were approximately seven tables. Upon arrival at 8:10, the seated tables had a drink and wonderful looking amuse-bouche, which appeared to be a velouté. They had menus (and maps of the important buildings along the route) in many different languages, so I was able to practice my long-ago high school French while he opted for English. We placed our order and proceeded to enjoy the views for a good 30 minutes before realizing that not only had we not received an amuse-bouche, the other tables had completed their appetizer course and were being offered a selection of differently colored steak knives for their main meal. My partner ultimately had to flag down our waiter and inquire if they had any remaining amuse-bouche as we had yet to start our meal. They brought it by, but no silverware.

Later on, we’re onto the main course and are using the typical knife on the table to try and cut our meat. Halfway through, the waiter brings by a steak knife, but it was essentially whatever was left. Not the same flourish and experience that we’d just witnessed at other tables.

Overall, we had a memorable experience and an incredible view of Paris with great entertainment and good food. But for €200 a plate, I shouldn’t feel like I was an afterthought throughout an entire 5 course meal.

Based on our cruise, you have a 6/7 chance of a truly memorable experience and a 1/7 chance of great views, great entertainment, and decent food but only if you ask for it…

Food was mediocre and the major sites were not visible from the river.
Also there was no human guide. Just a map.

Got to say. I was somewhat sceptical about this. But both me and my partner had a great time. Lovely evening. Lovely atmosphere. Nice food. Great service. The evening is what you might expect. So it'll either be your thing or not.
We both loved it.

Was looking forward to this dinner cruise, however the service was absolutely terrible. The waiter was rushing us to decide what we wanted within 1 minute of sitting down and having an attitude when we were not sure yet. The food was so bad I couldn't even eat it.
The experience was a good. Beautiful evening view of the city, was able to view up close the Statue of Liberty and Norte Dame. The band was enjoyable and the meal.

Adam was a fantastic tour guide went above and beyond with his knowledge of art and the city, he looks like he enjoys his work and that really comes across in his explanation of the art and history of the city, it made our experience more fun and realy taught us a lot of information that we would not have known if we had tried to do a tour on our own
The food was good, but i wouldn’t go there again for the food. It was a cosy atmosphere, and you could see a lot from the boat.
memorable evening with amazing sights. Great music and food. Overall definitely something I would do again.

We loved our dinner cruise. Service was lovely, the food was amazing and the views were spectacular! We paid for the window seat but honestly, we would have been happy with anything. Highly recommend!
This cruise on the Seine river was a wonderful and relaxing way to see Paris at night. Champagne and good food

Wonderful experience - great staff who were efficient and friendly, magnificent views and a smooth ride on a well maintained boat. Food was nice - the courses were timed well with plenty of water, wine poured by the waiter and extra bread offered in addition to the three courses.
Would give the experience an 11 out of 10 if possible. Elegant atmosphere with sincere attention to detail. The menu was delightfully diverse and did not disappoint. Just go !!!

Beautiful sights, delicious food. We had an a amazing time and I would recommend this experience to anyone. The music was lovely and the waiter was a gem. I will definitely do this again when I am back in Paris.
Lovely food, staff were really nice as well. We saw everything that was advertised and was the highlight of our Paris trip!
excellent food, service and overall experience, well worth it with kids or not, and you feel like you are "inside" the belly of Paris

Great French food, views, music and service. Waiter we had was especially wonderful and shared all the French loves with us. Neighborhoods to visit, music and the language similarities to English. The trip up the river in the evening is an unforgettable experience
The Food was delicious was all new tastes for me the atmosphere was great & our waiter was very polite.
A lovely experience from start to finish, lovely food and the hosting was superb. Incredible experience to see Paris by night
It was an amazing night, beautiful boat, very good service, excellent live music. The food isn't that great, but it's worth the experience.
This tour is well worth the money *****.the service was excellent. The food was great. The entertainment on board the ship was great. This was the highlight of our trip to Paris

One of my favorite memoirs was witnessing my granddaughter and her husband discover and enjoying new tastes during dinner.
I would encourage passengers to arrive at the pier by 7:30 to check in, then board to fully experience the beautiful surroundings on the boat and peruse the menu choices.
Great service and romantic. Didn’t expect this kind of service or view. Also the boat doesn’t move too much. Didn’t feel like we were on a boat
The atmosphere is nice, live music too loud, the food is definitely not the best in Paris, very mediocre. Nice view from the boat but service on board is very amatutre. Not the money worth.

The cruise was nice and we managed to see all the sights, the boat wasnt the most intimate felt a little commercialised . The food was average, the
Vegetarian food for my family member wasnt that great and not good value .

We paid for the premier seating and got every penny worth! It was cold outside, we were protected inside, relaxed, ate and drank the entire event. Time well spent with views! Food tasted amazing, wine and champagne.

It was the perfect evening
The serve is great so is the food
I am definitely will be back
If is have a chance
I want to recommend to anyone how is traveling to Paris

Our first night in Paris to celebrate my Wife's 50th Birthday and what a way to start having just arrived that day, the staff and food where excellent and the whole atmosphere on the boat was incredible great music and if I'm being honest you could easily have forgot you where actually on a boat, the trip was overall was great passing the famous landmarks all lit up at night was really nice.
If I get the chance to return to this wonderful City I certainly would do it all again it was that again.

I can’t recommend this enough.
Great food, great service and a great experience!
I will definitely do this again when I return to Paris.

Thank you for such a nice evening.
The whole dinner experience was so enjoyable, the attention and service were amazing and the sceneries to the city during it all made it a trip I would very much recommend and do once again.
Amazing experience! Great food and service and wonderful views! Highly recommended for viewing this beautiful city by night.

Wonderfull Ambiente, very friendly and funny servicepersonal.
Great sightseeing tour at night. It's beautiful to watch how all the lights play together.

2nd time getting this cruise

1st time was amazing no complaints

2nd time i miss the cruise by 10 minutes due to traffic conditions. Neither viator or Bateaux were able to help accommodate a refund or a different day. I book the tour for my mom and wife birthday and they were rude and not understanding at all.

I wont book any future activities with company.
Excellent service and food and of course the wonderful ambience of Paris at night. We stayed for a weekend in Paris and this was our favourite event.
Great time down the river, the wait and boarding process were beyond smooth and this was a great bookend for our trip
Stunning evening. Our waiter Samad was amazing, so attentive and informative. Would highly recommend. 10/10 Samad was the best ever
Excellent trip on the Seine with great food, atmosphere, service and sights. Highly recommended great way to see paris while enjoying Excellent food!

We loved everything about this trip. It was a great way to see so many famous sights and the food and service were beyond our expectations; really excellent. (I had the duck and thought it was perfect so disagreed with a previous reviewer.)

This was the most memorable part of our Paris trip. The ambiance, food, seating were all perfect. This is great for couples or families. The service was wonderful. A great way to start our trip. Would highly recommend and will do again when we return to Paris.
What an amazing night! The food was high quality and very tastefull. The service was amazing! If you are in Paris this is one of the things that will make your night! Very romantic!
Food was excellent! Amazing service! Lovely view! Highly recommend if you are new to the city or have lived here for years!
Amazing food, service & a perfect ride/dinner to take with your loved ones. pescatarian & lactose intolerant suitable
Dinner was great, staff was excellent, gorgeous views. We really enjoyed it and definitely would recommend this experience.

This was fabulous. I knew it would be fun but figured it would be a bit silly for corny.
It was so much better than I anticipated! The food was lovely and service outstanding. I would definitely recommend for anyone, not just first timer.

Great service. A little pricey, but the window table ("Privilege" option) view was worth it for a couples dinner. The meal and drinks also exceeded my expectations. Great choice for a special occasion dinner.

The food was amazing. The service was friendly and the food came out quickly.
The views were fantastic, even sat some way back from the Windows.
Definitely recommend

This was a nice idea but fell short of expectations. Service was great but food was horrible. From where we were seated, we couldn’t see the monuments very well.
Would be great to do a tour where you are sitting in open air on a boat in the spring/summer. But in November, it’s a pass.

I was told by our private tour guide that this was the best company providing Seine cruises and worth every penny. I went to the website, looked up the dates and found price was primarily based on where you chose to sit. Its almost always worth it to get the good seats and this was the case here. It would have been a nice trip at the lowest price table on this cruise, but the front of the boat with the curved glass dome was truly spectacular, especially when arriving back at the Tour Eiffel. It was so beautiful, it was emotional for me. A view of a lifetime... just amazing.

This three hour trip isnt about just the food, or the service, its the whole package that this company weaves together so well... its the atmosphere created by one of the most beautiful cities in the world, plus a lovely dinner, crisp linen covered tables and attentive service.

We had ample champagne, white wine and red wine. All were very good quality. My husband had escargot and I had the scallop as starters, both were excellent. Our entrees of sea bass and duck were also quite delicious. I cannot find fault with the food. Our server Ennis was VERY attentive and kept pouring the champagne for me once he learned I dont care for red.

I loved that there was a card telling us the sites we were passing but I found that by placing Google Maps on Satellite view on my iPhone, I knew exactly where we were and my husband and I could relate to daytime walks around the city. The nighttime skyline was gorgeous. All the monuments were lit by floodlights. BEAUTIFUL.

It was a 50 degree evening and we were warm and comfortable on our cruise. I was concerned we would be cold, but that was not the case at all. There was a coat check at the check in dock area.

The boat was lovely and we truly enjoyed ourselves. I wonder who these people are who hated this trip and feel they need to warn people to not take it. There are people who find fault with everything. If you know people like this, choose to ignore them on TripAdvisor as well. There is nothing heinous or awful about this wonderful evening by any stretch of the imagination. To the contrary, its a fantastic evening and a good value.

IF I must be very picky, I found the restroom situation to be VERY difficult. My husband is 82 and after a couple of glasses of wine, could have easily fell down the steep narrow step staircase to the bathrooms. I caught him in time and stopped him from going downstairs. No bathroom in the boarding area either. Surely in 2021 they must be required to have an accessible bathroom on restaurant level. I would encourage the company to offer use of an accessible bathroom to the elderly patrons aboard.

The person complaining about the taxi prices. Of course that has NOTHING to do with the cruise company. Its called Supply & Demand or Capitalism. We paid 15 E to get to the dock, but exciting the boat, many people walked to the street for a taxi, some had car services waiting, some had rental cars in the lot. I APPRECIATED the taxi drivers who waited for patrons exiting who could not walk far and were willing to pay extra for that service. I asked the driver if he were available. He said YES, but the fare is 25 tonight. I told him I knew that was more than usual for the distance but as long as he had change for 50 E, I would pay it. My choice and it was worth it.
Amazing experience and the boat was incredible but some of the food was slightly underwhelming. Still fantastic in the most part though. 4/5 overall
Great service and delicious food. Super comfortable and stylish boat. It was a wonderful experience.
We took the lunch tour as part of our Vantage River Cruise. Excellent service, good and great views. I would recommend this company and do this as a stand along activity.

We took the privilege package with seating next to the window, my wife and I celebrated our 26th anniversary with my mother-in-law; checking in was very smooth and the experience was unforgettable; gourmet food with wine and champagne, very attentive staff and outstanding views of Paris at night. It is expensive but really a great investment as you'll never forget that night!
What an experience! If you get a chance to sign up for this, do it. Great service, exquisite food, unforgettable sights. This was the highlight of our Paris honeymoon.
The food/drinks were excellent! The staff were very nice and we enjoyed the night time views of the city.
What a magnificent, elegant experience! The music, the cruise, the food..everything was great! I highly recommend it!

I live on the east coast in the US so I have done many dinner cruises. Typically, they are underwhelming with mediocre food at best. The food; the sights; and the cruise provided an excellent snapshot of Paris.

This was the highlight of our trip! The atmosphere was amazing, the food was great, the service was doing everything they could to make this night special for us. I'm so glad we did this. I recommend a table at the window.
The view is awesome and the food was excellent! The service and the atmosphere was great. We will be back again soon! Thank you for the wonderful time!
Food was outstanding service was exquisite and the scenery could not have been better. Wonderful way to kick off your vacation into meet and mingle with people from all over the world.

As expected dinner and cruise. Staff was friendly and the food was commensurate with the price. But BEWARE, the cabbies awaiting you are there to rip you off. I paid 12 Euro to get there, and when I disembarked there were many cabs awaiting. I chose one, asked how much and I thought he said 15 Euro so I jumped in the cab and when I got to destination he said 50 Euro!!!! He argued and said he was permitted by the cruise company to provide cab services and that was the fare. I called him a crook and we settled on 30 Euros. Rip Off in Paris. Shame on you Bateaux Parisiens because you should take care of your customers.
What a wonderful experience. Seeing the city all light up was spectacular. The food was delicious too.
Cant fault it. Excellent night. Great food and service. Very relaxing experience. Drinks included too, i did not know that.
Food was fabulous. Service was first rate. Views were decent but probably better right next to the window or at the front. Can’t fault the experience!

This was a very highly rated on TripAdvisor, and a friend told us we should to this, but I was a little skeptical that it would be “cheesy.” I was wrong.
This is a wonderful way to see some of the beautiful sites along the Seine River.
The dinner we had was actually delicious (we both selected the sea bass from the menu). The wine, while not great, was acceptable. The service was well-run, timed perfectly to end with the last sip of coffee as you return to the Eiffel Tower. The ride was so smooth that even when the boat reversed direction to allow another one right of way we didn’t even feel it.
One tip: the directions on the email are not fully detailed: from the corner of the street at the base of the Tower, go down the long stairs to river level, then walk about 100 meters to the right to find the ship.

It was a beautiful experience. No matter where you are seated you will get a nice view. The staff are very friendly. Very well maintained boat. I recommend you to arrive to the place 45 minutes prior departure.
Excellent experience! We really enjoyed, the service Stuff was 10 out 10, the food was good and the viwes you have are unbelievable! We would for certain recommend the experience!
All of it lol the whole experience was amazing from beginning to end. I would prefer not to have to check in on one boat only to get on another but this was a minimal thing
The check in process was very easy and smooth. Service was excellent. We really enjoyed each aspect of our meals, we even tried a few new items!
This was a lovely way to end our stay in Paris. The food was lovely. I ordered the beef and it was tender. The service was excellent. Really enjoyed the evening.
Great meal, gracious hosts, and a fantastic overview of the city. We started with this celebration dinner the night we arrived, and it was a perfect choice.

Fast service
and desert, there were a lot of extra charges that I wasn't expecting as I thought it was all inclusive. There was no commentary on what we were seing.
The food was amazing! The staff was very friendly and efficient. Loved the whole experience!….Especially how my wine glass was never empty 😉
What a wonderful experience, lovely food and music. A great way to see sites like Notre Dame and the Eiffel Tower all lit up.
Absolutely amazing, loved every minute. Very attentive staff and delicious food. Would definitely book again.

The service was impressive and the scenery delightful. The food overall was good. My sister-in-law had the steak, but it wasn’t until we had left the boat that she said it wasn’t a good piece of meat. I do believe had she’d let them know, it would have been taken care of.
Wonderful experience, worth every penny! Recommend the window seat. Get there early so you sit inthe middle of the boat

This company were professional from the moment we enquired at their offices at Pier 5 near the Eifel Tower, to the moment we left the boat after the cruise.
The booking staff were very helpful and patient. The boat was superbly furnished. All a bit of a tight squeeze but it was a boat after all! The food and wine were delicious, the serving staff brilliant. The cruise was really excellent and whole evening provided a lovely leisurely trip. Highly recommended.

Incredibly happy I booked my lunch with this cruise line. There were several companies to choose from that I wasn't sure initially but the convenient location next to the Eiffel tower, the elegant clean comfortable boat, wonderful meal, talented live music and professional courteous staff made this cruise better than I could have imagined. The large windows made taking touristy pictures easy. It was pouring outside so we arrived and were able stay in the nice waiting lounge early.
The highlight of our trip to Paris. Value plus. Outstanding dinner and service. The views were beyond our imagination.

This is a great way to see the sights along the river. The cruise is a wonderful escape from the busy streets of Paris. We booked the most expensive package. It was extravagant, however, after considering the value of the sightseeing and the wonderful dinner and wine, we agreed it was wekk worth the expenditure. I recommend sitting on the port side as you have the views across the river as opposed to looking up at the river bank from the starboard side. Of course, bow center tables are the best.
See Paris from the river, it's a must do experience. Boat is clean and timely with translations to all major languages.

Good value for money. The seats in the "middle" of the boat have good views. Food was delicious, service was great. Even the corny photos from the onboard photographer were good but expensive at 20 euros each! A night I can recommend :)
This was an amazing experience. Excellent service and food was delicious! Great views from the water, definitely recommend.

Very bad service on the boat. Very stressful atmosphere. Food served only after asking the waiter. Or else we would have been totally forgotten. Wonderful food....Wonderful Music. but thats all. Not worth the 200 euro. What a pity.
Food and service was good. Great for couples if you want to cruise the city by night. Music was entertaining.

Very nice dinner to enjoy dinner & see the sights of Paris at night.Dinner and wine were very good. Service was excellent. Spend more to sit next to the windows to get a better view. My only issue is with the spacing of the seating. It was difficult to get up and walk around due to the tables being too close together.

Booked cruise on first night in Paris. Check in process needs help. Booking says dock 5 or 7. Agent outside almost sent us to the non dinner cruise line even after looking at tickets. Check in counters at both 5 and 7 and people sent between both depending on which cruise. How about have someone outside to send you to the correct dock from the start. Once at host stand pleasant welcome and walk to seat. Nice window seat, ambience, singer, wine. Nice cheese pastry puffs. Before the trip I was told there was a vegetarian menu and options and also was noted on my boarding ticket. Again not having been on the river
Dinner cruise before the waiter was rude and just said “we will bring the meal” when asked if we could look at the vegetarian menu. The other dinner menu had options you picked. A simple explanation of “we only have one vegetarian option” and follow it up with a description of what one is getting to eat would suffice. Instead the waiter again just says “you will get what we have for vegetarian option.” At close to $200/pp I think knowing what is on the menu is part of eating a nice meal. The wine was good, but again the waiter didn’t explain we had 2 bottles included in our dinner. He just said “you cannot order other wine” when my significant other asked for a glass of rose. Overall, however, for the price to include a meal, music, wine, champagne and window views it is a good product/service and would recommend it. An improvement in service would make this is 4.5-5 star experience. Otherwise I settle for 3.5-4.

Was in Paris for my Birthday and went on this dinner cruise down the Seine. It was a beautiful night and the cruise was fun. The servers were fantastic and the food was delicious. The dessert was not very tasty at all which we were surprised. We asked if we could get something else instead and the cruise was almost over and they were unable to provide a better dessert, which was fine because we were full. Definitely would go again. It was a lovely way to see Paris at night!

My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our 8.30pm dinner cruise on the Seine and we were given a prime window seat.
The food was high quality & delicious and so was the excellent wine, that seemed to be suppled in generous volumes. Service was superb and the only complaint was the cheesy photography they insisted on doing with rather mediocre to poor quality results (surprising as the camera used was a good one), at €20 per photo this was a rip off and they even tried to take pictures with a second photographer! (Probably an error).
The cruise itself was about 2.5 hours and very nice indeed though and a great atmosphere on board with music and band playing, though not intrusive at all.
A great night out!

We chose the 6:15 pm cruise. Lucky to have a table on the outer perimeter of the boat however I noticed all tables had a good river view. Food was very good and served elegantly by pleasant servers. Romantic and relaxing view of the city. Highly recommend!

This was a true highlight of our week in Paris. From start to finish, we would give it an A+. We chose to take the cruise on our first night in the city and found it to be the perfect introduction. The cruise itself was what I had hoped it would be but the dinner far exceeded our expectations. The food was absolutely wonderful and the wine seemed to flow endlessly. The live music was just enough to be entertaining yet unobtrusive. Spring for the extra money to ensure a table by the window.

by far the most amazing thing I've done! if you go to Paris you need to book this! we did the 8:30 pm dinner cruise and it was out of this world. You see all Paris has to offer, and the food is out of this world. The service is second to none and the band is divine there is not one thing about this experience you could say was less than 5 star!
Was great way to see the city from the seine. The dinner was pretty good for a dinner cruise although not as good as some of the restaurants nearby

The service was the best part. The food was ok. To be fair I am a meat and potatoes kinda guy. I had the foie gras, the steak, and cheese plate. The steak was tough. The wine was good. You will share a table with another couple. Not bad as long as they are interesting people. Dont think it's a romantic trip.
We did the one hour cruise with commentary. We thought that it was a great way to see the city and the next time we will book a dinner cruise. Probably the best money that we spent in Paris.

My wife and I went to Paris to celebrate our honeymoon and we decided to have this dinner cruise on our last night. It was such a great experience! It was nice to see how active the Seine is and to see the Paris landmarks from a different perspective. We chose the 8pm dinner (Etoile) and it was great! We sat toward the middle of the tables which we did not mind since all our view was not obstructed. The food was good and there was plenty of wine to go around. We finished two bottles! I highly recommend this to anyone considering this cruise!

I couldn’t recommend this enough to anyone visiting Paris for a few days. We booked the Etoile package, the food was lovely. The steak was cooked perfectly and the wine was lovely, I’m not usually a wine drinker but, the red wine served with the main meal was the nicest I’ve ever had. The atmosphere was romantic, I was concerned the tables would be so close that it wouldn’t feel intimate, but we had the best night of our break. Thank you
Recommend to any visitors to Paris, the food and service was outstanding. The ever changing view made this a night to remember

We purchased Privilege Dinner Cruise tickets. We had a party of 8 and we were seated at two window tables. The evening cruise was spectacular! Everything from the live entertainment, food, wine, and illuminated famous sights at night were outstanding. We enjoyed seeing people along the river dancing, dining and relaxing. Excellent table service and personable waiters! Would highly recommend as a finale to any Paris visit.

Everything was terrific. Pay the extra $ for the guaranteed window table. Service was excellent, food and wine were fantastic, and you can't beat the view. They spent plenty of time at the Eiffel Tower which sparkled and flashed.

We chose a dinner cruise with love music, so there was a singer and a violinist playing throughout our meal -- delightful! The food and wine were delicious, the service was fine, and the views were absolutely spectacular. You really get to see the City of Lights in it's glory from the boat. Plus, a photographer snapped a picture of us at the beginning of the night, and we were able to purchase it later (no haggling needed - it was a great photo). Highly recommend as a romantic dinner date.

On our last day in Paris, my wife and I decided to take an evening cruise with another couple. We select Bateaux Parisiens, and had a wonderful time. Over a leisurely 2.5 hours, we finished off a bottle of champagne, 2 bottles of wine, and a 4 course French dinner. The food was good enough, but the boat ambiance was the best part. Live music, great table service, and a great mood set us off a wonderful way to end our Paris trip. I highly recommend getting the window seats and getting to view each of the Paris landmarks from the Seine river.

Oh dear, this can't be the same company that twenty years ago ran a full evening, romantic, dinner cruise with good food and wine, with live music and an opportunity for a dance after dinner. Now it seems to be get them on board, ignore the dress code, get them fed and get them disembarked so that we can have enough time for the second cruise on the same evening. However, full marks for the hardworking, pleasant, English speaking waiters.

Yes, the photographers gush a little and yes, the whole thing is a little commercial BUT the whole experience was way better than I expected.
I took my wife here for dinner our first night in Paris and we thought the service was good, the food great (excellent compared to other bateaux options) and how can you not love Paris at night on the Seine. Worth every cent in my opinion.

My husband booked the dinner cruise for our 20th anniversary - both our children came along and we got a lovely table next to the window. You can board the boat half an hour before the cruise time. The food was lovely - the starters and champagne we served before the cruise started so we felt the dinner wasn’t rushed. The main course was good - especially the sea bass. There were 2 ladies singing intermittently through out the evening. The views along the journey are amazing and the boat timed it’s docking with the beautiful light display on the Eiffel Tower. I would recommend this option to anyone.
The only bit of advise I would suggest is that make sure you ask your taxi to come back and collect you. We were very fortunate that a taxi was near by and we managed to grab it - there were no others near by when we left.

Wonderful cruise on Seine. Surprisingly good food, fast and great service! Definitely do the longer cruise that departs at 8:30. They even had live entertainment. Overall definitely worth the time and money!

What a fantastic evening we had on this cruise , the food was great, nice wine, and of course; Paris from the Seine.

Thank you so much for the excellent service also!

We did the 20:30 cruise on the Etoile service. Great experience through out the whole trip. This is a must see when in Paris and was my favourite trip out of all that we did. Service and food was brilliant. Sight seeing was amazing especially boarding in daylight and arriving back at dark. Would recommend to all! Definitely worth the money.

Food and service were excellent... very nice and relaxing way to see Paris from the water perspective.
Highly recommended cruise.
This was a very romantic and relaxing trip down the Seine. I would recommend this trip for anyone interested in a boat cruise. The food was excellent as well as the entertainment.

We were expecting a romantic dinner cruise along the river and visualizing the lights from the river. As it turned out, we our meal while still sitting in dock and then took a pitifully short token journey along the river. Food was okay...service was excellent. Not recommended.

I read mixed reviews so when I booked for my wife’s birthday I had every finger crossed... we had a GREAT time! We booked on the 8.30 dinner cruise, great atmosphere, great food and great service. Was such a nice way to see the city and the sites whilst enjoy great food and wine!

This was such a lovely way to see the views and have some dinner at the same time. I bit upper market food and very lovely. On my ticket it said no trainers or jeans. They were not really strict on this.

Took my wife and daughter on this dinner cruise for our anniversary. We were not disappointed! The evening was simply magical from the view of Paris, the selection of wines, and the dinner! Get a seat by the window....pay extra for the privacy and charm of Paris. The Wines were some of the best I have had in Paris. The food was outstanding. Definitely a must do when you visit. Thank you TripAdvisor!

On June 4, we joined another couple on this dinner cruise. They messed up our reservations and we did not get our table by the window. That was a huge disappointment, but the gentlemen gallantly allowed my friend and I to have the outward looking seats . We were also unaware that there were a variety of choices in the grade of wine and food options availab le before we pre-paid and made our reservations.

That being said , the food was delicious, the wine was good, the service was great and the views of Paris at night were spectacular. We would definitely do it again, but make sure you have your confirming e-mails showing exactly what you paid for!

Many reasons why I chose it. 1st it's always a great way to see the sights and to show that the river Seine is part of the city.
The food was amazing, the live music set the mood only down side is the service. Our waiter was in a very big section and couldn't take care of everybody. Maybe making the sections smaller for a better service would work wonders.

We did this tour our first night in Paris and it was a great experience. Got to see many of the monuments and attractions lit up at night while enjoying a good dinner. Would definitely recommend.

Food: 4.5/5
Experience: 5/5

Me and my partner booked the privilige packet and i can say, though the price is a little steep it was definitelt worth it. We were seated next to the window, beautiful food and constant supply of carefully selected wine. Music was perfect as it had a mix of french and english song choices that were also easy listening and the right volume. Extremely romantic and would recommend to anyone
While the atmosphere and service were great, the food was not. Those in our group that had steak found it tough and it was cold. The salads, shrimp dinner and desserts were great.

I will never forget this trip and that dinner, the night tour in the river is amazing, in both the river banks you will see the lights of the old city; I highly recommend any one visiting Paris not to miss this experience

Booked a lunchtime cruise with bateaux Parisians, which well exceeded our expectations. The food was exceptional, the wine was flowing and the service was second to none. By far the best 2 hours of our 3 day stay. Highly recommend.

We booked and paid for this wonderful evening a couple of months in advance online. The company, Bateaux Parisien, was recommended to me by the hotel where we are staying.
We booked the Premier service which, if you look online, has a lot of benefits, one of which is you have a table in the front of the boat with the best views.
We arrived at quay7 and booked in. We were given, by the very pleasant receptionist, the menu's and a card detailing all the sights that we will be seeing on the 2 1/2 hour cruise. After boarding we were escorted to our table for two by a waiter. We had a table by the window and there was plenty of room.
The four course menu had a lovely selection and was a joy to choose from. The waiting staff were very attentive, helpful and friendly but not intrusive. The meal was excellent and you were not rushed. It was a lovely way to see the sights. We had an evening cruise and the lights of the buildings were beautiful, especially the Eiffel Tower.
It was a wonderful evening and worth every penny.
Thank you Bateaux Parisien.

We had a wonderful evening. I'd have given 5 stars if the music had been more French and less trying-to-please-their-idea-of-tourists, which is what it felt like.
The views of Paris, by night, from the Seine, were stunning and when our very attentive and charming waiter noticed we were examining the map, he came and told us a little bit about the buildings we saw. He continued to pop back now and then with a short commentary.
The food was good. Not excellent but good enough. The desserts could be better. The wine was very good and there was plenty of it!
We had the privilege experience and I would do it again in a heart beat.

This was a pleasant evening out but could have been better. I felt the musical entertainment could have been more French in character with accordion music and " torch" singers. The service at our table gave the impression of being an afterthought probably resulting from a very large party of say 20 which had most of the staff at our end of the boat fully occupied. We were the last to be served on every course and the dessert served almost at the terminal of the cruise. I opted for the extra cheese course expecting some interesting French variety only to be served with what would be described as " Mousetrap " in the U.K. The only time our waiter hurried to us was at the end when we left the table to stand by the exit to claim our coats having forgot to pay the extra fee for the rather poor cheese offering !!. I dont think I could advise taking this trip as i feel it was probably rather over-priced.The Entree and main course were good but let down badly by the uninteresting dessert consisting of what appeared to be chocolate sponge with a small scoop of indifferent ice-cream. I did not feel this trip was good value and certainly would not repeat !! Incidentally I felt the photgrapher was rather rude when we declined to have our photographs taken. He immediately challenged with a rather brusque " Why not " and continued when i repeated that we did not require photographs. He came within an ace of me calling the " Manager" and demanding an apology. i do not have to give a reason for my decisions !!!!
Got engaged in Paris and topped it off with the river cruise. Perfect way to end the trip, amazing food and atmosphere in the evening on the boat.
Amazing food endless good wine excellent service and a cruise along the seine. This was Christmas Day 2017

What a fantastic evening we had cruising the Seine. I took my wife for a wonderfully romantic evening meal on board Le Cristal 2. The food was amazing, the wine fantastic and all set to the constantly changing scenery of a 2½ hour 24km cruise from the foot of the Eiffel Tower. The service was superb and the waiter was knowledgeable and entertaining. Lovely live music too. I will go again.

This was a great dinner/river cruise. The staff were very friendly and the service was fantastic. The meals were really good and it was a great way to see the sites of Paris. We had done a lot of walking in Paris to see all the sites and I found this very relaxing as we cruised the river. We asked for another bottle of wine and were pleasantly surprised when the waiter told us that he would not be charging us for it. Well worth the experience.

We book the Lunch Privilege Service with Bateaux Parisiens and are very pleased with our decision. The service was outstanding! Champagne, wine and food were delicious. The views of Paris were beyond words.
They even have menus in different languages, you just need to ask at the reception when you arrive.
I highly recommend this lunch cruise to anyone.

Starting from the Eiffel Tower we took the 2030 cruise which lasted 2hrs 30 mins until 2300. We received an excellent welcome and despite picking the cheapest seats on the boat, we had excellent views. The food was really good quality, and we had a bottle of whit, and red, and still water and sparking water at no extra cost between three of us. The only thing that was additional cost, was the purchase of photos from the photographer. The waiter was really kind and informative about the views too. All in all a great evening, on a great boat, when we were made to feel a million dollars - a good example of what customer service should be.
